original_title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
overview: This wacky prequel to the 1994 blockbuster goes back to the lame-brained Harry and Lloyd's days as classmates at a Rhode Island high school, where the unprincipled principal puts the pair in remedial courses as part of a scheme to fleece the school.
tagline: The evolution of dumb...
title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
plot:
Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd is a 2003 American buddy comedy directed by Troy Miller, who wrote the screenplay with Robert Brener. The second installment in the Dumb and Dumber franchise and a prequel to the 1994 original, it follows the characters during their high school years. The Farrelly brothers, Jim Carrey and Jeff Daniels had no involvement, and Trey Parker and Matt Stone, once slated to write it, left the project by 2000. Much of the film was shot in and around Atlanta, including school scenes at Walton High School in Marietta. New Line Cinema released it on June 13, 2003.

In 1986, Harry Dunne finally starts attending a regular high school, while Lloyd Christmas, after a string of failed adoptions, has been taken in by the school janitor, Ray. The two meet on the way to school and instantly become best friends, and the bully Turk soon hoists them up a flagpole. Meanwhile the corrupt Principal Collins, who wants money for a condo in Waikiki with his girlfriend, the cafeteria worker Ms. Heller, sees the pair and invents a fake "special needs" class to swindle a $100,000 grant out of Richard Moffit, a former special needs student. Harry and Lloyd eagerly recruit classmates they consider "special", including Turk, an injured skateboarder named Toby and his girlfriend, Terri, and a student they mistake for a centaur, and Ms. Heller teaches the class in Ray's shed.

Jessica Matthews, a headstrong reporter for the school paper, grows suspicious of Collins and invites Harry to dinner for information, which he mistakes for romance. Competing for her, Harry and Lloyd fall out before realizing they are nothing without each other. They steal a chest from Collins's office that holds evidence of all his and Ms. Heller's scams, and when Collins detains Jessica, believing she took it, the class turns its Thanksgiving parade float into a giant likeness of the principal and plays his recordings over loudspeakers. Collins and Heller are arrested. Jessica thanks the boys but rides off with her boyfriend, and the friends turn down a ride from twin sisters while arguing over which girl each wants.

Derek Richardson plays Harry and Eric Christian Olsen plays Lloyd, with Eugene Levy as Collins, Cheri Oteri as Ms. Heller, Luis Guzmán as Ray and Rachel Nichols as Jessica. Critics panned it, giving it 10% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 19. It still grossed $39.3 million worldwide against a $19 million budget.

overview: A respected priest volunteers for an experimental procedure that may lead to a cure for a deadly virus. He gets infected and dies, but a blood transfusion of unknown origin brings him back to life. Now, he’s torn between faith and bloodlust, and has a newfound desire for the wife of a childhood friend.
production_companies: Company K Movie Asset Fund No. 1
tagline: Lusting after sinful pleasures.
title: Thirst
plot:
Thirst (Korean: Bakjwi, literally "Bat") is a 2009 horror film written, produced and directed by Park Chan-wook, based on Émile Zola's 1867 novel Thérèse Raquin. Park had first asked Song Kang-ho to star in a vampire film as early as Joint Security Area, and developed the story with co-writer Chung Seo-kyung. A co-production of South Korea and the United States, it was the first Korean feature made with both Korean and American studio funding and distribution, from CJ Entertainment and Focus Features. It opened in South Korea on 30 April 2009.

Sang-hyun, a Catholic priest who ministers to hospital patients, volunteers for an experiment to find a vaccine against the deadly Emmanuel Virus. He is infected but recovers after a blood transfusion, and his parishioners come to believe he has healing powers. Among the new worshippers is his childhood friend Kang-woo, a sickly man who lives with his overbearing mother, Mrs. Ra, and his wife, Tae-ju. When Sang-hyun relapses, he discovers that he has become a vampire: sunlight burns him and only human blood keeps the disease at bay. Trying not to kill, he steals transfusion packs from the hospital, and he begins a passionate affair with Tae-ju. After she tells him that Kang-woo abuses her, Sang-hyun drowns his friend during a fishing trip.

The couple are haunted by visions of Kang-woo, and Mrs. Ra, drinking heavily, sinks into complete paralysis. When Tae-ju admits that Kang-woo never abused her, Sang-hyun is enraged. Distraught, she asks him to kill her, and he does, but unwilling to be alone forever, he revives her with his own blood. As a vampire, Tae-ju kills without restraint while Sang-hyun feeds only when necessary, and their conflicting ethics lead to violent clashes. When Mrs. Ra reveals their crime to Kang-woo's friends, Tae-ju murders two of them. Sang-hyun destroys his followers' faith in him by pretending to attack a girl, then drives Tae-ju and Mrs. Ra to an open field before dawn. Tae-ju tries to hide, but he thwarts every attempt, and the lovers burn to ash in the rising sun as Mrs. Ra looks on.

Song plays Sang-hyun, with Kim Ok-vin as Tae-ju, Shin Ha-kyun as Kang-woo and Kim Hae-sook as Mrs. Ra. Thirst won the Jury Prize at the 2009 Cannes Film Festival, where it competed for the Palme d'Or, and topped the South Korean box office on its opening weekend. Critics were largely positive, with 81% approval on Rotten Tomatoes, and Roger Ebert called Park the most successful horror director working.

overview: Set between Episode II and III, The Clone Wars is the first computer animated Star Wars film. Anakin and Obi Wan must find out who kidnapped Jabba the Hutt's son and return him safely. The Separatists will try anything to stop them and ruin any chance of a diplomatic agreement between the Hutts and the Republic.
title: Star Wars: The Clone Wars
plot:
Star Wars: The Clone Wars is a 2008 animated science fiction film directed by Dave Filoni, George Lucas, and Karen Gilchrist. The movie takes place between Attack of the Clones and Revenge of the Sith in the Star Wars universe.

The main themes of Star Wars: The Clone Wars include:

1. **Loyalty vs. Duty**: Anakin Skywalker (Hayden Christensen) is faced with a difficult decision when he is ordered to execute Order 66, which would lead to the execution of Jedi Knights. This theme explores the conflict between loyalty to one's friends and duty to follow orders.

2. **The Gray Area Between Good and Evil**: The Clone Wars introduce a more nuanced view of the Star Wars universe, where characters are not simply good or evil. Anakin's character development is particularly notable in this regard, as he struggles with his own morality.

3. **Friendship and Camaraderie**: The film highlights the strong bonds between Anakin, Obi-Wan Kenobi (Ewan McGregor), Ahsoka Tano (Ashley Eckstein), and other clone troopers. These relationships are tested as they face numerous challenges together.

4. **The Cost of War**: The Clone Wars depict a galaxy in chaos, with widespread destruction and loss of life. This theme serves as a reminder of the devastating consequences of war and the importance of finding alternative solutions to conflict.

5. **Personal Growth and Self-Discovery**: Anakin's journey is marked by significant personal growth, as he grapples with his own identity and the expectations placed upon him. Ahsoka Tano also undergoes a transformative experience, learning valuable lessons about her place in the galaxy.

Overall, Star Wars: The Clone Wars offers a rich and complex exploration of these themes, setting the stage for the events of Revenge of the Sith and beyond.

original_title: Tinker Bell and the Pirate Fairy
overview: Zarina, a smart and ambitious dust-keeper fairy who’s captivated by Blue Pixie Dust and its endless possibilities, flees Pixie Hollow and joins forces with the scheming pirates of Skull Rock, who make her captain of their ship. Tinker Bell and her friends must embark on an epic adventure to find Zarina, and together they go sword-to-sword with the band of pirates led by a cabin boy named James, who’ll soon be known as Captain Hook himself.
tagline: From the World of Peter Pan.
title: Tinker Bell and the Pirate Fairy
plot:
Tinker Bell and the Pirate Fairy is a 2014 animated adventure film produced by DisneyToon Studios, which serves as a spin-off to the popular Tinker Bell franchise. The movie follows the story of Zarina, a young fairy who dreams of becoming a pirate fairy.

The film begins with Zarina (voiced by Mae Whitman), a talented but struggling fairy who lives in Pixie Hollow, a community of fairies who live and work together to maintain the balance of nature. Zarina is fascinated by pirates and longs to join their ranks, much to the dismay of her friends and family. Despite her efforts, she is constantly rejected due to her lack of pirate skills.

One day, Zarina discovers that the infamous pirate fairy, Captain Lirien (voiced by Tom Hiddleston), has stolen a magical treasure known as the "Heart of Pixie Hollow." The Heart is a powerful artifact that maintains the balance of nature in Pixie Hollow. Without it, the land begins to wither and die.

Zarina decides to embark on a journey to find Captain Lirien and retrieve the Heart of Pixie Hollow. Along the way, she meets a motley crew of pirates, including the infamous pirate fairy, Captain Lirien (voiced by Tom Hiddleston), and his loyal first mate, Vidia (voiced by Lucy Liu). Zarina also befriends a young boy named James (voiced by Ross Humphreys), who becomes her ally in her quest.

As Zarina navigates the high seas, she learns valuable lessons about perseverance, friendship, and believing in herself. Meanwhile, Captain Lirien's true intentions are revealed, and Zarina must confront him to reclaim the Heart of Pixie Hollow.

The film features a mix of action, adventure, and humor, with plenty of exciting sequences showcasing Zarina's pirate skills. The animation is vibrant and colorful, bringing the world of fairies and pirates to life in a way that is both whimsical and thrilling.

In the end, Zarina successfully retrieves the Heart of Pixie Hollow and returns it to its rightful place in Pixie Hollow. With her newfound confidence and pirate skills, she earns the respect of her friends and family, and becomes a true pirate fairy. The film concludes with Zarina and James sharing a heartwarming moment, as they look out at the sunset together.

Overall, Tinker Bell and the Pirate Fairy is a delightful and entertaining film that explores themes of self-discovery, friendship, and following one's dreams. With its lovable characters, exciting adventure sequences, and stunning animation, it is a must-see for fans of Disney and fairy tales alike.

overview: Mexican immigrant and single mother Flor Moreno finds housekeeping work with Deborah and John Clasky, a well-off couple with two children of their own. When Flor admits she can't handle the schedule because of her daughter, Cristina, Deborah decides they should move into the Clasky home. Cultures clash and tensions run high as Flor and the Claskys struggle to share space while raising their children on their own, and very different, terms.
tagline: Every family has a hero.
title: Spanglish
plot:
Spanglish is a poignant and nuanced exploration of class differences, identity, and the complexities of human relationships. The film delves into the lives of two women from different walks of life, Madrigal (Cloris Leachman) and Flor (Shirley MacLaine), who form an unlikely bond with their new housekeeper, Flor's daughter Margarita (America Ferrera).

At its core, Spanglish is a story about the struggles of working-class women to maintain dignity and self-respect in the face of poverty, exploitation, and societal expectations. Madrigal, a wealthy widow, and Flor, a retired actress, find themselves at odds with each other as they navigate their own personal crises. However, when Margarita enters their lives, they are forced to confront their own biases and prejudices.

The film also explores the theme of identity and cultural heritage. Margarita's struggles to balance her Mexican-American roots with her desire for a better life serve as a powerful metaphor for the immigrant experience. Through Margarita's character, the film sheds light on the complexities of cultural identity and the ways in which societal expectations can both unite and divide people.

Furthermore, Spanglish is a nuanced portrayal of class differences and the ways in which they can be both oppressive and liberating. The film highlights the tensions between Madrigal's wealth and privilege, and Flor's more modest means, as well as Margarita's struggles to navigate her own economic circumstances.

Ultimately, Spanglish is a powerful exploration of human relationships, identity, and the complexities of class differences. Through its thoughtful portrayal of complex characters and their struggles, the film offers a nuanced and thought-provoking commentary on the human experience.

overview: This is a story of a man in free fall. On the road to redemption, darkness lights his way. Connected with the afterlife, Uxbal is a tragic hero and father of two who's sensing the danger of death. He struggles with a tainted reality and a fate that works against him in order to forgive, for love, and forever.
tagline: You don't choose your family. We all belong to somebody, but to belong to Uxbal and Marambra, is both a blessing and a curse.
title: Biutiful
plot:
Biutiful is a poignant and powerful film that delves into the complexities of human existence, exploring themes of redemption, morality, and the struggle for survival in a world that often seems devoid of compassion. The story revolves around Uxbal, a man struggling to care for his two daughters after being released from prison, where he was serving time for a crime he claims not to have committed.

As Uxbal navigates this treacherous landscape, he must confront the harsh realities of poverty, addiction, and the desperation that can drive individuals to make choices they later regret. The film is a nuanced exploration of the human condition, revealing the cracks in Uxbal's own moral framework as he grapples with his circumstances.

Throughout the movie, director Alejandro González Iñárritu masterfully weaves together elements of drama, mystery, and social commentary, creating a rich tapestry that not only reflects the gritty realities of life on the margins but also offers a profound meditation on the nature of humanity. Ultimately, Biutiful is a film about the resilience of the human spirit, its capacity for love, forgiveness, and redemption in the face of overwhelming adversity.

overview: Captain Glass of the USS Arkansas discovers that a coup d'état is taking place in Russia, so he and his crew join an elite group working on the ground to prevent a war.
tagline: Courage runs deep
title: Hunter Killer
plot:
Hunter Killer is a 2018 American action thriller film directed by Donovan Marsh and written by Arne Schmidt and Jamie Moss, based on the 2012 novel Firing Point by Don Keith and George Wallace. Gerard Butler stars as Commander Joe Glass, a submarine captain whose crew joins a team of Navy SEALs to rescue the Russian president from a coup, with Gary Oldman, Toby Stephens as the SEAL leader Lieutenant Bill Beaman and Michael Nyqvist, in his penultimate film role, as the Russian captain Sergei Andropov. Common and Linda Cardellini also appear.

When the American submarine USS Tampa Bay vanishes while shadowing a Russian submarine in the Barents Sea, the newly promoted and unconventional Glass is sent to investigate aboard USS Arkansas. Meanwhile, Beaman's SEAL team, watching a Russian naval base at Polyarny, sees Defense Minister Dmitriy Durov stage a coup and seize President Nikolai Zakarin in a bid to start a war, and the team is forced to leave behind a wounded member, Martinelli. Arkansas finds the wreck of Tampa Bay with no survivors and the sunken Russian submarine Konek, apparently sabotaged from within, and is ambushed by a second Russian submarine hidden beneath an iceberg, the vessel that had sunk Tampa Bay. Arkansas fights back and rescues the Konek's survivors, including Captain Andropov. Rear Admiral John Fisk proposes that Arkansas pick up Zakarin once the SEALs free him. With the reluctant Andropov's guidance, the submarine slips through a minefield to the base undetected. The SEALs free Zakarin with the help of a wounded presidential bodyguard, Oleg, losing him and two of their own, and Beaman delivers the injured president to the submarine's rescue vehicle before returning for Martinelli. Arkansas is then attacked by Andropov's old ship, the destroyer Yevchenko but Andropov signals that Zakarin is aboard. When Durov orders missiles fired at the surfaced submarine, Glass refuses to retaliate for fear of starting the war he is trying to prevent, and Andropov's former crew defy orders, shoot down the missiles and destroy the base headquarters, killing Durov. War averted, Glass returns Zakarin and the Russian survivors and departs under Russian escort.

Summit Premiere released Hunter Killer in the United States on October 26, 2018. It flopped, grossing $31.7 million worldwide, and drew mixed reviews, with a 38% Rotten Tomatoes rating.

overview: Dr. Louis Creed and his wife, Rachel, move from Boston to Ludlow, in rural Maine, with their two young children. Hidden in the woods near the new family home, Ellie, their eldest daughter, discovers a mysterious cemetery where the pets of community members are buried.
tagline: They don't come back the same.
title: Pet Sematary
plot:
Pet Sematary (2019) is a horror film directed by Kevin Kölsch and Dennis Widmyer, based on the novel of the same name by Stephen King. The movie follows the Creed family - Louis (Jason Clarke), Rachel (Amy Seimetz), and their two children, Ellie (Layton Williams) and Gage (Jubel Early) - who move to rural Ludlow, Maine, where they discover a mysterious burial ground that has the power to bring the dead back to life.

The main themes of Pet Sematary (2019) include:

1. **Grief and Loss**: The film explores the devastating effects of losing loved ones, particularly in cases of sudden or untimely death. Louis's grief over his wife Rachel's passing drives much of the plot.
2. **Hubris and the Dangers of Playing God**: When Louis brings back his deceased wife, he unleashes a terrible curse that threatens to destroy his family. The film warns against the dangers of meddling with forces beyond human control.
3. **The Power of Nature**: The movie highlights the awe-inspiring power of nature, particularly in rural Maine's wilderness. The burial ground and its dark energies serve as a reminder of the natural world's unpredictability and fury.
4. **Trauma and Family Dynamics**: As the Creed family navigates their new life in Ludlow, they must confront their own traumas and the consequences of their actions. The film examines how trauma can affect families and relationships.
5. **The Corrupting Influence of Power**: When Louis's resurrected wife returns with a malevolent presence, it serves as a cautionary tale about the dangers of seeking power or control over life and death.

Overall, Pet Sematary (2019) is a haunting exploration of the human experience, delving into themes that are both universally relatable and uniquely terrifying.

overview: When ISIS took their homes, families and city, one group of men fought to take it all back. Based on true events, this is the story of the Nineveh SWAT team, a renegade police unit who waged a guerrilla operation against ISIS in a desperate struggle to save their home city of Mosul.
title: Mosul
plot:
Mosul is a 2019 Arabic-language American war film written and directed by Matthew Michael Carnahan, inspired by Luke Mogelson's New Yorker article about the 2016 Battle of Mosul, in which Iraqi government forces and their allies drove ISIS from the city it had held since 2014. Adam Bessa plays young policeman Kawa, with Suhail Dabbach as Major Jasem, Is'haq Elias as Waleed and Waleed Elgadi as an Iranian colonel.

During the battle, three Iraqi policemen who have arrested ISIS drug smugglers are overrun and run out of ammunition, and Kawa, a 21-year-old Feyli Kurd, loses his uncle in the fighting. They are rescued by the Nineveh SWAT team, a unit of Mosul natives who have lost relatives to ISIS, led by Major Jasem. Because his uncle was killed by ISIS, Kawa is invited to join, while his partner Jameel takes the uncle's body for burial. The unit presses on with a mission whose purpose no one will explain to Kawa. Resting in an abandoned building, Kawa and Jasem see Jameel guide an ISIS car bomber to their position, and the blast kills the team member Tomahawk, whose axe Jasem gives to Kawa. Distrusted as a traitor's partner, Kawa grows frustrated. Crossing into ISIS-held territory, the team loses Hooka to rooftop gunmen and a Humvee to an explosive drone.

An Iranian colonel commanding Popular Mobilization Forces in the city trades the unit ammunition for cigarettes, and Jasem finds Jameel among his prisoners. Jameel says ISIS forced him to betray them by threatening his grandson in Michigan, and as tensions rise between the two forces, Kawa kills Jameel with the axe. When Jasem finally begins to explain the mission, Kawa says he no longer needs to know. Friendly fire kills Youness and disfigures Kawa, and more men fall as the unit storms an ISIS camp, where Jasem is killed by a booby trap. Kawa rallies the shaken survivors, and Waleed leads them to an apartment, unlocks it with a hidden key and kills an ISIS fighter who has taken his wife and daughter. Kawa realizes the unit has been rescuing captured family members, and on learning that a comrade's son is nearby, he asks how far.

Shot in Marrakesh, the film premiered at the 2019 Venice Film Festival and was released on Netflix on November 26, 2020. It holds 84% on Rotten Tomatoes and 71 on Metacritic. After the film drew large audiences in Europe and the Middle East, cast members received death threats from people claiming ISIS ties.

overview: Trapped in their New York brownstone's panic room, a hidden chamber built as a sanctuary in the event of break-ins, newly divorced Meg Altman and her young daughter Sarah play a deadly game of cat-and-mouse with three intruders - Burnham, Raoul and Junior - during a brutal home invasion. But the room itself is the focal point because what the intruders really want is inside it.
title: Panic Room
plot:
Panic Room is a 2002 psychological thriller film directed by David Fincher, starring Jodie Foster and Kristen Stewart.

The movie revolves around the story of Meg Altman (Jodie Foster), a former CIA operative who has retired to suburban New York with her young daughter, Sarah (Kristen Stewart). The family's life takes a dramatic turn when two burglars, Burnham (Forest Whitaker) and Junior ( Jared Leto), break into their home. However, the situation escalates as it becomes clear that they are not ordinary thieves.

As the night unfolds, Meg must use her wits and resourcefulness to protect Sarah from the intruders while also confronting her own dark past and the traumas she has experienced. The film's plot is driven by a cat-and-mouse game between Meg and Burnham, with Sarah caught in the middle.

The main themes of Panic Room include:

1. **Motherhood and Protection**: The movie explores the intense bond between a mother and daughter, highlighting the lengths to which a parent will go to protect their child.
2. **Trauma and PTSD**: Meg's past experiences as a CIA operative are slowly revealed throughout the film, showcasing her struggles with trauma and PTSD.
3. **Domestic Violence**: Burnham's character serves as a symbol of domestic violence, highlighting the ways in which women can be trapped and vulnerable in their own homes.
4. **Female Empowerment**: Despite being confined to a small space, Meg finds ways to assert her authority and take control of the situation, demonstrating her strength and resilience.

Overall, Panic Room is a tense, suspenseful thriller that explores complex themes and relationships, making it a thought-provoking watch for audiences.

overview: London, England, April 2015. Brian Reader, a retired thief, gathers an unlikely gang of burglars to perpetrate the biggest and boldest heist in British history. The thieves assault the Hatton Garden Safe Deposit Company and escape with millions in goods and money. But soon the cracks between the gang members begin to appear when they discuss how to share the loot.
tagline: It's never too late to earn
title: King of Thieves
plot:
King of Thieves is a 2018 British heist comedy-drama film directed by James Marsh. The movie follows the story of Charlie Countryman, a small-time crook who gets caught up in a massive diamond heist.

The main theme of King of Thieves revolves around the idea of loyalty and friendship. Charlie's relationships with his friends and family are put to the test as he navigates the complexities of the heist and confronts his own personal demons. The film explores how these relationships can be both a source of strength and weakness, highlighting the blurred lines between right and wrong.

The movie also delves into the theme of redemption, as Charlie seeks to make amends for past mistakes and prove himself to those around him. Through his journey, he learns valuable lessons about trust, forgiveness, and the importance of human connection in a world that often values material wealth over personal relationships.

Furthermore, King of Thieves touches on the idea of identity and self-discovery. Charlie's struggles with his own sense of purpose and belonging serve as a catalyst for the events of the film, highlighting the tension between who we are and who we want to be. As he navigates the world of high-stakes crime, Charlie is forced to confront his own vulnerabilities and limitations, ultimately leading him down a path of self-discovery and growth.

Overall, King of Thieves presents a nuanced exploration of complex themes, weaving together elements of drama, comedy, and action to create a captivating narrative that lingers long after the credits roll.

overview: With John's social life at a standstill and his ex-wife about to get remarried, a down on his luck divorcée finally meets the woman of his dreams, only to discover she has another man in her life - her son. Before long, the two are locked in a battle of wits for the woman they both love-and it appears only one man can be left standing when it's over.
tagline: John met the woman of his dreams. Then he met her son...
title: Cyrus
plot:
Cyrus (2010) is a romantic comedy-drama film that explores the complexities of relationships and personal growth. The story revolves around John (played by John Cusack), a recently divorced man who seeks revenge on his ex-wife's new husband, Cyrus (played by Chris Evans). However, as John gets to know Cyrus, he begins to question his own motivations and the true nature of his feelings.

Through John's journey, the film delves into themes of identity, self-discovery, and the challenges of navigating modern relationships. The movie also touches on the idea of toxic masculinity and the societal expectations placed on men, particularly in regards to their roles as partners and providers.

As John forms a bond with Cyrus, he begins to confront his own emotional baggage and learn to let go of his past. This transformation is mirrored by Cyrus's own growth, as he struggles to reconcile his desire for independence with his need for human connection.

Ultimately, the film presents a nuanced exploration of the complexities of male relationships, highlighting the importance of vulnerability, empathy, and genuine communication in building meaningful connections with others.

overview: A team searching for a long-lost ship in the Arctic unwittingly unleash an alien creature that looks like it's made of ice.
title: Arctic Predator
plot:
Arctic Predator, released in the United States as Frost Giant, is a 2010 science fiction horror thriller made for television, directed by Víctor García from a screenplay by Rafael Jordan and produced by UFO Films and Arctic Productions. It stars Dean Cain, the former television Superman, as J.C., the dedicated leader of an expedition searching the Arctic for a lost ship, with Steven Waddington, Lucy Brown and Louisa Clein in supporting roles.

J.C. and his small team of explorers and scientists are hunting for the wreck of a 19th-century sailing ship that vanished in the ice near an Arctic island nearly two hundred years earlier. J.C.'s interest is personal: the ship was captained by one of his distant ancestors, and his own life comes to mirror that of his forefather. When the team finally locates the frozen vessel and begins carefully thawing its centuries-old artefacts, they unwittingly release something that has been entombed in the ice alongside it: an alien creature that appears to be made of ice itself.

Once free, the creature begins stalking the members of the expedition one by one at their isolated base, killing them to absorb the heat and energy it needs to recover its strength and return to where it came from, and leaving its victims frozen solid. As a violent storm cuts the survivors off, a desperate attempt to escape by helicopter ends when the injured pilot crashes, and the team is forced to improvise crude solutions, at one point cauterising a wound with a household iron. J.C. must find a way to stop the monster before it kills everyone and reaches the mainland.

The cast also includes Mike Johnson, Laia Gonzàlez, Iliana Lazarova, Mike Straub, Erbi Ago and Velizar Binev. Reviews were largely negative. Critics described it as a low-budget stalk-and-slay picture borrowing heavily from The Thing, with a creature reminiscent of the Predator; Dread Central found it blandly assembled and frequently tedious, while others criticised its cheap computer-generated effects, repetitive deaths and stock characters. The Exploding Helicopter blog nonetheless singled out the subplot linking the hero to the ship's captain as one genuinely good idea, and several reviewers felt Cain did what he could with weak material.

overview: Mirabelle is a disenchanted salesgirl and aspiring artist who sells gloves and accessories at a department store. She has two men in her life: wealthy divorcée Ray Porter and struggling musician Jeremy. Mirabelle falls in love with the glamorous Ray, and her life takes a magical turn, but eventually she realizes that she must empower herself and make a choice between them.
title: Shopgirl
plot:
Shopgirl is a 2005 American romantic comedy-drama film directed by Anand Tucker from a screenplay by Steve Martin, based on his 2000 novella. It follows a complicated love triangle between a disenchanted salesgirl, a wealthy older man and an aimless young man. Claire Danes stars as Mirabelle Buttersfield, Martin as Ray Porter and Jason Schwartzman as Jeremy, with Bridgette Wilson and Frances Conroy also in the cast.

Mirabelle, a young aspiring artist from Vermont, works behind the women's glove counter at Saks Fifth Avenue in Beverly Hills. Depressed and lonely, she finds herself courted by two very different men. Jeremy, a socially inept, penniless graphic designer and would-be typographer, meets her in a laundromat, but she loses interest after an awkward first date and a failed attempt at sex. Ray, a suave, wealthy and divorced older man, buys a pair of gloves from her and has them delivered to her apartment with a dinner invitation. After several dates they sleep together, and the next morning Ray explains that he does not want anything serious because he constantly travels between Los Angeles and Seattle, but she believes he wants to commit. As their affair continues, Jeremy leaves as a roadie for the band Hot Tears, where he discovers self-help tapes about relating to women. Ray lavishes Mirabelle with gifts and pays off her student loans rather than offering real affection, and when she stops taking her antidepressants, he takes her to a psychiatrist and cares for her. After Ray confesses to sleeping with a former girlfriend on a business trip, Mirabelle ends things, but she later accepts his apology and joins him in New York, where she feels lost at a lavish party. Back in Los Angeles, when Ray mentions that he is looking for a larger apartment in New York in case he meets someone and wants children, Mirabelle leaves him for good. She quits Saks to work as a receptionist at an art gallery, and Jeremy, now pursuing her properly, wins her love. At her own exhibition at the gallery, Ray apologizes and admits he did love her before she runs into Jeremy's arms.

Released by Buena Vista Pictures on October 21, 2005, Shopgirl grossed $11.7 million worldwide and received positive reviews, with critics singling out Danes. It was nominated for four Satellite Awards, including Best Picture – Musical or Comedy.

overview: Six actors portray six personas of music legend Bob Dylan in scenes depicting various stages of his life, chronicling his rise from unknown folksinger to international icon and revealing how Dylan constantly reinvented himself.
production_companies: Film & Entertainment VIP Medienfonds 4 GmbH & Co. KG (I)
tagline: All I Can Do Is Be Me Whoever That Is.
title: I'm Not There
plot:
I'm Not There is a 2007 film directed by Jim Jarmusch, not Endgame Entertainment.

The main theme of I'm Not There revolves around the life and legacy of Bob Dylan, but it's presented in an unconventional manner. The film tells the story through four different characters, each representing a distinct era of Dylan's life: a young man from Minnesota (played by Christian Bale), a folk singer from the 1960s (played by Calexico), a rock star from the 1970s (played by Scarlett Johansson), and a middle-aged man who is obsessed with Dylan (played by Casey Affleck).

Through these characters, the film explores themes of identity, creativity, and the search for meaning. Each character's storyline serves as a metaphor for Dylan's own journey, delving into his struggles with fame, artistic expression, and personal relationships.

The film also touches on the idea of how art can be both a reflection of one's life and a means to transcend it. The characters' experiences are intertwined, creating a sense of continuity and cohesion that underscores the notion that Dylan's music is not just a product of his individuality but also a representation of the collective human experience.

Ultimately, I'm Not There presents a complex and multifaceted exploration of creativity, identity, and the power of art to transcend time and circumstance.

overview: One of the most classic and revered stories of all time, Edgar Rice Burroughs' Tarzan returns to the big screen for a new generation. Tarzan and Jane face a mercenary army dispatched by the evil CEO of Greystoke Energies, a man who took over the company from Tarzan's parents, after they died in a plane crash in the African jungle.
tagline: The legend starts here
title: Tarzan
plot:
Tarzan is a 2013 English-language German animated action-adventure film written, directed and produced by Reinhard Klooss, based on the Tarzan stories by Edgar Rice Burroughs. Kellan Lutz voices John Greystoke Jr., the jungle-raised Tarzan, and Spencer Locke voices Jane Porter, with Trevor St. John as William Clayton, the scheming chief executive of Greystoke Energies and Les Bubb, Joe Cappelletti and Brian Huskey also in the cast.

In prehistoric times a meteor strikes the Earth and wipes out the dinosaurs. In the present, the industrialist John Greystoke funds an expedition to Uganda, aided by the scientist James Porter, to find the meteor and harness its energy. When the search fails, he leaves with his family, but over a semi-active volcano their helicopter's instruments go haywire and they land on the meteor. Taking a sample of its glowing rock, John sets off a reaction that awakens the volcano, and the helicopter crashes as they flee, leaving only the boy alive. The mountain gorilla Kala, who has just lost her own baby, adopts him, and he grows up among the animals under a name he invents, Tarzan. When Porter's daughter Jane is bitten by a viper during a safari, the young Tarzan carries her to shelter and cures her. Unsettled by contact with people, he leaves his gorilla family to live at the crash site. Years later, the apes' abusive leader Tublat accidentally activates the helicopter's emergency beacon, alerting Greystoke Energies, and Clayton persuades Jane, now a conservationist, to join him in Africa. Disgusted by his greed, Jane wanders into the jungle and finds the grown Tarzan. When Clayton discovers that the Greystoke heir is alive, he opens fire, and the couple flee into a valley where the meteor has mutated plants and animals into monsters. At the meteor Tarzan finds his father's pickaxe, and Jane realizes who he is. Tarzan returns to his troop, defeats and exiles Tublat, and he and Jane admit their love. Clayton turns Porter's camp into an armed base, Kala is shot protecting the couple, and Clayton rigs the meteor with explosives, but Tarzan rescues Jane and her father, summons his animal friends and escapes as the mountain collapses and Clayton and his men fall to their deaths.

Tarzan premiered in Russia on 17 October 2013 and was released in Germany by Constantin Film on 20 February 2014. Despite largely negative reviews, including a 20% Rotten Tomatoes rating, it grossed €44.1 million worldwide on a €25 million budget.

overview: A headstrong young girl in Afghanistan, ruled by the Taliban, disguises herself as a boy in order to provide for her family.
title: The Breadwinner
plot:
The Breadwinner is a powerful and poignant film that explores the complexities of war, family, and identity through the eyes of a young Afghan girl named Parvana.

At its core, The Breadwinner is a story about survival and resilience in the face of oppression. Set against the backdrop of Afghanistan's Taliban regime, the film follows Parvana as she navigates a world where women are forbidden from working or receiving an education. Despite these restrictions, Parvana finds ways to support her family and maintain her own sense of self-worth.

One of the main themes of The Breadwinner is the struggle for female empowerment in a patriarchal society. Through Parvana's experiences, the film highlights the ways in which women are marginalized and silenced, but also shows the strength and resourcefulness that can be found within them. The character of Parvana herself is a powerful symbol of this theme, as she finds creative ways to assert her independence and challenge the societal norms that seek to constrain her.

The Breadwinner also explores the complexities of family relationships and the sacrifices that must be made for love and survival. Parvana's father, who is forced to disguise himself as a woman in order to support his family, is a particularly poignant example of this theme. His actions are motivated by a desire to protect his daughters and provide for them, even if it means putting himself at risk.

Finally, the film touches on the theme of identity and cultural heritage. Parvana's experiences as an Afghan girl living under Taliban rule serve as a powerful reminder of the importance of preserving one's cultural traditions and values in the face of oppression. Through her story, the film shows how even in the darkest of times, there is always hope for a brighter future.

Overall, The Breadwinner is a moving and thought-provoking film that explores some of the most pressing issues of our time. Its powerful themes and compelling characters make it a must-see for anyone interested in stories about resilience, identity, and the human spirit.

original_title: 劇場版 BLEACH The DiamondDust Rebellion もう一つの氷輪丸
overview: When an artifact known as the "King's Seal" is stolen during transport from Soul Society, Hitsugaya Toushirou is assigned to retrieve it. Toushirou goes missing after a battle with the thieves, leading Seireitei to suspect him of treachery. They order his immediate capture and execution. Unwilling to believe him capable of such a crime, Ichigo, Rangiku, Rukia, and Renji set out to find Toushirou.
title: Bleach the Movie: The DiamondDust Rebellion
plot:
Bleach the Movie: The DiamondDust Rebellion is a Japanese animated science fantasy film based on the popular manga and anime series Bleach, created by Tite Kubo. The movie was produced by Pierrot and directed by Noriyuki Abe.

The story begins with Ichigo Kurosaki, a high school student who has the ability to see ghosts. He lives in Karakura Town, where spirits from the afterlife are drawn into the human world. One day, Ichigo meets Rukia Kuchiki, a Soul Reaper (a being tasked with guiding souls to the afterlife) who is injured by a Hollow (a malevolent spirit). To save her life, Ichigo absorbs the power of the Hollow's Reiatsu, allowing him to become a temporary Substitute Shinigami.

However, this act of substitution causes Ichigo to lose his powers as a Soul Reaper and gain the ability to see Hollows. Rukia is forced to return to the afterlife, leaving Ichigo to deal with the consequences of her injury. Meanwhile, a mysterious entity known as the "Hollows' King" begins to wreak havoc on Karakura Town, using its immense power to destroy everything in its path.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the Hollows' King is actually Sosuke Aizen, a former captain of the Gotei 13 (the Soul Reapers' organization) who has been manipulating events from behind the scenes. Aizen's true intentions are revealed: he seeks to gain control over the spiritual energy known as Reiatsu and use it to become invincible.

Ichigo, along with his friends Orihime Inoue, Yasutora "Chad" Sadoya, and Uryuu Ishida, sets out on a perilous journey to stop Aizen and save Karakura Town. Along the way, they encounter various allies and enemies, including other Soul Reapers and Hollows.

As the battle between Ichigo's group and Aizen's forces intensifies, it becomes clear that the fate of Karakura Town hangs in the balance. In a climactic showdown, Ichigo faces off against Aizen, using his unique abilities to try and defeat him. However, Aizen proves to be a formidable opponent, and the two engage in an epic battle.

In the end, Ichigo emerges victorious, but not without great cost. The movie concludes with Ichigo reflecting on the lessons he has learned and the sacrifices he has made to protect his friends and town. The DiamondDust Rebellion serves as a pivotal moment in the Bleach series, setting the stage for future story arcs and character developments.

Overall, Bleach the Movie: The DiamondDust Rebellion is an action-packed and emotionally charged film that explores themes of friendship, sacrifice, and the struggle between good and evil.

overview: Somewhere in the Balkans, 1995. A team of aid workers must solve an apparently simple problem in an almost completely pacified territory that has been devastated by a cruel war, but some of the local inhabitants, the retreating combatants, the UN forces, many cows and an absurd bureaucracy will not cease to put obstacles in their way.
title: A Perfect Day
plot:
A Perfect Day is a 2015 Spanish drama film directed by Fernando Franco. The movie revolves around a young boy named Juan who embarks on a journey to find his father, who has abandoned him and his mother.

The main theme of A Perfect Day is the struggle for survival and the resilience of the human spirit in the face of adversity. The story highlights the harsh realities of poverty and the difficulties faced by those living on the streets. Through Juan's journey, the film sheds light on the struggles of a young boy trying to find his place in the world.

The movie also explores themes of family, love, and redemption. Juan's quest for his father is motivated by a desire to understand why he was abandoned and to find closure. Along the way, he meets various characters who teach him valuable lessons about life, including the importance of human connection and the power of kindness.

One of the striking aspects of A Perfect Day is its portrayal of the complexities of human relationships. The film shows how people from different walks of life can come together in times of need, forming unexpected bonds that transcend social boundaries. Through these interactions, Juan learns about the value of empathy, compassion, and understanding.

Overall, A Perfect Day is a powerful and poignant film that explores the human condition with sensitivity and nuance. It offers a thought-provoking commentary on the struggles faced by marginalized communities and serves as a testament to the resilience of the human spirit in the face of adversity.

overview: Two childhood sweethearts, now both widowed, share a night by a lake in the mountains.
title: A Love Song
plot:
A Love Song is a 2022 American drama written, directed, produced and co-edited by Max Walker-Silverman in his feature directorial debut. Dale Dickey and Wes Studi star as two childhood friends who reunite for a night beside a lake in the mountains, with Michelle Wilson, Benja K. Thomas and John Way in supporting roles.

Faye, a lonely widow, waits at a lakeside campsite in the Colorado mountains for Lito, a childhood friend she has not seen in many years. Unsure when he will arrive or even what he looks like now, she passes the time watching birds and stars and meeting her neighbors. A polite group of siblings is waiting for her to move so they can dig up their father's coffin and rebury him elsewhere, and an engaged lesbian couple invites her to dinner, where one of the women, Jan, nervously asks whether marriage is worthwhile.

When Lito finally arrives, the two spend the day sharing memories, playing music and remembering their late spouses. He takes her photograph, which embarrasses Faye, who would prefer that he remember her as she was when young. That night, after admitting how much they miss their partners and bonding over their grief, they sleep together. In the morning Lito sets out to pick flowers for Faye but is overcome with emotion, and when she comes out to greet him he awkwardly thanks her for the invitation and confesses that he cannot begin a romance with her. Hurt but understanding, Faye helps him on his way. She then hikes alone through the landscape and watches the stars, slowly coming to terms with her feelings and disappointment. The next morning she visits Jan and urges her to marry and enjoy her life, then drives away from the campsite as the siblings begin digging up their father's coffin.

The film premiered at the Sundance Film Festival on January 20, 2022, and also screened at the Berlin International Film Festival and the Tribeca Film Festival. Bleecker Street and Stage 6 Films acquired worldwide distribution rights and released it in the United States on July 29, 2022. Critics praised the film, giving it 95% on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus called it a brilliant and too-rare showcase for its veteran leads that tells a small, stirring tale with quiet grace, and a Metacritic score of 78. The National Board of Review named it one of the top ten independent films of 2022, and it received two nominations at the 38th Independent Spirit Awards.

overview: The Flash finds himself in a war-torn alternate timeline and teams up with alternate versions of his fellow heroes to restore the timeline.
tagline: Fight the future.
title: Justice League: The Flashpoint Paradox
plot:
Justice League: The Flashpoint Paradox is a 2013 animated superhero film produced by Warner Bros. Animation, based on the DC Comics storyline "The Flash of Two Worlds" and "Flashpoint". The movie takes place in an alternate universe where Barry Allen, aka The Flash (Ezra Miller), has become a crime lord in Central City.

In this reality, Barry's life took a dark turn after his mother, Nora Allen, was murdered by a man named Reverse-Flash (Tom Cavanagh). This event led to Barry becoming obsessed with stopping the villain and eventually discovering he had superhuman speed. However, instead of using his powers for good, Barry became a ruthless crime lord who terrorized Central City.

The story begins with Barry's life as a crime lord, where he is feared by everyone in the city. Meanwhile, in the Justice League headquarters, Superman (James Arnold Taylor) and Batman (Kevin Conroy) are discussing the threat of Darkseid, an intergalactic warlord who seeks to conquer Earth. However, their conversation is interrupted by the arrival of Barry Allen, who has come to join the Justice League.

Upon meeting the team, Barry's presence causes a rift in the timeline, creating a new reality where Superman and Batman are not present. In this reality, Darkseid has taken over Central City, and Barry must navigate his way through the city to stop him.

As Barry navigates this new world, he meets a young version of himself (Ezra Miller) who is struggling to control his powers. The two Barrys form an alliance to take down Darkseid's army and ultimately face off against the villain himself.

Throughout the movie, the Flashpoint Paradox storyline unfolds, revealing that Barry's actions in this reality have created a catastrophic timeline where Superman and Batman are not present. The team must work together to find a way to restore the original timeline and bring balance back to the universe.

In the climactic final battle, Barry and his allies face off against Darkseid's army, while also dealing with the consequences of their actions in this reality. Ultimately, they succeed in defeating Darkseid and restoring the original timeline.

The movie concludes with Barry returning to his own reality, where he is reunited with his mother's spirit (voiced by Kari Wahlgren). The film ends on a hopeful note, as Barry reflects on the lessons he learned from his journey through Flashpoint Paradox.

overview: A seemingly perfect romance turns dark when a mother becomes convinced her daughter’s new boyfriend has a sinister connection to her own past.
tagline: Trust your mother's instincts.
title: Evil Eye
plot:
Evil Eye is a 2020 American psychological thriller film directed by David E. Talbert and written by David E. Talbert and Nia DaCosta. The movie stars Saniyya Sidney, Michelle Buteau, and Otmara Sanchez.

The main themes of Evil Eye revolve around the destructive power of jealousy, obsession, and the blurred lines between reality and paranoia. The story follows a young woman named Nina (played by Saniyya Sidney), who becomes increasingly obsessed with her friend's new relationship, fueled by her own insecurities and feelings of inadequacy.

As the plot unfolds, it becomes clear that Nina's perception of reality is distorted by her own jealousy, leading to a downward spiral of paranoia and violence. The film explores how these toxic emotions can consume individuals, causing them to lash out at those around them in destructive ways.

Throughout the movie, the theme of female friendship and loyalty is also explored, highlighting the complexities and nuances of relationships between women. The film raises questions about the societal pressures that women face, particularly in terms of their relationships with each other, and how these pressures can lead to feelings of resentment and jealousy.

The ending of the movie is intentionally ambiguous, leaving the audience to ponder the true nature of reality and Nina's state of mind. This ambiguity adds to the overall sense of unease and tension, emphasizing the film's themes of obsession, paranoia, and the destructive power of unchecked emotions.

Overall, Evil Eye is a thought-provoking thriller that explores the darker aspects of human psychology, making it a compelling watch for fans of psychological suspense.

original_title: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
overview: The evil Darth Sidious enacts his final plan for unlimited power -- and the heroic Jedi Anakin Skywalker must choose a side.
tagline: The saga is complete.
title: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
plot:
Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith is a 2005 epic space opera film directed by George Lucas, written by George Lucas, and produced by Lucasfilm Ltd.

The film takes place three years after the events of Attack of the Clones (Episode II). The galaxy is on the brink of war as the Galactic Republic and the separatist droid army clash. Chancellor Palpatine, who has been manipulating events from behind the scenes, senses an opportunity to gain more power and control.

The story begins with Anakin Skywalker, a young Jedi Knight, feeling increasingly disillusioned with the Jedi Order. He is haunted by premonitions of his loved ones' deaths and feels underappreciated by the Jedi Council. Chancellor Palpatine, who has been secretly manipulating Anakin's fears and tempting him with the promise of saving Padmé Amidala's life, begins to play on Anakin's insecurities.

As the Clone Wars rage on, Anakin becomes more and more swayed by Palpatine's promises. He begins to question the Jedi Code and his loyalty to the Order. Meanwhile, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin's mentor, is tasked with leading a mission to rescue Chancellor Palpatine from the planet of Naboo.

However, it is revealed that Palpatine has actually been kidnapped by the separatists, and Obi-Wan and Anakin must work together to rescue him. During the mission, Anakin and Obi-Wan engage in a fierce lightsaber duel with the Separatist leader, General Grievous. In the heat of battle, Anakin is forced to confront his own fears and doubts.

As the Clone Wars come to an end, Palpatine declares himself Emperor and orders the execution of Order 66, a secret order that will lead to the near-destruction of the Jedi Order. Anakin, now fully under Palpatine's control, pledges his allegiance to the Emperor and turns against his former friends.

The film culminates in an epic battle between the Republic forces and the Separatist droid army on the planet of Coruscant. Obi-Wan Kenobi, who has become increasingly disillusioned with Anakin's betrayal, engages in a fierce duel with Anakin, now Darth Vader.

In the end, Anakin is mortally wounded by Obi-Wan, but not before he reveals his true identity as Darth Vader to his former mentor. As Anakin lies dying, he sees visions of his loved ones and finally finds peace. The film ends with Obi-Wan, now a fugitive, watching over the infant Luke Skywalker, who will one day become a powerful Jedi Knight.

Throughout the film, George Lucas explores themes of fear, temptation, and the corrupting influence of power. Anakin's fall to the dark side is a tragic reminder that even the most well-intentioned individuals can be swayed by their own fears and doubts. The film sets the stage for the original Star Wars trilogy, which follows the adventures of Luke Skywalker as he confronts his father, Darth Vader, and ultimately redeems him.

Overall, Revenge of the Sith is a gripping and emotionally charged film that explores the complexities of human nature and the dangers of unchecked power.

overview: In a kingdom ruled by a young and unpredictable king, the military commander has a secret weapon: a shadow, a look-alike who can fool both his enemies and the King himself. Now he must use this weapon in an intricate plan that will lead his people to victory in a war that the King does not want.
tagline: The Battlefield in Ink.
title: Shadow
plot:
Shadow (Chinese: Yǐng) is a 2018 wuxia film directed by Zhang Yimou and starring Deng Chao, Sun Li, Zheng Kai, Wang Qianyuan, Hu Jun, Wang Jingchun, Guan Xiaotong and Leo Wu. A Chinese-Hong Kong co-production, it is adapted from Zhu Sujin's play Jingzhou of the Three Kingdoms and set in a fictional historical era.

Years earlier, the Kingdom of Pei lost the strategic city of Jing to the Kingdom of Yan when its commander, Ziyu, was defeated in a duel by the Yan general Yang Cang. Pei's king, Pei Liang, is furious that Ziyu has challenged Yang Cang to a rematch without permission, and to keep the peace he arranges for his sister, Qingping, to marry Yang Cang's son, Yang Ping. The Ziyu at court, however, is a double named Jingzhou, secretly trained as a "shadow" by Ziyu's family because of his uncanny resemblance; the real Ziyu, gravely wounded in the duel, hides in secret, known only to his wife, Xiaoai, and promises Jingzhou his freedom once Jing is retaken. The king demotes "Ziyu" to commoner, and when Yan offers to take Qingping only as a concubine, he accepts, prompting General Tian Zhan to resign in protest.

Jingzhou trains with a metal umbrella against Ziyu, who imitates Yang Cang's guandao, until Xiaoai shows him a yielding, feminine technique to counter Yang's forceful style. Ziyu reveals the plan to Tian Zhan: while Jingzhou keeps Yang Cang occupied in a duel, Tian and a hundred convicts will seize Jing. On the night before, Xiaoai sleeps with Jingzhou as Ziyu watches in secret. The convicts, joined by the stowaway Qingping, attack with umbrella weapons. Qingping is mortally wounded by Yang Ping but kills him, and Jingzhou kills Yang Cang with a snapping umbrella blade. Returning home, Jingzhou finds his mother dead and is saved from assassins by the king's emissary. At the victory feast, the king reveals that he knows Jingzhou's secret and wants him to replace Ziyu entirely, but Ziyu, disguised as an assassin, stabs the king and orders Jingzhou to finish him. When Ziyu turns on him, Jingzhou mortally wounds Ziyu, kills the king and frames Ziyu for the murder, declaring himself the assassin's slayer. Tian does not object, and Xiaoai watches, torn over whether to expose him.

Shadow screened at the Venice, Toronto and London film festivals in 2018 before wider international releases in 2019. Critics acclaimed its cinematography, design and choreography, giving it 94% on Rotten Tomatoes and 81 on Metacritic.

overview: William Tell just wants to play cards. His spartan existence on the casino trail is shattered when he is approached by Cirk, a vulnerable and angry young man seeking help to execute his plan for revenge on a military colonel. Tell sees a chance at redemption through his relationship with Cirk. But keeping Cirk on the straight-and-narrow proves impossible, dragging Tell back into the darkness of his past.
tagline: He's Playing the Hand He Was Dealt.
title: The Card Counter
plot:
The Card Counter is a 2021 American neo-noir thriller film written and directed by Paul Schrader. The movie stars Oscar Isaac, Willem Dafoe, and Tiffany Haddish.

The story follows the protagonist, Henry McCardel (Oscar Isaac), a professional gambler who suffers from PTSD after witnessing the murder of his family in a small town. He is haunted by the memories of that fateful night and struggles to form connections with others due to his emotional scars.

Henry's life takes a turn when he meets Catherine Clifton (Tiffany Haddish), a woman who claims to be a victim of a similar traumatic event. She convinces him to join her on a road trip, where they visit various towns and gamble at card tables. As they travel together, Henry begins to open up about his past, sharing the story of how he lost his family.

However, their journey is disrupted by the presence of LaGraine (Willem Dafoe), a ruthless and cunning gambler who seeks revenge against Henry for winning from him in a previous game. LaGraine's true intentions are shrouded in mystery, but it becomes clear that he has a personal vendetta against Henry.

As the story unfolds, Henry's past begins to catch up with him. He is forced to confront his demons and make amends with those who were wronged by him. The film builds towards a tense showdown between Henry and LaGraine, which ultimately leads to a dramatic confrontation that changes the course of their lives forever.

Throughout the movie, Schrader explores themes of trauma, guilt, and redemption. Henry's character is complex and multifaceted, struggling to find peace and forgiveness in a world that seems determined to hurt him. The film's use of long takes and atmospheric sound design adds to the overall sense of unease and tension, drawing the viewer into Henry's dark and troubled world.

The Card Counter received critical acclaim for its performances, direction, and writing. Oscar Isaac delivers a nuanced and emotionally charged performance as Henry McCardel, while Willem Dafoe brings his signature intensity to the role of LaGraine. The film's exploration of complex themes and moral ambiguity has been praised by critics, who have noted that it is both a gripping thriller and a thought-provoking drama.

Overall, The Card Counter is a gripping and unsettling film that explores the darker aspects of human nature. With its tense plot, atmospheric sound design, and outstanding performances, it is a must-see for fans of neo-noir thrillers and those who appreciate complex, thought-provoking cinema.

overview: In the aftermath of a family tragedy, an aspiring author is torn between love for her childhood friend and the temptation of a mysterious outsider. Trying to escape the ghosts of her past, she is swept away to a house that breathes, bleeds… and remembers.
tagline: Love makes monsters of us all.
title: Crimson Peak
plot:
Crimson Peak is a 2015 American gothic romance horror film directed by Guillermo del Toro and written by del Toro and Matthew Robbins. The film stars Mia Wasikowska, Tom Hiddleston, and Jessica Chastain.

The story begins with Edith Cushing (Mia Wasikowska), a young writer who is struggling to find inspiration for her next novel. She receives a letter from her distant relative, Thomas Sharpe (Tom Hiddleston), inviting her to visit his family's estate in the English countryside. The letter is accompanied by a photograph of Thomas' wife, Lucille (Jessica Chastain), which Edith finds unsettling.

Edith travels to the estate, where she meets Thomas and his sister, Jessica (Mia Wasikowska's real-life twin). As Edith settles into her new surroundings, she begins to notice strange occurrences and an eerie atmosphere surrounding the house. She also becomes increasingly fascinated with Lucille, who seems to be hiding secrets.

As the story unfolds, it is revealed that Thomas has been hiding a dark family secret: his wife Lucille was involved in a tragic accident that left her severely injured, and she has since become obsessed with death and the supernatural. Edith soon discovers that Lucille's obsession has led to a series of gruesome events, including the murder of several people who have visited the estate.

As Edith delves deeper into the mystery, she becomes trapped in a web of horror and suspense. She begins to experience strange visions and nightmares, which seem to be connected to Lucille's dark past. Thomas, who is increasingly distant and controlling, seems to be hiding secrets of his own.

The plot thickens as Edith uncovers a dark family history that involves human sacrifice, occult rituals, and supernatural forces. The house itself becomes a character in the story, with its labyrinthine corridors and hidden rooms seeming to shift and change like a living entity.

As the story reaches its climax, Edith must confront Lucille's dark past and the evil forces that have taken over the estate. In a shocking twist, it is revealed that Thomas has been using his wife's condition to lure victims to the house, where they are brutally murdered.

In the end, Edith manages to escape the house with the help of Jessica, who has been hiding her own secrets. The film ends on a haunting note, with Edith reflecting on the trauma she has experienced and the darkness that lurks within the human heart.

Overall, Crimson Peak is a visually stunning and atmospheric horror film that explores themes of love, obsession, and the supernatural. With its intricate plot and complex characters, it is a must-see for fans of gothic horror and suspense.

overview: MORTAL KOMBAT: REBIRTH is a short film released by Kevin Tancharoen (Director) in 2010. It was originally made as a proof of concept for Tancharoen's pitch to Warner Brothers for a reboot movie franchise. This 8-minute short features an intricate fight scene choreographed by Larnell Stovall. It also reintroduces classic Mortal Kombat characters, including: Jax (Michael Jai White), Sonya Blade (Jeri Ryan), Johnny Cage (Matt Mullins), Scorpion (Ian Anthony Dale), Baraka (Lateef Crowder) and Shang Tsung (James Lew).
title: Mortal Kombat: Rebirth
plot:
Mortal Kombat: Rebirth is an action-adventure film that serves as a reboot to the Mortal Kombat franchise. The movie delves into the world of martial arts and fantasy, where characters with extraordinary abilities engage in mortal combat.

At its core, Mortal Kombat: Rebirth explores the theme of revenge and redemption. The protagonist, Jax, is driven by his quest for vengeance against those who wronged him, while also seeking to atone for past mistakes. This internal conflict serves as a catalyst for his journey, as he navigates the treacherous world of Mortal Kombat.

The film also touches on the idea of identity and self-discovery. Jax's character arc is marked by his struggle to come to terms with his past and find his place in the world. This theme is echoed in the relationships between other characters, such as Sonya Blade, who grapples with her own sense of purpose and loyalty.

Furthermore, Mortal Kombat: Rebirth features a rich tapestry of mythology and symbolism, drawing inspiration from various cultures and traditions. The film's use of martial arts and fantasy elements serves to blur the lines between reality and myth, creating a sense of wonder and awe in the viewer.

Overall, Mortal Kombat: Rebirth is a thrilling and action-packed ride that explores complex themes and ideas through its engaging characters and storylines.

original_title: ドラゴンボール超 スーパーヒーロー
overview: The Red Ribbon Army, an evil organization that was once destroyed by Goku in the past, has been reformed by a group of people who have created new and mightier Androids, Gamma 1 and Gamma 2, and seek vengeance against Goku and his family.
tagline: A super awakening and calamity is born.
title: Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero
plot:
Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero is a 2022 Japanese animated martial arts fantasy adventure film and the sequel to Dragon Ball Super: Broly (2018). The twenty-first animated feature in the Dragon Ball franchise, it was the first to be produced mainly in CGI and the last Dragon Ball film made under the supervision of creator Akira Toriyama before his death in March 2024; Toriyama supplied the concept and character designs. Its Japanese voice cast includes Masako Nozawa, Toshio Furukawa, Yuko Minaguchi, Hiroshi Kamiya and Mamoru Miyano.

Commander Magenta, head of Red Pharmaceuticals, plans to revive the Red Ribbon Army, once led by his late father, Commander Red, before Goku destroyed it more than three decades earlier. With his assistant Carmine, he recruits Dr. Hedo, the superhero-obsessed grandson of Dr. Gero, a convicted grave robber, by convincing him that Bulma's Capsule Corporation is an evil organization bent on world domination. While Goku, Vegeta and Broly train on Beerus's planet, Piccolo, frustrated that Gohan is neglecting his potential, is attacked by the android Gamma 2 and follows him back to the Red Ribbon base. He learns that Hedo has built the androids Gamma 1 and Gamma 2 to defeat Capsule Corporation and has reluctantly used his grandfather's designs to create an improved Cell, known as Cell Max. Unable to reach Goku and Vegeta, Piccolo has the dragon Shenron unlock his full potential. Learning that Magenta plans to kidnap Gohan's daughter Pan to lure him into a trap, Piccolo volunteers to carry out the abduction himself and has Pan play along. Enraged, Gohan storms the base and overpowers Gamma 1 in his "Ultimate" form, while Piccolo unleashes a powerful new transformation against Gamma 2 and convinces him that Magenta has lied about Capsule Corporation. Turning against the Red Ribbon Army, the Gammas side with the heroes, but Magenta unleashes Cell Max, a giant, rampaging monster. Reinforced by Goten, Trunks, Android 18 and Krillin, the heroes fight back; Gamma 2 sacrifices himself in a failed attempt to destroy it, and after Piccolo is beaten, Gohan awakens a new "Beast" form and kills Cell Max with a Special Beam Cannon. Bulma then offers a repentant Hedo and Gamma 1 jobs at Capsule Corporation.

Delayed by a cyberattack at Toei Animation, the film was released in Japan on June 11, 2022, and internationally that August. It received positive reviews and grossed about US$102.5 million worldwide, the second-highest for a Dragon Ball film.

original_title: ワンピース ~ハートオブ ゴールド~
overview: A girl named Olga is pursued by both the World Government and a man named Mad Treasure, as she is the only one who knows the location of the Pure Gold, a substance that can buy the entire world. Olga ends up sailing with the Straw Hat Pirates, and they journey to find the Pure Gold on the lost island of Alchemi, which is located inside the stomach of a large angler fish named Bonbori.
title: One Piece: Heart of Gold
plot:
One Piece: Heart of Gold is an animated film that serves as a prequel to the popular anime series One Piece. The movie delves into the backstory of Monkey D. Luffy, the main protagonist, and his early adventures with his mentor, Shanks.

At its core, One Piece: Heart of Gold explores themes of friendship, camaraderie, and the power of human connection. The film showcases the strong bond between Luffy and his crew members as they navigate the high seas and face various challenges together. This emphasis on relationships highlights the importance of having people who believe in you and support you through thick and thin.

The movie also touches on the theme of ambition and the drive to become a great pirate. Luffy's unwavering determination to find One Piece, the legendary treasure left behind by the Pirate King Gol D. Roger, serves as a catalyst for his growth and self-discovery. Through his adventures, Luffy learns valuable lessons about perseverance, courage, and the true meaning of being a pirate.

Furthermore, One Piece: Heart of Gold features a narrative that celebrates the beauty of freedom and the open sea. The film's stunning animation and vibrant characters bring to life the sense of adventure and possibility that defines the world of One Piece. By exploring these themes, the movie provides an engaging and entertaining experience for audiences while also offering insights into the richly detailed universe created by Eiichiro Oda.

Overall, One Piece: Heart of Gold is a heartwarming and action-packed film that delves into the complexities of human relationships, ambition, and the pursuit of one's dreams.

overview: A group of rambunctious toddlers travel a trip to Paris. As they journey from the Eiffel Tower to Notre Dame, they learn new lessons about trust, loyalty and love.
tagline: France never had a chance!
title: Rugrats in Paris: The Movie
plot:
Rugrats in Paris: The Movie is a heartwarming and visually stunning film that explores the universal themes of family, love, and self-discovery. At its core, the movie is about the adventures of Tommy Pickles and his friends as they navigate the complexities of growing up and finding their place in the world.

One of the main themes of the movie is the power of imagination and creativity. The Rugrats' fantastical journey to Paris is a metaphor for the boundless possibilities that exist within each child's mind, and how these imaginative worlds can serve as a refuge from the challenges of everyday life.

The film also delves into the theme of family and relationships. Tommy's desire to reunite with his estranged father, Stu Pickles, serves as a catalyst for the adventure, highlighting the complexities of family dynamics and the importance of forgiveness and understanding. Through the characters' experiences, the movie shows that even in the midst of disagreement and conflict, love and connection can ultimately prevail.

Furthermore, Rugrats in Paris: The Movie touches on the theme of growing up and letting go. As the Rugrats navigate their way through the City of Light, they must confront the reality of leaving childhood behind and embracing adulthood. This is a universal struggle that many children (and adults!) face, and the movie offers a poignant exploration of this transition.

Overall, Rugrats in Paris: The Movie is a charming and entertaining film that explores timeless themes with wit, humor, and heart.

overview: A heroic tale of three blood brothers and their struggle in the midst of war and political upheaval. It is based on "The Assassination of Ma," a Qing Dynasty (1644-1911) story about the killing of general Ma Xinyi.
production_companies: Beijing Jinyinma Movie & TV Culture Co.
title: The Warlords
plot:
The Warlords, originally titled The Blood Brothers, is a 2007 epic historical action film directed and co-produced by Peter Chan, starring Jet Li, Andy Lau, Takeshi Kaneshiro and Xu Jinglei. A Hong Kong-Chinese co-production set during the Taiping Rebellion in the 1860s, it centers on the sworn brotherhood of three men. Chan said it was influenced by, though not a remake of, Chang Cheh's 1973 film The Blood Brothers, and that he had long wanted to make a film about male bonds after seeing John Woo's A Better Tomorrow. Filming began in December 2006 in Beijing and also took place in Shanghai and at Hengdian World Studios.

Pang Qingyun, commander of an imperial battalion, is the sole survivor of a battle with rebel forces. He befriends Zhao Erhu and Jiang Wuyang, leaders of a bandit gang in a poor, starving village, and secretly begins an affair with Liansheng, Zhao's wife. When imperial troops seize the food the bandits have stolen, Pang persuades them to become a militia in the emperor's service, and the three swear a blood oath of brotherhood on pain of death. The militia wins a series of victories, but jealous superiors starve Pang of supplies, and his attack on rebel-held Suzhou becomes a long siege.

Zhao slips into Suzhou and makes a deal with the rebel commander, who lets Zhao kill him in exchange for a promise that the surrendering rebels will be spared. Lacking food for prisoners, Pang breaks the promise, chains Zhao and has Jiang oversee the massacre, then convinces Zhao that the killing was needed to end the war. After the fall of Nanjing, Pang is made a viceroy, but he and Zhao drift apart, and fearing that Zhao is beyond his control, Pang reluctantly plots his death. Jiang tries to stop him, discovers the affair and kills Liansheng, while Zhao is lured into a trap and murdered without knowing who betrayed him. Learning the truth, Jiang attacks Pang, who is shot by a sniper sent by his political rivals and allows Jiang to deliver the final blow. Jiang is later made a scapegoat and executed.

Li plays Pang, Lau plays Zhao, Kaneshiro plays Jiang and Xu plays Liansheng. Released across most of Asia on 13 December 2007, it won the Hong Kong Film Award for Best Film and the Golden Horse Award for Best Feature Film, and Li won Best Actor at the Hong Kong Film Awards. Li's fee made him the highest-paid actor in a Chinese-language film, and the film holds 65% approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: A Semester at Sea ship is attacked and sunk by a mutated two-headed shark, and the survivors seek refuge on a deserted atoll. The coeds, however, are no longer safe when the atoll starts flooding.
tagline: 1 Body, 2 Heads and 6,000 Teeth
title: 2-Headed Shark Attack
plot:
"2-Headed Shark Attack" is a campy, over-the-top horror-comedy that explores the theme of survival in the face of absurd and terrifying circumstances. The movie takes a satirical approach to the shark attack genre, exaggerating the dangers posed by a genetically mutated two-headed shark.

At its core, the film is about human resilience and the will to survive against all odds. The protagonist, Jill (played by Darlene Vogel), finds herself in a desperate fight for her life as she navigates the treacherous waters of the ocean. As the two-headed shark closes in, Jill must use her wits and resourcefulness to outsmart the beast and stay alive.

The movie also touches on themes of paranoia and the breakdown of social order in the face of chaos. As the shark attack escalates, the characters' behavior becomes increasingly erratic, revealing deeper psychological flaws and fears. This descent into madness serves as a commentary on how quickly society can unravel when faced with an existential threat.

Furthermore, "2-Headed Shark Attack" can be seen as a tongue-in-cheek critique of modern society's obsession with sensationalized media and the 24-hour news cycle. The film's absurdity and over-the-top plot twists serve as a commentary on how easily we can become desensitized to the horrors of the world around us.

Overall, "2-Headed Shark Attack" is a lighthearted, entertaining horror-comedy that uses its absurd premise to explore themes of survival, paranoia, and the human condition.

overview: A young and devoted morning television producer is hired as an executive producer on a  long-running morning show at a once-prominent but currently failing station in New York City. Eager to keep the show on air, she recruits a former news journalist and anchor who disapproves of co-hosting a show that does not deal with real news stories.
tagline: Breakfast TV just got interesting.
title: Morning Glory
plot:
Morning Glory is a 2010 American comedy-drama film that explores the cutthroat world of television news. The movie delves into the theme of ambition and the lengths to which people will go to achieve success in their careers.

At its core, Morning Glory is a story about the pursuit of power and control, as embodied by the character of Becky Fuller (played by Rachel McAdams), a driven and ambitious young executive who will stop at nothing to become the top news anchor. As she navigates the treacherous waters of television news, Becky must confront her own demons and learn to balance her ambition with her personal relationships.

The film also explores the theme of identity and how it is shaped by our professional lives. Becky's character is a prime example of this, as she struggles to reconcile her on-air persona with her true self. Through Becky's journey, the movie raises questions about the nature of authenticity in the public eye and the tension between personal and professional identities.

Furthermore, Morning Glory touches on the theme of female empowerment and the challenges faced by women in male-dominated industries. The film features a strong ensemble cast, including Meryl Streep as Patty Hewes, a veteran news anchor who becomes Becky's mentor and confidante. Through their complex and often fraught relationship, the movie explores the ways in which women can support and empower each other in the pursuit of their goals.

Overall, Morning Glory is a nuanced and engaging film that offers a thoughtful exploration of the themes that drive us to succeed in our careers and personal lives.

overview: After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic incident involving a patient, Dr. Rose Cotter starts experiencing frightening occurrences that she can't explain.
