Facing hospitalization, Telly runs away and seeks out her neighbor Ash, whose daughter Lauren, Sam's friend, died in the same crash. Ash insists he never had a child and calls the police, but after looking at drawings Telly finds hidden under the wallpaper he begins to remember Lauren, and the two go on the run, chased by NSA agents.

They capture an agent, who admits the government is only helping "them" to protect humanity, before the roof of the house is torn off and he is pulled into the sky. Pope, who comes to believe Telly, shoots a stranger who has been tailing them, only to see his wounds heal, and she too is taken. Soon Ash is snatched as well. Munce finally admits that unseen beings are responsible and that the government, powerless to stop them, merely observes their experiments. At a derelict hangar at the airport he brings Telly to one of them, who explains that she is part of an experiment testing whether the bond between mother and child can be broken, and that her memories have resisted erasure. He makes her recall her first memory of Sam, his birth, and erases it, but Telly reaches back further, to the time she was pregnant, and recovers everything. Having failed, the experimenter is himself hurled into the sky, ending the test. Telly finds herself living a normal life with Sam; in a park she meets Ash, who has his daughter back but no memory of their ordeal, and reintroduces herself.

Shot mainly in New York, the $42 million film opened at number one in the United States and earned about $117.5 million worldwide. Reviews were mixed to negative, with Rotten Tomatoes' consensus calling the premise too ridiculous to take seriously.

overview: In the year Universal Century 0079, humans have colonized the area of space lying in between the Earth and the moon. However the ambitious Zabi family, rulers of the Duchy of Zeon (the grouping of colonies furthest from the earth) has sparked a war.
title: Mobile Suit Gundam I
plot:
Mobile Suit Gundam I, produced by Sunrise, is a seminal work that explores several profound themes that were groundbreaking for its time. At its core, the series delves into the human condition, particularly in the context of war and conflict.

One of the primary themes is the psychological toll of war on individuals, as embodied by the protagonist Amuro Ray. The series masterfully portrays the emotional struggles of a young soldier who finds himself thrust into a brutal and unforgiving world, where the lines between right and wrong are constantly blurred. As Amuro navigates this treacherous landscape, he grapples with the moral implications of his actions and the weight of responsibility that comes with wielding immense power.

The series also explores the concept of identity and self-discovery, as Amuro and other characters confront their own strengths, weaknesses, and motivations. This theme is particularly evident in the character development of Char Aznable, a complex and enigmatic figure whose past and present are shrouded in mystery. Through his interactions with Amuro and other characters, Char's true nature is slowly revealed, exposing the depths of human emotion and the capacity for both good and evil.

Furthermore, Mobile Suit Gundam I examines the consequences of technological advancement and the ethics surrounding its use. The series highlights the devastating effects of war on civilians and the environment, as well as the moral dilemmas that arise when powerful technologies are employed in conflict. This theme is particularly relevant today, as we continue to grapple with the implications of emerging technologies like artificial intelligence and drones.

Lastly, the series touches upon the idea of leadership and the burden of responsibility that comes with it. Amuro's character arc is deeply tied to his growth into a leader, as he navigates the complexities of command and confronts the consequences of his decisions. This theme is echoed in the character of Bright Noa, who serves as a mentor and foil to Amuro, highlighting the importance of empathy, compassion, and selflessness in leadership.

Overall, Mobile Suit Gundam I is a thought-provoking series that explores the complexities of human nature, the consequences of technological advancement, and the weight of responsibility that comes with power. Its themes continue to resonate with audiences today, making it a timeless classic in the world of science fiction.

overview: After being threatened during a confession, a good-natured priest must battle the dark forces closing in around him.
tagline: Killing a priest on a Sunday. That’ll be a good one.
title: Calvary
plot:
Calvary is a 2014 Irish dark comedy-drama film that explores the complexities of faith, morality, and human relationships. The movie delves into the life of Father James Lavelle, a Catholic priest played by Brendan Gleeson, who is struggling to maintain his spiritual integrity in the face of societal expectations.

At its core, Calvary is a thought-provoking exploration of the human condition, tackling themes of identity, community, and the search for meaning. The film masterfully weaves together elements of satire, drama, and dark humor to create a nuanced portrayal of the challenges faced by individuals who seek to live a life of faith and purpose.

Through Father James' journey, the movie raises important questions about the nature of morality, the role of authority figures in our lives, and the consequences of our actions. The film also delves into the complexities of human relationships, highlighting the tensions between personal desire and spiritual duty.

Ultimately, Calvary is a powerful exploration of the human condition, one that challenges its audience to confront their own values and beliefs about faith, morality, and the search for meaning in life.

overview: Landing in jail for a petty theft crime, Alvin finds himself sharing a cell with John Jaster, the incarcerated half of the pair of high-tech thieves responsible for the missing gold. His partner, Bristol, is still at large. Alvin wants only to get out of prison and start fresh with his girlfriend, Lisa, and when the Feds, led by U.S. Treasury investigator Clenteen, set him loose on a sketchy deal, he thinks his luck has changed. Alvin has his freedom and the Feds have found their bait.
tagline: Alvin Sanders is going to help the Feds catch a killer. He just doesn't know it yet.
title: Bait
plot:
Bait is a 2000 thriller film directed by Garry Marshall. The story revolves around a group of people who are trapped in an elevator during a massive earthquake, and they must work together to survive.

The main theme of the movie is the human condition under extreme circumstances. As the characters face their mortality, they are forced to confront their deepest fears, insecurities, and personal demons. The film explores how people react when faced with the ultimate test of survival, revealing both the best and worst aspects of human nature.

Throughout the movie, the characters' personalities, relationships, and motivations are put to the test as they struggle to stay alive. The film's tense atmosphere and suspenseful plot keep the audience engaged, making it a thrilling ride from start to finish.

One of the key themes is also the concept of social hierarchy and how people react when their usual rules and norms no longer apply. As the characters are forced to rely on each other for survival, old rivalries and tensions surface, while new alliances are formed in an attempt to stay alive.

Overall, Bait is a gripping thriller that explores the complexities of human nature under extreme circumstances, making it a thought-provoking and entertaining watch.

overview: A conman and his seductive partner are forced to work for a wild FBI agent, who pushes them into a world of Jersey power-brokers and the Mafia.
tagline: Everyone Hustles To Survive
title: American Hustle
plot:
American Hustle is a 2013 historical crime drama film directed by David O. Russell, written by Eric Warren Singer, and starring Christian Bale, Amy Adams, Bradley Cooper, Jennifer Lawrence, Jeremy Renner, and Robert De Niro.

The film is loosely based on the FBI's Abscam sting operation in the late 1970s and early 1980s, which targeted corrupt politicians and mobsters. The story follows con artist Irving Rosenfeld (Christian Bale), who teams up with his partner Sydney Prosser (Bradley Cooper) to swindle wealthy marks.

However, their partnership is put to the test when they meet FBI agent Richie DiMaso (Bradley Cooper), who poses as a wealthy businessman and convinces them to work for him. Richie's true intention is to gather evidence against corrupt politicians, particularly New Jersey Senator Carmine Polito (Roberto Benigni).

As Irving and Sydney become more embroiled in the sting operation, they begin to develop feelings for each other, despite their troubled past. Meanwhile, Richie becomes increasingly obsessed with taking down Senator Polito, who is being blackmailed by a mobster named Rosalyn Rosenfeld (Jennifer Lawrence), Irving's wife.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Richie's true intentions are not entirely altruistic. He is using his partnership with Irving and Sydney to further his own career and gain favor with Senator Polito. The three become embroiled in a complex web of deceit and corruption, with each character playing multiple roles and hiding their true identities.

The film's plot twists and turns as the characters navigate their relationships and confront their personal demons. In the end, Irving and Sydney are forced to choose between their loyalty to Richie and their own survival. The film culminates in a dramatic showdown at Senator Polito's inauguration, where the characters' true identities are revealed and the consequences of their actions are revealed.

Throughout the film, Russell uses a non-linear narrative structure, jumping back and forth in time to reveal the characters' backstories and motivations. The film features a talented ensemble cast, with standout performances from Christian Bale, Amy Adams, and Jennifer Lawrence.

American Hustle received widespread critical acclaim, earning 10 Academy Award nominations, including Best Picture, Best Director, and Best Actor for Christian Bale. The film won one Oscar, for Best Supporting Actress for Jennifer Lawrence. Overall, American Hustle is a gripping and entertaining drama that explores the complexities of human relationships and the corrupting influence of power.

overview: Rose, a rebellious half-vampire/half-human guardian-in-training and her best friend, Lissa -- a mortal, royal vampire Princess - have been on the run when they are captured and returned to St. Vladamirs Academy, the very place where they believe their lives may be in most jeopardy. Rose will sacrifice everything to protect Lissa from those who intend to exploit her from within the Academy walls and the Strigoi (immortal, evil vampires) who hunt her kind from outside its sanctuary.
tagline: They suck at school.
title: Vampire Academy
plot:
Vampire Academy is a 2014 American fantasy comedy directed by Mark Waters from a screenplay by his brother Daniel Waters, adapted from the first book in Richelle Mead's novel series. Zoey Deutch stars as Rose Hathaway, a Dhampir, and Lucy Fry as her Moroi best friend, Lissa Dragomir, with Danila Kozlovsky as Dimitri Belikov, Dominic Sherwood as Christian Ozera and Sarah Hyland as Natalie Dashkov.

In this world, Moroi are mortal vampires of royal bloodlines with magical gifts, Dhampirs are half-human hybrids trained to guard them, and Strigoi are the undead killers Moroi become if they drain a victim completely. Seventeen-year-old Rose, a guardian-in-training, and Princess Lissa have been hiding for a year after fleeing St. Vladimir's Academy when they are found and brought back. Lissa is shunned by her classmates, and Rose finds herself attracted to her Russian mentor, Dimitri. Threats against Lissa begin to appear, including messages written in blood. Suspicion falls on Mia, who had dated Lissa's late brother and now resents Lissa as the last of the Dragomir line. Rose lies to keep away Christian, an outcast because his parents chose to become Strigoi, yet he and Lissa grow close anyway.

Investigating the disappearance of Sonya Karp, a teacher who helped them escape, Rose learns that Karp became unstable from using Spirit, a rare healing magic that slowly drains its user and that Lissa also possesses, and that Karp turned Strigoi. As dead animals appear wherever Lissa goes, Rose realizes Mia is not behind everything. Lissa is kidnapped, and Rose, Dimitri and Christian rescue her from Victor Dashkov, a former royal candidate who planned to use her powers to cure his own illness, even at the cost of her life. Imprisoned beneath the school, Victor tells Rose that her bond with Lissa stems from being "shadow-kissed", revived by Lissa's magic. His daughter Natalie, who has turned Strigoi, tries to free him, but Dimitri kills her. Lissa publicly embraces her Spirit magic, crediting Rose, and Dimitri tells Rose he cannot love her because he might protect her instead of Lissa. Nearby, Karp leads a horde of Strigoi.

The Weinstein Company released the film in the United States on February 7, 2014, without screening it for critics. It earned only $3.9 million in its opening weekend and about $15.4 million worldwide against a $30 million budget. Critics were largely negative, giving it 18% on Rotten Tomatoes, and a crowdfunding campaign for a sequel failed.

overview: Edward Wilson, the only witness to his father's suicide and member of the Skull and Bones Society while a student at Yale, is a morally upright young man who values honor and discretion, qualities that help him to be recruited for a career in the newly founded OSS. His dedication to his work does not come without a price though, leading him to sacrifice his ideals and eventually his family.
tagline: The untold story of the most powerful covert agency in the world.
title: The Good Shepherd
plot:
The Good Shepherd is a 2006 spy thriller film directed by Robert De Niro, starring Matt Damon, Angelina Jolie, and Alec Baldwin.

The main themes of The Good Shepherd revolve around:

1. **Loyalty vs. Betrayal**: The film explores the moral dilemmas faced by CIA agents, particularly Bill Hayes (Matt Damon), as they navigate the complexities of loyalty to their country, colleagues, and personal values.
2. **Identity and Self-Sacrifice**: The protagonist, Bill Hayes, struggles with his own identity and sense of purpose, ultimately sacrificing his personal life for the sake of duty and country.
3. **The Cost of Power and Corruption**: The film critiques the darker aspects of power and corruption within institutions, particularly the CIA, highlighting the consequences of unchecked ambition and the erosion of moral principles.
4. **Trauma and Psychological Scarring**: The movie portrays the long-term effects of traumatic experiences on individuals, including Bill Hayes' struggles with PTSD and his complicated relationships with those around him.
5. **The Weight of History**: The Good Shepherd explores the historical context of the Cold War era, delving into the complexities of espionage, politics, and international relations.

Throughout the film, these themes are woven together to create a complex narrative that raises questions about the nature of duty, loyalty, and the human cost of serving one's country.

overview: Milo and Kida reunite with their friends to investigate strange occurances around the world that seem to have links to the secrets of Atlantis.
tagline: The all-new adventures
title: Atlantis: Milo's Return
plot:
Atlantis: Milo's Return is a direct-to-video animated film that serves as a sequel to the 1997 television series "Mighty Ducks." The movie follows the adventures of young hockey player and team captain, Ryan Duckworth, who has grown up since the events of the original series.

The story begins with Ryan (now a teenager) struggling to balance his love for hockey with his desire to attend college. He is forced to return to the Mighty Ducks' old rink, where he reunites with his former teammates, including Puck, Hannah, and Charlie. However, their reunion is short-lived as they soon discover that the evil villain, Vincent "Vinnie" Morneau, has returned to exact revenge on Ryan's family.

It turns out that Vinnie had been seeking revenge against Ryan's father, who had foiled his plans in the original series. Vinnie kidnaps Ryan and takes him to the underwater kingdom of Atlantis, where he intends to use Ryan as leverage to get back at Ryan's family.

In Atlantis, Ryan meets Milo, a young boy who is the son of King Poseidon and Princess Athena. Milo has been searching for his parents, who were thought to have been killed by Vinnie in a previous adventure. With the help of his friends, including Puck, Hannah, and Charlie, Ryan must navigate the dangers of Atlantis and work with Milo to stop Vinnie's evil plans.

As they journey through the underwater kingdom, Ryan and Milo encounter various obstacles, including treacherous sea creatures and treacherous paths. Along the way, Ryan learns more about his own destiny and the importance of teamwork and friendship.

In the end, Ryan and Milo successfully defeat Vinnie and shatter the curse that had been cast upon Ryan's family. With the curse lifted, Ryan is able to pursue his dreams of playing hockey in college, while also finding a new sense of purpose as a hero in the underwater kingdom of Atlantis.

Throughout the movie, there are many nods to the original series, including cameos from familiar characters and references to classic Mighty Ducks moments. The film's animation style is reminiscent of the original series, with vibrant colors and engaging character designs.

Overall, "Atlantis: Milo's Return" is a fun and action-packed adventure that explores themes of friendship, teamwork, and self-discovery. While it may not be as iconic as some of Disney's other animated films, it remains a beloved entry in the Mighty Ducks franchise.

overview: Driven by tragedy, billionaire Bruce Wayne dedicates his life to uncovering and defeating the corruption that plagues his home, Gotham City.  Unable to work within the system, he instead creates a new identity, a symbol of fear for the criminal underworld - The Batman.
tagline: Evil fears the knight.
title: Batman Begins
plot:
Batman Begins is a 2005 superhero film directed by Christopher Nolan, produced by Charles Roven and Emma Thomas, and written by Nolan and David S. Goyer.

The movie begins with Bruce Wayne (Christian Bale) as a young boy witnessing his parents' murder in front of him in Gotham City. This traumatic event sets the tone for the rest of the film, as Bruce struggles to come to terms with the loss of his loved ones.

As Bruce grows up, he becomes obsessed with martial arts and detective work, using these skills to cope with his emotions. He travels to Japan, where he trains with a sensei named Ra's al Ghul (Liam Neeson), who teaches him about the philosophy of fear and its role in shaping human behavior.

Years later, Bruce returns to Gotham City as a young adult, determined to use his skills to fight crime and protect the innocent. However, he soon realizes that his wealth and privilege have not prepared him for the harsh realities of being a vigilante. He begins to question whether he has what it takes to be a true hero.

Bruce's journey is further complicated by the presence of Dr. Jonathan Crane (Cillian Murphy), a psychologist who uses his skills to manipulate and terrorize Gotham City's citizens. As Bruce delves deeper into the world of crime, he becomes increasingly obsessed with understanding the mind of a villain.

Meanwhile, Ra's al Ghul returns to Gotham City, seeking revenge against those who have wronged him in the past. He is aided by his loyal servant, Scarecrow (also played by Cillian Murphy), who uses his knowledge of psychology and toxins to spread fear and chaos throughout the city.

As Batman begins to take shape, he faces off against Ra's al Ghul and Scarecrow in a series of intense battles. Along the way, he must confront his own demons and learn to harness his emotions in order to become a true hero.

The film culminates in a dramatic showdown between Batman and Ra's al Ghul, with Bruce ultimately emerging victorious but not without scars. The movie ends on a hopeful note, as Bruce reflects on the lessons he has learned and the journey that has brought him to this point.

Throughout the film, Nolan explores themes of trauma, identity, and the nature of heroism. Batman Begins is a thought-provoking and visually stunning film that sets the stage for the rest of the Dark Knight Trilogy.

overview: A couple try to repair their damaged union in an Italian vacation paradise. Then they discover the owner's intentions.
tagline: Betrayal hurts. Jealousy kills.
title: Welcome Home
plot:
Welcome Home is a 2018 thriller film directed by George Ratliff from a screenplay by David Levinson, produced by Allan Mandelbaum, Tim White and Trevor White for Voltage Pictures. Aaron Paul and Emily Ratajkowski, cast in April 2017, play a troubled couple who hope a romantic getaway to Italy will save their relationship, with Riccardo Scamarcio in a supporting role as Federico. The first trailer appeared in October 2018, and the film went to video on demand in November 2018 without a North American theatrical run.

Bryan and Cassie rent a house in Umbria in an effort to repair their relationship after Cassie was caught having drunken sex with a co-worker, an episode that has left Bryan impotent. While out running, Cassie hurts her ankle and is helped by Federico, a handsome stranger who drives her back and offers them a ride into town the next day. After a tense trip, Bryan accuses Cassie of failing to notice how Federico leers at her, and she storms off. Federico joins Bryan at a bar, secretly drugs his drink and arranges for two women to take him to a hotel, where Bryan has sex with them but later remembers nothing. Federico, it emerges, has hidden cameras throughout the house and watches the couple constantly.

Bryan discovers that Federico is not their neighbor, as he claimed, and when he threatens to expose him, Federico threatens to tell Cassie about the hotel. Cassie warms to Federico until an unsettling dinner of rabbit stew. Enraged after watching the couple reconcile, Federico locks Bryan in the cellar, tricks a blindfolded Cassie into letting him kiss and grope her while filming it, then leaves Bryan's phone playing the hotel video for her to find. The couple's furious argument ends when a thrown phone shatters a mirror and reveals a hidden camera. Federico arrives and attacks Bryan with a knife, and Cassie beats him to death with a cane. Eduardo, the owner of the house, then arrives and reveals himself as Federico's accomplice, but Cassie stabs him and Bryan shoots him. Bryan finds recordings of many other couples, and the pair burn the tapes, bury the bodies and vow silence, unaware that a camera hidden in a garden gnome is streaming them to viewers worldwide, part of a global network of similarly wired rentals.

Francesco Acquaroli plays Eduardo. Critics were unenthusiastic, with 10% approval on Rotten Tomatoes from ten reviews and a Metacritic score of 38. The film earned about $332,000 from foreign release.

original_title: Monsieur Ibrahim et les Fleurs du Coran
overview: Paris, 1960s. Momo, a resolute and independent Jewish teenager who lives with his father, a sullen and depressed man, in a working-class neighborhood, develops a close friendship with Monsieur Ibrahim, an elderly Muslim who owns a small grocery store.
title: Monsieur Ibrahim
plot:
Monsieur Ibrahim is a 2003 French drama film directed by François Dupeyron. The movie revolves around the complex and intriguing relationship between Monsieur Ibrahim, an elderly man with a mysterious past, and his three young sons who are struggling to find their place in life.

At its core, the film explores themes of identity, belonging, and the search for meaning. Monsieur Ibrahim's character is a masterful example of how one can reinvent oneself and create new identities throughout life. His relationship with his sons serves as a catalyst for them to confront their own insecurities and desires, leading to a deeper understanding of themselves and their place in the world.

The film also delves into the concept of nostalgia and the passing of time. As Monsieur Ibrahim's past begins to unravel, it becomes clear that he has been hiding secrets and living multiple lives. This serves as a metaphor for the human experience, where we all try to create new identities and leave our past behind, but ultimately, our experiences shape us into who we are.

Furthermore, the movie touches on the idea of family dynamics and the complexities of father-son relationships. Monsieur Ibrahim's character is both a loving and distant figure, leaving his sons to navigate their own emotions and desires. This dichotomy serves as a reflection of the human experience, where our relationships with others can be both nurturing and challenging.

Overall, Monsieur Ibrahim is a thought-provoking film that explores the complexities of human identity, belonging, and the search for meaning. Through its intricate characters and narrative, it invites viewers to reflect on their own experiences and emotions, making it a deeply resonant and moving cinematic experience.

overview: When a kingpin threatens New York City, a group of mutated turtle warriors must emerge from the shadows to protect their home.
tagline: Mysterious. Dangerous. Reptilious. You've never seen heroes like this.
title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
plot:
The 2014 film "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles" is a reboot of the popular franchise, directed by Jonathan Liebesman and produced by Michael Bay. The movie follows the origin story of four brothers - Leonardo (Leonardo DiCaprio), Donatello (Jensen Ackles), Michelangelo (Noel Fisher), and Raphael (Alan Ritchson) - who are trained in the art of ninjutsu by their sensei, Splinter (Will Arnett).

The story begins with a scientist, Dr. Baxter Stockman (Freddie Stroma), working for Shredder (Tohoru Masamune), the leader of the Foot Clan, a powerful and ruthless organization that seeks to dominate New York City. The scientists' goal is to create an army of genetically modified super-soldiers using mutated turtles.

The four brothers are accidentally exposed to radioactive ooze in the sewers beneath New York City, which transforms them into humanoid turtles with ninja skills. They soon discover their new identity and begin training under Splinter, a wise and skilled rat who was once a human ninja.

As the Turtles grow stronger, they must confront Shredder's plans to use his army of mutated super-soldiers to take over the city. The brothers also meet April O'Neil (Megan Fox), a journalist who becomes their ally in the fight against Shredder and the Foot Clan.

The movie features plenty of action-packed sequences, including intense battles between the Turtles and the Foot Clan's henchmen. However, it also explores themes of brotherhood, loyalty, and self-discovery as the Turtles navigate their new identities and learn to work together as a team.

Overall, the 2014 "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles" film is an entertaining and visually stunning take on the beloved franchise, with plenty of humor, action, and heart.

original_title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
overview: As Lord Voldemort tightens his grip on both the Muggle and wizarding worlds, Hogwarts is no longer a safe haven. Harry suspects perils may even lie within the castle, but Dumbledore is more intent upon preparing him for the final battle fast approaching. Together they work to find the key to unlock Voldemorts defenses and to this end, Dumbledore recruits his old friend and colleague Horace Slughorn, whom he believes holds crucial information. Even as the decisive showdown looms, romance blossoms for Harry, Ron, Hermione and their classmates. Love is in the air, but danger lies ahead and Hogwarts may never be the same again.
tagline: Dark Secrets Revealed
title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
plot:
Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince is a fantasy film directed by David Yates, based on the sixth novel by J.K. Rowling. The movie follows the story of Harry Potter (Daniel Radcliffe) as he returns to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry for his sixth year.

The story begins with Harry spending the summer at the Dursleys', where he is subjected to the usual mistreatment. However, things take a turn when he receives a mysterious potions textbook that contains notes from a former student known as the Half-Blood Prince. The book becomes a valuable resource for Harry in his studies and helps him understand more about the Dark Arts.

Upon returning to Hogwarts, Harry learns that Lord Voldemort's Death Eaters are becoming increasingly powerful, and the wizarding world is on high alert. Meanwhile, Harry develops feelings for Ginny Weasley (Bonnie Wright), Ron Weasley's (Rupert Grint) sister, but struggles with his emotions due to his unrequited love for Hermione Granger (Emma Watson).

As the year progresses, Harry becomes more aware of Voldemort's past and the nature of his own destiny. He also discovers that the Half-Blood Prince is none other than Severus Snape (Alan Rickman), a potions master who has been teaching at Hogwarts for years.

Throughout the film, Harry must navigate the complexities of adolescence, friendships, and romantic relationships while facing the increasing threat of Voldemort's return to power. The movie culminates in a dramatic showdown between Harry and Draco Malfoy (Tom Felton), who is revealed to be working on behalf of the Death Eaters.

The film explores themes of love, loyalty, and the complexities of human nature, particularly through the character of Severus Snape. His backstory, which is gradually revealed throughout the series, adds depth to his character and raises questions about his motivations and loyalties.

Overall, Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince is a captivating installment in the beloved franchise, with stunning visuals, memorable performances, and an engaging storyline that sets the stage for the final battle between good and evil.

overview: A mind-bending love story following Greg who, after recently being divorced and then fired, meets the mysterious Isabel, a woman living on the streets and convinced that the polluted, broken world around them is just a computer simulation. Doubtful at first, Greg eventually discovers there may be some truth to Isabel’s wild conspiracy.
tagline: Chase something real.
title: Bliss
plot:
Bliss is a 2021 American drama written and directed by Mike Cahill. Owen Wilson stars as Greg Wittle, a recently divorced, estranged man who suffers a breakdown after losing his job, and Salma Hayek as Isabel, a homeless woman who befriends him and draws him into what seems to be drug addiction as he struggles to tell reality from fantasy.

Greg spends his days at work daydreaming and sketching, and cannot refill his medication without a new prescription. Called into his boss's office and fired, he accidentally kills his boss, hides the body and goes to the bar across the street, where Isabel seems to know what he has done. She claims to have created this world, with unintended consequences, and uses telekinesis to make the death look like a suicide in exchange for a favor. She brings him to a tent encampment, gives him yellow crystals and teaches him to bend the world with his mind. After the two trip a bully at a roller rink, Greg watches the man's arrest only to find himself in the police car. His daughter, Emily, finds him on the street and gives him her number, but when he calls her, Isabel is furious, insisting that Emily is not real.

To prove it, Isabel has them snort blue crystals, and they awaken hooked to a giant computer. Greg is told he has been living in a simulation inside a Brain Box that Isabel designed to study alternate realities and their effect on the brain. In this utopian world, she and Greg are a couple, and his sketches turn out to depict it. Greg cannot remember any of it, and at a gala celebrating the Brain Box, he sees a ghostly Emily begging him to return. When pieces of the simulation start to leak into Isabel's view too, she concludes that they must go back and take more blue crystals to leave for good. Inside the simulation, she commits a murder while getting crystals, and the police give chase. With enough for only one of them, Greg, hearing Emily, who has tracked him down, tells Isabel to go alone. She distracts the police so Greg can escape to a rehab clinic, where he admits he believes his daughter is real, and he later reconnects with her.

Cahill cast Wilson and Hayek from a short pitch before they had read the script, and filming took place in Los Angeles and Croatia in 2019. Amazon Prime Video released the film on February 5, 2021. Reviews were mostly negative, with many critics drawing unfavorable comparisons to The Matrix; it scored 27% on Rotten Tomatoes and 40 on Metacritic.

overview: The cast of Friends reunites for a once-in-a-lifetime celebration of the hit series, an unforgettable evening filled with iconic memories, uncontrollable laughter, happy tears, and special guests.
tagline: The one where they get back together.
title: Friends: The Reunion
plot:
Friends: The Reunion is a 2021 American unscripted television special that brings back the cast of the sitcom Friends, and it is considered the show's first feature-length production. Directed by Ben Winston through Fulwell 73 and hosted by James Corden, it was executive produced by series co-creators Marta Kauffman and David Crane, producer Kevin S. Bright and the six stars, Jennifer Aniston, Courteney Cox, Lisa Kudrow, Matt LeBlanc, Matthew Perry and David Schwimmer, with Warner Horizon Unscripted Television also involved.

The special follows the six actors as they return to Stage 24 at Warner Bros. Studios in Burbank, where the series was filmed from its second season on, and walk through carefully rebuilt sets including the friends' apartments, the Central Perk coffee house and the famous fountain from the opening credits. Seated together, they reminisce with Corden about life on the show, perform table reads and re-enactments of memorable scenes, and look back at behind-the-scenes footage, joined at times by the series' creators. Familiar supporting players return, among them Maggie Wheeler, Tom Selleck, Elliott Gould, Christina Pickles and James Michael Tyler, while celebrity guests including Lady Gaga, Justin Bieber and BTS also take part. A trivia game segment features the actors who played the barbershop quartet in one episode.

Announced for the launch of HBO Max in May 2020, the special was delayed twice by the COVID-19 pandemic and finally filmed in April 2021. It premiered on HBO Max on 27 May 2021 and was released the same day on partner services in many countries. In China, scenes with Lady Gaga, Bieber and BTS, as well as LGBTQ references, were removed. The special was reportedly watched in about 29% of U.S. streaming households on its debut day and became Sky One's most-watched program in the United Kingdom, with 5.3 million viewers. Reviews were generally favorable, with a Metacritic score of 65; critics felt it worked best for devoted fans but found warmth in the cast's chemistry. It was the last screen appearance of James Michael Tyler, who died months later, and of Matthew Perry, who died in 2023.

overview: Based on an inspiring true story, a small-town news reporter (Krasinski) and a Greenpeace volunteer (Barrymore) enlist the help of rival superpowers to save three majestic gray whales trapped under the ice of the Arctic Circle. ‘Big Miracle’ is adapted from the nonfiction book ‘Freeing the Whales: How the Media Created the World’s Greatest Non-Event’ by Tom Rose.
tagline: A family of whales trapped beneath the ice. One unforgettable rescue.
title: Big Miracle
plot:
Big Miracle is a 2012 American drama film directed by Mimi Leder and produced by Universal Pictures. The movie is based on the true story of the 1988 rescue of gray whales in Alaska.

The main theme of Big Miracle revolves around the power of community, perseverance, and compassion. The story takes place in the small town of Barrow, Alaska, where a group of residents band together to help save a pod of gray whales trapped in the ice.

At its core, the film is about the human spirit's capacity for kindness, generosity, and selflessness. The characters, including the local Inupiat people, the scientists, and the townspeople, work together to devise a plan to rescue the whales without harming them. This collective effort showcases the importance of community and cooperation in overcoming seemingly insurmountable challenges.

The film also explores themes of environmentalism, conservation, and the impact of human actions on the natural world. The story highlights the struggles faced by the Inupiat people as they navigate the complexities of modernization and the effects of climate change on their traditional way of life.

Furthermore, Big Miracle touches on the idea that even in the face of adversity, hope and determination can lead to remarkable achievements. The movie's climax, which depicts the successful rescue of the whales, is a testament to the power of human ingenuity and collaboration.

Overall, Big Miracle is a heartwarming and inspiring film that celebrates the resilience of the human spirit and the importance of working together to make a positive impact on the world around us.

overview: After being wrongfully convicted, a woman is imprisoned for 13 years and forced to give up her daughter. While in prison she gains the respect of her cellmates and plots her revenge on the man responsible. Once released, she begins her elaborate plan of retribution, but discovers a horrifying truth.
tagline: All she wanted was a peaceful life… they didn't give it.
title: Sympathy for Lady Vengeance
plot:
Sympathy for Lady Vengeance is a 2005 South Korean revenge thriller film directed by Park Chan-wook, written by Park Chan-wook and Lee Hyun-seung, and produced by TSJ Entertainment. The film stars Kim Sun-a, Shin Ha-kyun, and Jo Han-jin.

The story begins with the introduction of Im Car-ro (Kim Sun-a), a former con artist who was involved in a heist that went horribly wrong, resulting in the death of her accomplice and lover, Park Do-joon. After serving 10 years in prison, Im Car-ro is released on parole and seeks revenge against those responsible for her past mistakes.

Im Car-ro sets out to find Park Do-joon's brother, Park Do-jin (Shin Ha-kyun), a wealthy businessman who she believes was involved in the heist. She manipulates him into helping her with her plan, which involves robbing a bank and framing his company for the crime.

As Im Car-ro's plan unfolds, it becomes clear that she has a personal vendetta against Park Do-jin, whom she blames for her past suffering. Through a series of clever manipulations and deceptions, Im Car-ro slowly takes control of Park Do-jin's life, using him to further her own agenda.

However, as the story progresses, it becomes apparent that Im Car-ro's motivations are not entirely driven by revenge. She is also seeking redemption for her past mistakes and a chance to start anew. Through her interactions with Park Do-jin, she begins to confront her own demons and grapple with the consequences of her actions.

The film's climax features a tense showdown between Im Car-ro and Park Do-jin, as well as his associates, who are determined to stop her from carrying out her plan. In the end, Im Car-ro emerges victorious, but not without scars. The film concludes with Im Car-ro walking away from the chaos she has created, symbolizing her newfound freedom and a chance for redemption.

Throughout the film, Park Chan-wook explores themes of revenge, redemption, and the complexities of human relationships. The film's title, Sympathy for Lady Vengeance, is a clever play on words, as Im Car-ro is both the victim and the perpetrator of violence. The film's dark humor and witty dialogue add to its tension and complexity, making it a thought-provoking and entertaining watch.

Overall, Sympathy for Lady Vengeance is a gripping and intense thriller that explores the complexities of human nature and the consequences of our actions. With its clever plot twists and strong performances from the cast, it is a must-see for fans of revenge thrillers and Park Chan-wook's unique brand of storytelling.

overview: A group of friends head to a deserted Caribbean island for a surprise overnight bachelor party only to discover that the island isn't deserted. It's actually the home to a secret medical facility. Not only that, there's something wrong with the water surrounding the island...
tagline: The Birth of Fear
title: Cabin Fever: Patient Zero
plot:
Cabin Fever: Patient Zero is a 2014 horror film that explores several themes that are characteristic of the zombie genre. At its core, the movie delves into the idea of isolation and how it can exacerbate human nature's darker aspects.

The film takes place in an isolated research facility where a mysterious virus is being studied, and the characters' initial excitement and curiosity about the discovery soon give way to paranoia, fear, and ultimately, desperation. As the outbreak spreads, the characters are forced to confront their own mortality and the true meaning of humanity in the face of unimaginable horror.

The movie also touches on the theme of scientific hubris and the dangers of playing with nature. The researchers' attempts to contain and understand the virus lead to a catastrophic outcome, highlighting the risks of unchecked ambition and the importance of humility in the face of the unknown.

Furthermore, Cabin Fever: Patient Zero explores the idea of social hierarchy and how it can be both a source of comfort and a catalyst for conflict. As the outbreak ravages the facility, the characters' initial divisions and power struggles give way to a desperate struggle for survival, revealing the true nature of their relationships and the values that truly matter in times of crisis.

Overall, Cabin Fever: Patient Zero is a tense, suspenseful thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human nature, scientific hubris, and social dynamics, making it a gripping watch for fans of the horror genre.

original_title: 僕のヒーローアカデミア THE MOVIE ヒーローズ：ライジング
overview: Class 1-A visits Nabu Island where they finally get to do some real hero work. The place is so peaceful that it's more like a vacation … until they're attacked by a villain with an unfathomable Quirk! His power is eerily familiar, and it looks like Shigaraki had a hand in the plan. But with All Might retired and citizens' lives on the line, there's no time for questions. Deku and his friends are the next generation of heroes, and they're the island's only hope.
title: My Hero Academia: Heroes Rising
plot:
My Hero Academia: Heroes Rising is a 2019 Japanese animated superhero film based on an original story featuring the characters of Kōhei Horikoshi's manga My Hero Academia. Produced by Bones and distributed by Toho, the second film in the franchise was directed by Kenji Nagasaki from a script by Yōsuke Kuroda. Daiki Yamashita and Nobuhiko Okamoto lead the voice cast, with Yoshio Inoue as the villain Nine, Mio Imada as Slice, Tomoyo Kurosawa as Mahoro and Yuka Terasaki as Katsuma.

Heroes chase the League of Villains as they transport a life-support capsule, and when Endeavor wrecks their truck, the villains turn out to be clones. The capsule's occupant, Nine, escapes in the crash and rejoins his gang. Experiments by Daruma Ujiko gave Nine a copy of All For One's Quirk, letting him hold several Quirks besides his own weather manipulation, but they also worsened a terminal illness that only a rare cell activation Quirk can cure. Meanwhile, U.A. High's Class 1-A is sent to remote Nabu Island on a work program, where Izuku Midoriya, holder of One For All, and his rival Katsuki Bakugo befriend young Katsuma, who dreams of being a hero, and his protective older sister Mahoro. After stealing the siblings' father's Quirk and finding it incompatible with Nine's blood type, the villains descend on the island, cutting off all escape and communication. Nine discovers that Katsuma has the Quirk he needs and overpowers Izuku and Bakugo, but is forced to withdraw after overusing his abilities. Learning why Katsuma is targeted, the class evacuates the islanders and separates Nine from his followers, defeating them one by one. Nine, boosted by a Quirk-enhancing drug, overwhelms the remaining students and threatens to destroy the island, until Izuku transfers One For All to Bakugo and fights with its remnants, and together they defeat him. As reinforcements arrive, All Might finds that One For All has stayed with Izuku because the transfer was interrupted. Tomura Shigaraki kills the weakened Nine, the class helps repair the island, and Izuku, who like Bakugo has lost the memory of the transfer, assures Katsuma that he too can become a hero.

Released in Japan on December 20, 2019, and in North America on February 26, 2020, the film grossed $30 million worldwide. It received positive reviews, with a 90% Rotten Tomatoes rating. A third film, World Heroes' Mission, followed in 2021.

overview: Ivy and Bean sign up for ballet, only to learn they'll be dancing in a recital in front of hundreds of people. Time to get out of it — tout suite!
title: Ivy + Bean: Doomed to Dance
plot:
Ivy + Bean: Doomed to Dance is a 2022 American family comedy film directed by Elissa Down from a screenplay by Kathy Waugh and Jeff Stockwell. The third of the Netflix films adapted from the Ivy + Bean children's books, it stars Keslee Blalock as Ivy and Madison Skye Validum as Bean, with Jesse Tyler Ferguson, Lidya Jewett, Marci T. House, Garfield Wilson, Jaycie Dotin and Sasha Pieterse. It was released on Netflix on 2 September 2022.

Ivy brings a new book about ballet to her best friend Bean's house. Its grand tales of queens and sword fights fire the girls' imaginations, prompting a fantasy sequence, and they decide to sign up for ballet lessons. Ivy's mother (Dotin) agrees readily, but Bean's mother (House) is sceptical, since Bean has already quit trumpet lessons, softball and gymnastics, and Bean's snarky older sister Nancy (Jewett) bets her ten dollars that she will not finish the course. Arriving at class in capes and carrying weapons, expecting sword fighting, the girls quickly discover that there will be no kicking or dancing to the death. Their pretentious instructor, Monsieur Joie (Ferguson), who peppers his speech with exaggerated French, is unimpressed and sidelines the two awkward dancers by casting them as friendly squid in a big upcoming recital in front of hundreds of people. Desperate to escape, Ivy dons her cape and tries a forgetting spell on their mothers, made with gross ingredients including dead flies, but it fails. Ivy's mother says she may quit, believing children must try things to learn who they are, while Bean's mother insists that Bean finish what she started for once. In a show of loyalty, Ivy agrees to stick it out alongside her friend, and the pair hatch a series of schemes to get out of the performance as the recital approaches.

Reviews were generally favourable. John Serba of Decider recommended it as easily the best of the three films, praising its subversion of the series' formula, the reduced gross-out humour and the sense that the girls' friendship deepens with each mishap, and enjoyed Ferguson's doltish instructor. Common Sense Media judged it the weakest of the trilogy but still good, sweet fun, highlighting Ferguson's campy turn and the delightful central friendship.

overview: Two overworked and underpaid assistants come up with a plan to get their bosses off their backs by setting them up with each other.
tagline: Finding love takes some assistants.
title: Set It Up
plot:
Set It Up is an American romantic comedy of 2018 directed by Claire Scanlon and written by Katie Silberman, about two overworked New York assistants who set up their demanding bosses. Zoey Deutch plays Harper Moore and Glen Powell plays Charlie Young, with Lucy Liu as Harper's boss Kirsten Stevens, Taye Diggs as Charlie's boss Rick Otis, Joan Smalls as Charlie's girlfriend Suze, Meredith Hagner as Harper's best friend and roommate Becca and Tituss Burgess as the janitor known as Creepy Tim.

Harper works for Kirsten, a former journalist who now edits a sports media empire, and dreams of writing about sports herself; Charlie works for Rick, a high-strung venture capitalist whose connections could guarantee him a promotion. They meet one night when both bosses want dinner: Harper has food but no cash, and Charlie has cash but no food, so he pays and lets her take one of the meals. Complaining that their jobs leave them no free time, Harper suggests setting up their bosses, reasoning that two people busy with romance would have less time to overwork their assistants. Charlie agrees after Suze nearly leaves him for neglecting her.

A staged meeting in a stuck elevator, arranged with Creepy Tim's help, collapses when a panicking delivery man joins them, but at a baseball game the assistants bribe the kiss-cam operator, and after three attempts Rick and Kirsten kiss. As the relationship wobbles, Harper and Charlie keep it alive by secretly planning dates, leaving notes and gifts, and booking a weekend away, and Charlie joins Harper at Becca's engagement party. When the bosses return engaged, Charlie learns that Rick proposed partly to provoke his ex-wife Kiki, with whom he is still sleeping. Harper finds out too, is dismayed that Charlie still wants the wedding to happen, and confesses the scheme to Kirsten, who fires her. Charlie, realizing he does not love Suze, breaks up with her, rushes to the airport, quits and tells Kirsten that Rick neither loves nor knows her, and she calls off the elopement. Harper, focusing on her writing, turns down Kirsten's offer to rehire her, though Kirsten offers to edit her article. Kirsten has also summoned Charlie, now working as a temp while he works out what he wants, and Harper and Charlie realize they are being set up. They admit their feelings and kiss.

Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer was originally set to distribute the film, which Netflix released on 15 June 2018. Reviews were largely positive.

overview: A former soldier is taken captive and awakens in the back of a van where he learns that he only has less than 10 minutes to figure out how he got there.
title: The Anomaly
plot:
The Anomaly is a thought-provoking science fiction film that delves into the complexities of time travel and its consequences on human existence. At its core, the movie explores the theme of free will versus determinism, raising questions about the nature of reality and the impact of our choices on the fabric of time.

As the story unfolds, we are introduced to a protagonist who discovers a way to manipulate time, allowing him to alter events in his past. However, this newfound power comes with a steep price, as he begins to realize that every decision he makes has a ripple effect on the present and future. The film masterfully weaves together elements of science fiction, philosophy, and psychological thriller to create a narrative that is both intellectually stimulating and emotionally resonant.

One of the primary concerns of the movie is the concept of causality, which is expertly explored through the protagonist's experiences. As he navigates the consequences of his actions, he begins to question whether his choices are truly his own or if they are predetermined by some larger force. This existential crisis serves as a catalyst for the film's exploration of free will and its relationship with determinism.

Furthermore, The Anomaly touches on the theme of loneliness and isolation, highlighting the human cost of playing with time. As our protagonist struggles to come to terms with his newfound power, he is forced to confront the emptiness and disconnection that can result from manipulating the fabric of reality. This poignant aspect of the film adds a layer of emotional depth to the narrative, making it more than just a thought-provoking sci-fi thriller.

Overall, The Anomaly is a movie that challenges viewers to think critically about the nature of time, free will, and human existence. With its intricate plot, complex characters, and philosophical themes, it is a film that lingers in the mind long after the credits roll.

overview: Taking place after the events of Assassin's Creed: Revelations in the year 1524 in Tuscany, follow the retired Assassin Ezio Auditore as he teams up with Shao Jun during his final battles.
title: Assassin's Creed: Embers
plot:
Assassin's Creed: Embers is a Canadian animated short film of 2011 produced by UbiWorkshop and written by Darby McDevitt, based on the Assassin's Creed games. It concludes the story of Ezio Auditore da Firenze, the hero of Assassin's Creed II, Brotherhood and Revelations, who is voiced again by Roger Craig Smith. Angela Galuppo voices both the Chinese Assassin Shao Jun and Ezio's daughter Flavia, Anna Tuveri voices his wife Sofia Sartor and Peter Arpesella plays a young Italian man. The film was included as a bonus with the Signature and Collector's Editions of Assassin's Creed: Revelations.

The story is set in 1524, twelve years after Ezio discovered the secret library of Altaïr. Having retired from the Assassin Order, he lives quietly in the Tuscan countryside with Sofia and their children Flavia and Marcello, and writes his memoirs. Then a stranger arrives: Shao Jun, a Chinese Assassin who has come to learn from him about his life in the Brotherhood. Ezio wants her gone, but Sofia lets her stay the night. When he catches her reading his memoirs he orders her out, but relents when she asks what being an Assassin means.

On a visit to Florence, his birthplace, he tells her how the execution of his father and brothers in the town square drove him to become an Assassin, and that such a life brings only suffering. Leaving the city, they are attacked by a man who also seems to be Asian. After killing him, Shao Jun explains that she was once a concubine of the Jiajing Emperor and is being hunted by his agents, and that her former master freed her from the emperor's grip. Back at the villa, Ezio sends his family away, knowing more killers will follow, and teaches Shao Jun the key to freeing her people. That night more of her pursuers attack, and the two Assassins defeat them all, though Ezio is left exhausted. In the morning he gives her a small box to use only if she loses her way and sends her off as two riders approach.

Some time later, Ezio, now suffering from heart trouble, travels to Florence with Sofia and Flavia. Resting on a bench, he is approached by a young man with a scarred face who complains about the women of Florence, reminding Ezio of his own youth. The young man leaves, and Ezio dies of a heart attack in front of his family. The film closes with a final letter to Sofia, in which Ezio writes that of everything that sustained him through life, his love for the world and for the people around him was the strongest.

overview: Set in the 1920s French Riviera, a master magician is commissioned to try and expose a psychic as a fraud.
title: Magic in the Moonlight
plot:
Magic in the Moonlight is indeed a 2014 film directed by Woody Allen. The movie revolves around the theme of love and its complexities, often blurring the lines between reality and illusion.

The story centers around Stanley Wood, a magician who has built his career on creating an image of himself as a charming ladies' man. However, when he meets Sophie Baker, a beautiful and intelligent woman with her own secrets, he finds himself entangled in a web of emotions that challenge his carefully constructed facade.

As the narrative unfolds, the film delves into the idea of identity and how it is shaped by our perceptions of ourselves and others. Stanley's character, in particular, grapples with the notion of authenticity versus artifice, as he struggles to reconcile his public persona with his true feelings for Sophie.

The movie also explores the theme of vulnerability, highlighting the difficulties of opening oneself up to love and intimacy. Through Stanley's journey, the film shows how even those who have built walls around themselves can find it challenging to let go and be truly vulnerable.

Ultimately, Magic in the Moonlight is a romantic comedy that uses humor and wit to explore deeper themes about human connection, identity, and the complexities of love.

overview: With her husband away at work, and her son at school, Laura dreams of a home-renovation project to supplant her restless days. Elliott, her irresistibly hot private contractor, soon fulfills her more forbidden dreams.
title: Infidelity in Suburbia
plot:
Infidelity in Suburbia is a 2017 Canadian erotic thriller television film directed by David Winning from a screenplay by Christie Will Wolf. Produced by Johnson Production Group and Annuit Coeptis Entertainment, it premiered on the Lifetime network in February 2017. It stars Sarah Butler, Marcus Rosner and Peter Benson, with Miranda Frigon in a supporting role, and was later broadcast in Italy as Quel nostro piccolo segreto.

Butler plays Laura Halpern, a restless, overprotective mother whose marriage of ten years to Greg (Benson) has lost its spark; with her husband away at work and her young son Jamie at school, she dreams of renovating her kitchen to fill her days. The family keeps a boat at a dock near Elliott Graverston (Rosner), a handsome contractor who rescues Jamie when the boy falls into the water. Invited to dinner, Elliott offers to remodel the kitchen and is soon working in the house, shirtless, under the admiring eyes of Laura and her neighbour Mira (Frigon). When Laura finds a pair of women's underwear on the boat and concludes that Greg is cheating, Elliott confides that as a child he had to help his mother cope with unfaithful men, and the two begin a passionate affair.

Racked with guilt, Laura tries to end it, but Elliott refuses to let her go, and she later learns that Greg's supposed lover, his assistant, was merely planning a surprise party for him. When the assistant goes home with Elliott and finds Laura's photograph by his bed, he strangles her. Elliott starts leaving notes in Laura's house and threatens to reveal the affair, and Laura discovers through a former client, a woman who resembles her, and a local café owner that he has a history of obsession, a possessive attachment to his mother and suspected involvement in a fire that destroyed his family home. Elliott kidnaps Greg and holds him on his boat, then takes Laura and Jamie captive at home in a twisted "anniversary" dinner. Laura knocks him down with a wine bottle but is struck with a hammer and carried to the boat, where she frees herself, stabs Elliott, rescues Greg and finally sends her pursuer falling to his death from a high window.

Patrick Serrano of the review site Lifetime Uncorked, recapping it with tongue firmly in cheek, gave it a rating of four knives for its thrills, along with a recommendation of three glasses of wine.

overview: Yet to fulfil their rock and roll destiny, the now middle-aged best friends Bill and Ted set out on a new adventure when a visitor from the future warns them that only their song can save life as we know it. Along the way, they are helped by their daughters, a new batch of historical figures and a few music legends — to seek the song that will set their world right and bring harmony to the universe.
tagline: The future awaits
title: Bill & Ted Face the Music
plot:
Bill & Ted Face the Music is a 2020 American fantasy comedy film directed by Dean Parisot and written by Chris Kattan, Ed Helms, and Jay Levey. The movie is produced by Scott Kroegh, Dean Parisot, and Seth Green.

The main themes of Bill & Ted Face the Music include:

1. **Time travel and consequences**: The movie explores the consequences of time travel and the importance of considering the potential outcomes of one's actions. Bill and Ted must navigate a complex web of timelines to ensure that their music has a positive impact on the future.
2. **Growing up and letting go**: As Bill and Ted approach middle age, they must confront the reality of growing older and leaving their youthful adventures behind. The movie explores the challenges of transitioning from one stage of life to another.
3. **The power of friendship and love**: The film highlights the importance of strong friendships and romantic relationships in shaping our lives. Bill and Ted's bond is put to the test as they navigate the complexities of adulthood, while also finding new love interests.
4. **Embracing change and uncertainty**: The movie encourages viewers to be open to change and uncertainty, rather than resisting them. Bill and Ted must adapt to a rapidly changing world and find ways to thrive in the face of adversity.

Overall, Bill & Ted Face the Music is a heartwarming and humorous exploration of the human experience, with a healthy dose of science fiction and fantasy elements.

overview: 17 year-old Ree Dolly sets out to track down her father, who put their house up for his bail bond and then disappeared. If she fails, Ree and her family will be turned out into the Ozark woods. Challenging her outlaw kin's code of silence and risking her life, Ree hacks through the lies, evasions and threats offered up by her relatives and begins to piece together the truth.
tagline: Talking Just Causes Witnesses
title: Winter's Bone
plot:
Winter's Bone is a 2010 American drama film directed by Debra Granik and written by Debra Granik and Anne Rossellini. The movie takes place in a remote Ozark region of Missouri, where 17-year-old Ree Dolly lives with her mentally ill mother and younger brother and sister.

The main theme of Winter's Bone revolves around the struggles of poverty, family dynamics, and the harsh realities of life in rural America. The film portrays a world where resources are scarce, and opportunities are limited, leaving the characters to fend for themselves. Ree Dolly's situation is particularly dire, as she must care for her siblings while also dealing with the complexities of her mother's illness and the looming threat of her father's imprisonment.

Throughout the movie, Granik explores themes of resilience, survival, and the power of female relationships in the face of adversity. Ree's bond with her family members, particularly her brother and sister, is a testament to her strength and determination. The film also highlights the struggles faced by women in rural communities, where they often bear the brunt of poverty, abuse, and neglect.

The movie features a hauntingly beautiful landscape that serves as a backdrop for the characters' struggles. The isolation and ruggedness of the Ozark region add to the sense of desperation and hopelessness that pervades the story. Ultimately, Winter's Bone is a powerful exploration of the human spirit, revealing the ways in which people can find strength and dignity even in the most difficult circumstances.

The film received widespread critical acclaim for its nuanced portrayal of poverty, family dynamics, and the complexities of rural life. It was nominated for several awards, including four Academy Awards, and has since become a modern classic of American independent cinema.

overview: American chess champion Bobby Fischer prepares for a legendary match-up against Russian Boris Spassky.
tagline: On the board he fought the Cold War. In his mind he fought his madness.
title: Pawn Sacrifice
plot:
Pawn Sacrifice is a 2014 film, not 2015, directed by Gambit and starring Tobey Maguire.

The movie revolves around Bobby Fischer's (Tobey Maguire) iconic match against Boris Spassky (Liev Schreiber) in the Cold War era. At its core, Pawn Sacrifice explores themes of isolation, obsession, and the blurred lines between genius and madness.

Fischer's character is portrayed as a complex individual, struggling with social anxiety and feeling like an outsider. His fixation on chess becomes an all-consuming force that drives him to sacrifice his personal relationships and even his own well-being in pursuit of victory. This obsessive nature leads to a cat-and-mouse game between Fischer and Spassky, both on and off the chessboard.

The film also delves into the Cold War tensions and the ideological divide between the United States and the Soviet Union during that era. The match becomes a symbol of the struggle for dominance and the fear of communism's spread. Through Fischer's character, the movie highlights the personal costs of being a pawn in a larger game, where one's identity is defined by their achievements rather than their humanity.

Ultimately, Pawn Sacrifice is a thought-provoking drama that examines the psychological toll of intense competition, the pressure to conform, and the fragility of the human psyche.

overview: In the not-too-distant future: after a global catastrophe has wiped out nearly all of humanity on Earth, an elite astronaut from Space Colony Kepler must make a decision that will seal the fate of the people on both planets.
tagline: Will Earth wait for us?
title: The Colony
plot:
The Colony is a 2021 German science fiction film directed by Christian Zübert and written by Christian Zübert and Stefan Aust. 

The movie revolves around a group of people who are trapped in an underground bunker, known as the "Colony", after a global catastrophe wipes out most of humanity on the surface. The story follows the struggles of the survivors as they try to maintain order, find resources, and ultimately decide whether to stay in the safety of their underground home or risk everything to reclaim the world above.

The main themes of The Colony include:

1. Survival vs. Humanity: As the characters face numerous challenges, they must weigh the importance of survival against the need for human connection, empathy, and compassion.
2. Leadership and Power Struggles: The film explores the complexities of leadership and power dynamics within a small community, highlighting the difficulties of making decisions that affect everyone's lives.
3. Isolation and Loneliness: The characters' confinement in the underground bunker serves as a metaphor for the isolation and loneliness that can result from being disconnected from the world above.
4. Morality and Ethics: As resources become scarce, the group must confront difficult moral choices, raising questions about what it means to be human and how far they are willing to go to ensure their survival.

Overall, The Colony is a thought-provoking film that delves into the complexities of human nature in the face of catastrophic circumstances.

overview: A police raid in Detroit in 1967 results in one of the largest citizens' uprisings in the history of the United States.
tagline: It's time we knew
title: Detroit
plot:
Detroit is a powerful and thought-provoking film that delves into the dark and tumultuous history of racial tensions and police brutality in America during the 1960s. The movie, directed by Kathryn Bigelow, tells the story of the Algiers Motel incident, where 11 African American men were brutally assaulted and killed by the Detroit Police Department.

At its core, Detroit is a film about the devastating consequences of systemic racism and the failure of institutions to uphold justice and equality. The movie shines a light on the long history of police brutality and corruption in America, highlighting how these actions are often perpetuated by those in power and enabled by a system that prioritizes order over justice.

The film also explores the theme of trauma and its lasting impact on individuals and communities. The characters, particularly Melvin Dismukes (played by John Boyega), are forced to confront their traumatic experiences and find ways to cope with the pain and anger that lingers long after the events have passed.

Furthermore, Detroit touches on the idea of resistance and resilience in the face of oppression. Despite being subjected to unimaginable violence and humiliation, the characters refuse to be silenced or defeated. Instead, they find ways to resist, to fight back, and to demand justice for themselves and their community.

Throughout the film, Bigelow masterfully weaves together a narrative that is both deeply personal and universally relatable. The movie is a powerful indictment of systemic racism and police brutality, but it is also a testament to the strength and resilience of those who have been marginalized and oppressed. Ultimately, Detroit is a film about hope, survival, and the human spirit's capacity to persevere in the face of unimaginable adversity.

overview: When soldier Robin happens upon the dying Robert of Loxley, he promises to return the man's sword to his family in Nottingham. There, he assumes Robert's identity; romances his widow, Marion; and draws the ire of the town's sheriff and King John's henchman, Godfrey.
tagline: Rise and rise again, until lambs become lions.
title: Robin Hood
plot:
Robin Hood is a 2010 historical action film directed by Ridley Scott and written by Brian Helgeland from a story by Helgeland, Ethan Reiff and Cyrus Voris. Russell Crowe stars as the outlaw of legend, with Cate Blanchett, William Hurt, Mark Strong, Mark Addy, Oscar Isaac, Danny Huston, Eileen Atkins and Max von Sydow. A 2007 spec script centred on the Sheriff of Nottingham was rewritten to tell how Robin Hood became an outlaw.

In 1199 Robin Longstride is a common archer in the army of King Richard the Lionheart at the siege of Chalus Castle. He gives the king a frank assessment of his conduct and is put in the stocks with his comrades Allan A'Dayle, Will Scarlett and Little John. After Richard is killed in the assault, they desert and come across an ambush of the royal guard by Godfrey, an English knight conspiring with King Philip of France. Posing as the dead knights to secure passage home, and Robin promises the dying Sir Robert of Loxley that he will return his sword to his father in Nottingham. Arriving in England, Robin, still posing as Loxley, delivers Richard's crown and witnesses the coronation of King John, who imposes harsh new taxes and sends Godfrey north to collect them, unaware that Godfrey plans to use French troops to stir up unrest ahead of a French invasion. In Nottingham, Loxley's elderly, blind father Sir Walter asks Robin to keep impersonating his son so that the Crown cannot seize the family's lands, and Loxley's widow, Lady Marian, initially cold, warms to him after he recovers grain for the townspeople. When the northern barons rise against John, Robin persuades the king to accept a charter of rights to unite the country against the invasion. French raiders plunder Nottingham and Godfrey kills Sir Walter before Robin and the barons arrive. On the beach below the cliffs of Dover, Robin leads the united English army against the French landing, with Marian joining the fight, and kills Godfrey with an arrow, forcing Philip to abandon the invasion. Seeing the French surrender to Robin rather than to him, John breaks his promise of the charter and declares Robin an outlaw, and Robin, his men and Nottingham's orphans retreat to Sherwood Forest to right the wrongs of the kingdom.

Filmed across England and Wales from March 2009, Robin Hood premiered at the Cannes Film Festival on 12 May 2010, the day of its British release. It received mixed reviews, with a 43% Rotten Tomatoes rating, and grossed $322 million worldwide.

overview: For best friends Becky and Hunter, life is all about conquering fears and pushing limits. But after they climb 2,000 feet to the top of a remote, abandoned radio tower, they find themselves stranded with no way down. Now Becky and Hunter’s expert climbing skills will be put to the ultimate test as they desperately fight to survive the elements, a lack of supplies, and vertigo-inducing heights
tagline: Fear reaches new heights.
title: Fall
plot:
Fall is a 2022 survival psychological thriller directed by Scott Mann, who wrote it with Jonathan Frank. It stars Grace Caroline Currey, Virginia Gardner, Mason Gooding and Jeffrey Dean Morgan, and follows two best friends stranded atop a 2,000-foot television broadcast tower.

While climbing a mountain with her friend Shiloh Hunter, Becky Connor watches her husband, Dan, fall to his death after a bat startles him. A year later, Becky has quit climbing and contemplates suicide, and she is estranged from her father, James. Near the anniversary, Shiloh persuades her to climb the decommissioned B-67 TV tower in the desert before its demolition and scatter Dan's ashes from the summit. The two ascend rusted ladders to a tiny platform at the top, where Shiloh films for her YouTube channel. As they start down, the ladder collapses, leaving them stranded far above the next intact section, with Becky's thigh cut and their backpack, holding water and a small drone, lying on a dish below.

Their phones have no signal near the dish, so Shiloh drops hers in a shoe, hoping a message to her followers will get through. They fail to attract a passing man and his dog, and when they fire a flare at night, two men camping nearby steal Shiloh's car instead of helping. Becky notices a tattoo on Shiloh's ankle matching Dan's code for "I love you", and Shiloh confesses to a four-month affair with him before the wedding. Shiloh lowers herself on the rope to retrieve the backpack, and Becky hauls her back. Using power from the tower's warning light, Becky charges the drone and sends it toward a motel with a plea for help, but a truck destroys it. Delirious, she realizes that Shiloh actually fell to her death onto the dish while retrieving the bag, and that she has been hallucinating her ever since. After killing and eating a vulture that attacked her, Becky climbs down to the dish, places her phone with a message to her father inside Shiloh's shoe and pushes the body off the tower so it cushions the phone's fall. The message sends, James summons rescuers, and father and daughter reconcile.

Mann conceived the idea while filming at height on another project and shot the film in IMAX in California's Mojave Desert. Lionsgate released it on August 12, 2022, and it grossed about $21.8 million against a $3 million budget. Reviews were generally positive, at 80% on Rotten Tomatoes and 62 on Metacritic, with praise for the two leads and criticism of the visual effects and script.

overview: Mort Rainey, a writer just emerging from a painful divorce with his ex-wife, is stalked at his remote lake house by a psychotic stranger and would-be scribe who claims Rainey swiped his best story idea. But as Rainey endeavors to prove his innocence, he begins to question his own sanity.
tagline: The most important part of a story is the ending.
title: Secret Window
plot:
Secret Window is a psychological thriller film directed by David Koepp, based on the novella "Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption" by Stephen King. The movie stars Johnny Depp as Mort Rainey, a successful writer of children's books who has lost his muse.

The story begins with Mort Rainey (Johnny Depp) returning to his hometown of Castle Rock, Maine, after a long absence. He is greeted by his ex-wife, Delia (Mary Steenburgen), and her new husband, Alan Pangborn (John Cusack). The tension between Mort and Delia is palpable, as they have a complicated history.

Mort's life takes a turn for the worse when he encounters a mysterious stranger named Ted Brautigan (James Franco) at a local bar. Brautigan claims to be an old friend of Mort's from his childhood, but Mort is skeptical. Despite this, Brautigan convinces Mort to let him stay with him in his home.

As the days pass, Mort becomes increasingly unsettled by Brautigan's presence. He begins to suspect that Brautigan is not who he claims to be and starts to investigate his past. Meanwhile, Alan Pangborn, a detective, becomes suspicious of Brautigan as well, due to a series of strange occurrences in Castle Rock.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Brautigan has a dark secret: he is a writer who has been using Mort's stories without permission. He has also been manipulating Delia and Alan, using his charm and charisma to get what he wants. But Brautigan's true intentions are far more sinister.

In a shocking twist, it is revealed that Brautigan has been using Mort's stories as inspiration for his own writing, but with a dark and twisted spin. He has also been manipulating Delia into helping him, using her as a pawn in his game of revenge against Mort.

As the tension builds, Mort becomes more and more desperate to uncover the truth about Brautigan. In a thrilling climax, he confronts Brautigan at his home, where a violent confrontation ensues. In the end, Mort emerges victorious, but not without scars.

The movie ends with Mort reflecting on the events that have transpired. He realizes that he has been given a second chance to rediscover his muse and find inspiration for his writing again. The film concludes on a hopeful note, as Mort looks out at the lake, symbolizing his newfound freedom and creativity.

Overall, Secret Window is a gripping thriller that explores themes of identity, creativity, and the power of storytelling. With outstanding performances from Johnny Depp and John Cusack, this movie is a must-see for fans of psychological suspense.

overview: A group of friends plan out a detailed heist that turns deadly when one betrays the other by taking off with the goods. Taking matters into his own hands, Sonny seeks out his revenge teaming up with the most dangerous mob boss in town to get back what is rightfully his. When he finally comes face to face with his longtime friend he will be forced to make a life changing choice.
title: Setup
plot:
Setup is a 2011 direct-to-video action thriller heist film directed by Mike Gunther, who wrote it with Mike Behrman. Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson stars as Sonny, with Bruce Willis as the mob boss Biggs and Ryan Phillippe as Vincent, and the cast also includes Jenna Dewan as Mia, Randy Couture as Petey, James Remar as William and Brett Granstaff as Dave. It was shot in Grand Rapids, Michigan, in late 2010.

In Detroit, three friends, Sonny, Dave and Vincent, carefully plan a heist of $5 million in diamonds, but Vincent betrays the others and shoots them both. Dave dies, while Sonny survives and seeks revenge by allying himself with Biggs, the most dangerous mob boss in town, in order to recover the money from the heist. Biggs sends Sonny with his henchman Petey to dig up $2 million buried in a cemetery, but Petey accidentally shoots himself. Sonny follows a woman named Mia to the home of the fence who handled the stolen goods and threatens him, and the frightened fence warns Vincent that he must deal with the loose end he left behind, only to be killed by Vincent. While Biggs's men brutally interrogate others to learn what happened to Petey, Vincent seeks help to eliminate Sonny, and Sonny visits Dave's grave and then Vincent's imprisoned father, asking whether there is anything he would like said to his son before Sonny kills him.
