As panic sweeps Ember, the mayor shuts himself in his vault and is eaten by the mole. The children reach the surface and see their first sunrise, then find Ember far below through a hole in the ground and drop a rock bearing directions out, which lands at Loris's feet.

Saoirse Ronan plays Lina, with Harry Treadaway as Doon, Bill Murray as Mayor Cole, Tim Robbins as Loris and Martin Landau as Sul. Reviews were mixed, with 53% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and praise for its visuals and cast but complaints of too little action. It grossed only about $17.9 million against a $55 million budget.

overview: Frank Allen, a professional speaker who lectures on time management has a perfectly ordered and scheduled life, down to the minute. When his wife sets his clock forward 10 minutes as a joke, his day is thrown off. Deciding that his strictly ordered life has done him little good, he begins to make multiple choice index cards, choosing one at random and doing what is written on the card.
tagline: This man will bring order to the universe...or not.
title: Chaos Theory
plot:
Chaos Theory is a 2008 American comedy-drama directed by Marcos Siega from a screenplay by Daniel Taplitz, starring Ryan Reynolds, Emily Mortimer and Stuart Townsend. It was filmed in Coquitlam and Squamish, British Columbia.

On the morning of his wedding to Jesse Allen, Ed gets cold feet after learning she slept with one of his friends while they were on a break. Jesse's father, Frank, corners him and tells the story of his own marriage to Jesse's mother, Susan. Years earlier, Frank and his friend Buddy both loved Susan, who picked Frank on New Year's Eve. Eight years on, Frank is a time-management lecturer who plans every minute of his day, and they have a seven-year-old daughter, Jesse. One morning Susan secretly resets the clocks to buy him ten minutes for an errand but moves them the wrong way, and he misses the ferry and arrives late to an important seminar. At his hotel, Paula, from his lecture, makes a pass at him, and later answers when Susan calls. Driving home, Frank nearly collides with Nancy, a pregnant woman in labor, takes her to hospital and mistakenly fills in his own details on the forms. When Nancy abandons the baby, the hospital calls the Allen home, and Susan, convinced Frank is living a double life, throws him out.

A paternity test to prove the baby is not his reveals that Frank has Klinefelter syndrome and has been sterile since birth, meaning he cannot be Jesse's father either. Nancy returns for her baby and clears things up with Susan, but Frank, devastated, refuses her calls. When he confides in Buddy, Buddy realizes he fathered Jesse during a one-night stand with Susan just before her engagement, tells Susan about Frank's infertility and tries to court her. Frank starts making decisions by drawing index cards at random and invites Paula to his room, but nothing happens because he still loves Susan. On seeing Buddy's roses at home, he grasps the truth and lures Buddy onto a boat with murderous intent, only for both to fall into the lake and Buddy to save him. Learning that Susan loves him, Frank reconciles with her. Back in the present, Ed realizes he loves Jesse, and Frank walks his daughter down the aisle.

Reynolds plays Frank, Mortimer plays Susan, Townsend plays Buddy, Sarah Chalke plays Paula and Elisabeth Harnois plays the adult Jesse. The film did poorly at the box office and received 31% approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: The story of Danièle Delpeuch and how she was appointed as the private chef for François Mitterrand.
title: Haute Cuisine
plot:
Haute Cuisine is a French drama film that explores the complexities of human relationships and the struggles of maintaining one's identity in a high-pressure environment. The movie delves into the world of haute cuisine, where the protagonist, Claire Delaunay, navigates the cutthroat kitchen landscape with precision and passion.

At its core, Haute Cuisine is a story about the tension between creativity and conformity. Claire, a talented young chef, finds herself torn between her desire to innovate and push boundaries in the kitchen, and the expectations of those around her who value tradition and consistency. As she rises through the ranks, she must confront the compromises that come with success and the sacrifices she must make to maintain her artistic vision.

The film also explores themes of loneliness and isolation, as Claire's relationships with her colleagues and mentors are fraught with tension and unspoken emotions. Her character is a symbol of the artist who struggles to find her place in the world, and the movie raises questions about the cost of ambition and the importance of staying true to oneself.

Ultimately, Haute Cuisine is a nuanced exploration of the human condition, one that reveals the complexities and contradictions of its characters as they navigate the challenges of their profession. The film's thoughtful pacing and attention to detail create a rich and immersive world that draws the viewer in and refuses to let go.

overview: Based on a true story, this riveting western follows a headstrong New York widow as she journeys west to meet Sioux chief Sitting Bull, facing off with an army officer intent on war with Native Americans.
tagline: Defy your times
title: Woman Walks Ahead
plot:
Woman Walks Ahead is a biographical Western drama of 2017 directed by Susanna White and written by Steven Knight. Jessica Chastain plays Catherine Weldon, a character inspired by the real Caroline Weldon, a New York portrait painter who travels to the Dakotas in 1890 to paint Sitting Bull, played by Michael Greyeyes. Sam Rockwell appears as the army officer Colonel Silas Grove, Ciarán Hinds as the Indian agent James McLaughlin and Bill Camp as General Crook.

Recently widowed, Catherine writes to Sitting Bull through McLaughlin at Fort Yates, asking to make his portrait. The agent secretly destroys the letter and orders her detained. On the train the colonel advises her to go home. When she arrives, a passerby steals her trunk and art supplies, and at Fort Yates she is confined overnight; the colonel returns her stolen belongings and warns her that the recent fighting between the army and the Lakota is far from forgotten. Next morning Sitting Bull's nephew, an agency employee, takes her to him. Sitting Bull agrees to sit for $1,000, and she stays on the reservation. The colonel warns her not to raise the Lakota's hopes, since a treaty taking more of their land is about to be ratified and General Crook and the 7th Cavalry are on their way.

Sitting Bull first appears for the portrait in an ordinary suit, then changes into traditional buckskins at Catherine's request. Returning, they find the village empty: the people have seen a draft of the treaty, which would halve their rations and take their land, and suspecting Catherine of being a spy, have joined a Ghost Dance. Catherine buys all the food in town for the reservation and is beaten by townsmen for it. Recovering, she announces at a dinner with Crook that she will fight the treaty, and campaigns alongside Sitting Bull, whose arrival at the vote silences the chiefs bribed to testify falsely. The treaty is overwhelmingly rejected, but the colonel tells her this gives the army its pretext for war. Sitting Bull, foreseeing his death that winter, sees the finished portrait before the colonel warns him in Lakota of an arrest at dawn and carries Catherine off for her safety. During the arrest, a hidden sniper shoots Sitting Bull dead. Closing titles note the Wounded Knee massacre that followed and Catherine's lifelong advocacy.

The film premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival in September 2017 and was released by A24 and DirecTV Cinema in 2018. Reviews were mixed, praising the two leads.

overview: Comedian and actress Atsuko Okatsuka brings her brand of ingenious, offbeat storytelling to the Elsewhere stage in Brooklyn, New York where she dishes on the futile art of impressing teenagers, attending a “Magic Mike Live” show with her grandmother, and the alarming reactions that she and her husband had to the unwanted presence of an intruder.
title: Atsuko Okatsuka: The Intruder
plot:
Kinsey is a biographical drama film that explores the life of Alfred Kinsey, an American sex researcher and professor at Indiana University. The movie delves into the complexities of human sexuality, challenging societal norms and taboos surrounding sex and relationships.

At its core, Kinsey is a story about the power of curiosity, intellectual freedom, and the pursuit of knowledge. The film follows Kinsey's journey as he conducts groundbreaking research on human sexuality, collecting data through interviews with thousands of people from all walks of life. This approach allows him to challenge conventional wisdom and shed light on the diversity of human experiences.

The movie also touches on themes of repression, conformity, and the constraints placed on individuals who dare to question societal norms. Kinsey's work is met with resistance and criticism from some quarters, highlighting the tension between personal freedom and social expectations.

Furthermore, Kinsey explores the complexities of relationships, particularly in the context of his own life. The film portrays a nuanced portrayal of Kinsey's personal struggles, including his unrequited love for a colleague, which serves as a counterpoint to his professional achievements.

Ultimately, Kinsey is a thought-provoking film that encourages viewers to think critically about their assumptions and biases surrounding sex, relationships, and human behavior.

overview: The story of how social networks and instant messengers are changing the life of a modern person. It has been several years since a 16-year-old teenager posted a photo of his girlfriend in the general chat, hoping to boast to friends. Now he has a happy adult life: work, friends, fiance Katya, who is about to become his wife. But the Internet makes you remember teenage love, after which a chain of inexplicable mystical events occurs with the future wife of a young man. The girl receives mysterious messages from her fiance's past. Because of them, her life turns into a nightmare.
tagline: She'll Never Forgive
title: The Ex
plot:
The Ex (Russian: Byvshaya) is a 2021 Russian supernatural horror thriller directed by Evgeny Puzyrevsky, his feature-length directorial debut, from a screenplay credited to Veronika Voznyak, Pyotr Tochilin and Vladimir Batrameev. Produced by KARO-Production with Force Media, it was released in Russian cinemas on 11 March 2021 under the English tagline "She'll Never Forgive". The film is framed as a cautionary tale about how social networks and messaging apps shape modern life, and how a careless online act from adolescence can return years later.

The story opens with Sasha, a sixteen-year-old who wants to impress his friends and posts a doctored picture of himself with an attractive girl in a group chat. Seven years later he is a successful young man living in Moscow and preparing to marry his beloved fiancée Katya. Their contentment is disturbed when Sasha receives a message from the same girl asking to meet him, while Katya begins to suffer terrifying visions of a female ghost. Katya learns that the girl, Masha, with whom Sasha had once corresponded online, recently killed her own former fiancé in a bloody attack and then took her own life. Believing that a church wedding will protect them, the couple marry quickly, but the ceremony fails to stop the spirit, which goes on killing anyone who gets in its way. Guided by a priest fighting to save Sasha's life, Katya must arrange a funeral service for Masha, whose body has still not been buried and whose soul has been seized by a demonic force.

Konstantin Beloshapka plays Sasha and Vera Kincheva plays Katya, with Zhanna Danilova as Masha, Elena Morozova as Masha's mother, Sergey Dvoynikov and Yekaterina Shumakova as the couple's friends Oleg and Zhenya, and Vladimir Seleznyov as the priest, Father Aleksei.

Made on a reported budget of about 50 million rubles, the film earned roughly 290,000 US dollars in Russia. Reviewing it for Kinoafisha, Asya Zabolotskaya called it a stereotypical horror film in a Russian setting that borrows the style of American B-movies. She felt the horror atmosphere worked reasonably well and that the cast approached the material with real affection, and she noted the sepia-tinted look of locations such as an empty hospital. However, she found the suspense built on familiar devices like jarring music, sudden blackouts and slow camera moves, criticised the uneven, television-style dramaturgy, and suggested the plot would be forgotten soon after viewing.

overview: The newly married Elizabeth arrives with her new husband, the scientist Henry, at a magnificent house. He tells her that she can do there anything she pleases, except to enter a certain closed room.
title: Elizabeth Harvest
plot:
Elizabeth Harvest is a psychological thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy. The film follows Elizabeth, a young woman who returns to her hometown after being away for several years, only to find herself entangled in a web of secrets and lies.

At its core, Elizabeth Harvest explores the theme of trauma and its lasting impact on individuals. Elizabeth's past is shrouded in mystery, and as she tries to rebuild her life, she begins to confront the traumas that have haunted her for so long. The film masterfully weaves together elements of psychological suspense, creating a sense of unease and tension that keeps the viewer on edge.

The movie also touches on the theme of identity and how it can be manipulated and distorted by external forces. Elizabeth's perception of reality is constantly challenged, leaving the audience questioning what is real and what is just a product of her imagination. This theme is expertly handled, creating a sense of uncertainty that adds to the overall sense of unease.

Furthermore, the film explores the idea of isolation and how it can both isolate and liberate individuals. Elizabeth's return to her hometown serves as a catalyst for her journey of self-discovery, but it also forces her to confront the darkness that has been lurking beneath the surface of her small town.

Overall, Elizabeth Harvest is a thought-provoking thriller that delves into the complexities of human psychology and the darker aspects of human nature.

overview: Katniss Everdeen reluctantly becomes the symbol of a mass rebellion against the autocratic Capitol.
tagline: Fire burns brighter in the darkness
title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
plot:
The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1 is a 2014 dystopian science fiction film directed by Francis Lawrence, based on the third book of Suzanne Collins' Hunger Games trilogy. The movie is produced by Lionsgate.

In this installment, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has become the face of the rebellion against the oppressive Capitol. After being rescued from the arena in Catching Fire, Katniss is taken to District 13, where she meets President Coin (Julianne Moore), the leader of the rebellion.

Katniss is forced to participate in a propaganda campaign to rally the districts and gain support for the rebellion. She becomes the Mockingjay, the symbol of hope and defiance against the Capitol. However, Katniss struggles with the moral implications of her role as the face of the rebellion and the weight of responsibility that comes with it.

Meanwhile, Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson), who was captured by the Capitol during the 74th Hunger Games, is being used as a propaganda tool to show the brutality of the Capitol's actions. Katniss and Peeta are forced to pretend to be in love again, but their feelings for each other remain complex.

As the war escalates, Katniss becomes increasingly disillusioned with President Coin's leadership and the true intentions of the rebellion. She also begins to question her own identity and purpose as a symbol of hope.

The film ends with Katniss realizing that she has been manipulated by President Coin and the rebellion, and that she must take control of her own destiny. The stage is set for the final installment of the trilogy, where Katniss will face off against President Snow in a battle to save Panem.

Overall, The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1 is a thought-provoking and emotionally charged film that explores themes of war, propaganda, and the complexities of leadership. Jennifer Lawrence delivers a powerful performance as Katniss Everdeen, bringing depth and nuance to the character's struggles with her role in the rebellion.

Rating: 4.5/5 stars

Note: The movie is divided into two parts, hence Part 1.

overview: The most dangerous and exciting car race in the universe is held only once every five years. And that's tonight. The competitors are lined up at the starting block. In his vehicle, JP, the most daredevil driver on the circuit, is ready for the green light. Female driver Sonoshee, with whom he is secretly in love, is also on the starting line. She will stop at nothing to get on to that podium. In this race, not only is anything possible, but also anything is allowed. In fact, their adversaries have modified their vehicles to equip them with highly destructive weapons; with such participants, it is hardly surprising that Redline is forbidden by the authorities, who will try anything to halt the proceedings.
title: Redline
plot:
Redline is a 2009 Japanese animated science fiction racing film produced by Madhouse and directed by Takeshi Koike in his directorial debut, written by Katsuhito Ishii, Yōji Enokido and Yoshiki Sakurai from Ishii's story. Its voice cast includes Takuya Kimura, Yū Aoi, Tatsuya Gashūin, Takeshi Aono and Tadanobu Asano.

On the planet Dorothy, "Sweet" JP competes in the Yellowline, the last qualifier for the Redline. His mechanic and friend Frisbee has fixed the race with a mafia boss, and when JP pushes for first instead of second, Frisbee remotely detonates a bomb hidden in JP's car, handing victory to the racer Sonoshee McLaren. Recovering in the hospital, JP learns he has been voted into the Redline after two qualifiers withdraw, because the race will be held on Roboworld, a planet ruled by militant cyborgs whose President has threatened to hang anyone involved. The racers gather on a demilitarized moon of Roboworld, where JP recruits the junk dealer Old Man Mole, who reluctantly accepts Frisbee and his dangerously powerful engine, and Roboworld's Colonel Volton warns the racers that the military will crush the event.

Saboteurs hired by the race commission disable an orbital cannon meant to destroy the Redline mothership as it exits hyperspace, while rebellious miners attack the military's power station. Furious, the President sends his army against the racers as they head into a mined zone hiding Funky Boy, a giant illegal bioweapon that awakens as they approach. The army shells it, wrecking much of the field; JP rights his overturned car and picks up Sonoshee, whose vehicle is destroyed, and Volton defeats Funky Boy by merging with another bioweapon. Frisbee, offered the same rigged deal, refuses to trigger the bomb this time and is rescued from the mobsters by Old Man Mole. In a neck-and-neck finish with the reigning champion, Machinehead, a drunken Mole accidentally sets off the explosive, hurling JP and Sonoshee over the line, and JP wins by the length of his pompadour before the two declare their love.

Redline took seven years to make and used more than 100,000 hand-drawn frames. It premiered at the Locarno International Film Festival on August 14, 2009, and opened in Japan on October 9, 2010. A box-office failure, it found success on home video and became a cult film; Anime News Network gave it an A+, calling it insanely exhilarating.

overview: Jean and Sara have been living together for 10 years. When they first met, Sara was living with François, Jean’s best friend and an admirer from back when he played rugby. Jean and Sara love each other. One day, Sara sees François in the street. He does not notice her, but she is overtaken by the sensation that her life could suddenly change. François gets back in touch with Jean. For the first time in years. He suggests they start working together again. From here on, things spiral out of control.
title: Both Sides of the Blade
plot:
Both Sides of the Blade (Avec amour et acharnement, literally "With Love and Fury"), at first marketed in English as Fire, is a French romantic drama of 2022 directed by Claire Denis, who wrote the screenplay with Christine Angot, adapting Angot's 2018 novel Un tournant de la vie. Juliette Binoche stars as Sara, with Vincent Lindon as her partner Jean and Grégoire Colin as her former lover François. The supporting cast includes Bulle Ogier as Jean's mother Nelly and Issa Perica as his son Marcus.

The film opens with Sara and Jean on holiday, swimming in the sea and embracing. Back in wintry Paris, Sara presents a radio show. Jean, an ex-convict and onetime professional rugby player, has been an absent father to his mixed-race teenage son Marcus, who is being raised by Jean's mother Nelly in the suburb of Vitry. One day Sara catches sight of her estranged ex-boyfriend François in the street, and the encounter floods her with emotion. François, once a close friend of Jean's as well, is launching a sports agency to recruit young rugby players, and he contacts Jean to offer him work as a talent scout. His return to their lives threatens the relationship Sara and Jean have shared for ten years.

Made under COVID-19 restrictions, the film was shot in Paris, partly at the Maison de la Radio, the headquarters of Radio France, and wrapped in early February 2021. Denis said the lockdowns drew her and the actors closer while also leaving them exhausted, and the pandemic is present on screen: shooting in the Paris Métro, she found it impossible to pretend it did not exist, and characters wear masks in some scenes outside the apartment. The film also marked the acting debut of Hana Magimel, the daughter of Binoche and Benoît Magimel.

The English title comes from a song of the same name written for the film by Stuart A. Staples of Tindersticks and heard at its close. Denis publicly objected to the name Fire, and IFC Films adopted the new title in April 2022.

The film premiered in competition for the Golden Bear at the 72nd Berlin International Film Festival on 12 February 2022, where Denis won the Silver Bear for Best Director. IFC Films gave it a limited American release on 8 July 2022, and Ad Vitam Distribution opened it in France on 31 August, where it opened eighth. It grossed about $1.8 million worldwide. Critics responded warmly, with Rotten Tomatoes' consensus crediting Denis and Binoche for a relationship drama that cuts deep.

overview: In this animated musical, a girl builds a rocket ship and blasts off, hoping to meet a mythical moon goddess.
tagline: Believing is Everything
title: Over the Moon
plot:
Over the Moon is a 2020 animated musical fantasy film produced by Pearl Studio and directed by Glen Keane. The movie follows the story of a young Chinese-American girl named Luna, who dreams of reaching the moon to find her missing father.

The film begins with Luna's life in modern-day San Francisco, where she lives with her mother, Mee-Na. Luna is fascinated by the stories of her ancestors and their connections to the moon, which has been a source of inspiration for her. She spends most of her time reading about Chinese mythology and dreaming of reaching the moon.

One day, Luna discovers an ancient scroll that contains a magical map that supposedly leads to the moon. Believing this is her chance to find her missing father, who was on a mission to the moon when he disappeared, Luna sets out on a journey to follow the map.

Along the way, Luna meets a group of misfit creatures from different cultures and backgrounds, each with their own unique abilities and personalities. There's Bao, a Chinese dumpling robot; Noisemakers, a trio of Japanese drums who can create powerful sounds; and Lala, an Indian peacock who can fly.

Together, the group faces various obstacles and challenges as they journey through the sky, encountering fierce storms, treacherous mountains, and even a giant dragon. Along the way, Luna learns valuable lessons about friendship, perseverance, and believing in herself.

As they near their destination, the group discovers that the moon is actually a magical realm filled with wonders and dangers. They meet the Moon Goddess, who reveals that she has been watching over Luna's father and guiding him on his journey.

The group soon realizes that Luna's father was not just searching for the moon but also trying to find a way to bring people together across cultures and borders. The Moon Goddess tells Luna that her father's mission is complete, and it's time for her to take over.

In the end, Luna and her friends successfully reach the moon and help the Moon Goddess restore balance to the universe. Along the way, Luna discovers her own connection to the moon and finds out that she has inherited her father's determination and spirit.

The movie ends with Luna returning home to San Francisco, but not before sharing stories of her incredible journey with her mother and friends. The film concludes on a hopeful note, emphasizing the importance of cultural exchange, understanding, and unity.

Overall, Over the Moon is a heartwarming and visually stunning animated film that celebrates diversity, creativity, and the power of imagination.

overview: George, a lonely and fatalistic teen who's made it all the way to his senior year without ever having done a real day of work, is befriended by Sally, a popular but complicated girl who recognizes in him a kindred spirit.
tagline: The toughest lesson is love.
title: The Art of Getting By
plot:
The Art of Getting By is a 2011 American coming-of-age romantic comedy-drama film that explores the complexities of identity, relationships, and self-discovery.

At its core, the movie delves into the theme of finding one's place in the world. The protagonist, George Zinavoy, played by Freddie Highmore, is a charismatic but aimless high school senior struggling to define himself outside of his privileged upbringing. As he navigates his relationships with those around him, including his enigmatic classmate Sally Howe, played by Emma Roberts, George must confront the tension between his desire for independence and his need for connection.

The film also touches on the theme of social hierarchy and the complexities of high school cliques. The characters' interactions are often marked by a sense of superficiality, as they navigate the intricate web of relationships and alliances that define their world. However, beneath this façade lies a deeper exploration of vulnerability, empathy, and genuine human connection.

Furthermore, The Art of Getting By examines the challenges of transitioning from adolescence to adulthood. George's journey is marked by a series of awkward encounters, missteps, and epiphanies as he grapples with the uncertainty of his future. Through his experiences, the film offers a nuanced portrayal of the struggles and triumphs that accompany this pivotal stage of life.

Ultimately, the movie presents a poignant and relatable exploration of what it means to be young, in love, and searching for one's place in the world.

overview: In the Barrio of Oak Springs live a strong and stubborn group of elderly friends who refuse to be gentrified. Their leader, Lupita, keeps them together as a community, a family. But little did they know, their beloved Bingo hall is about to be sold to a much more powerful force than money itself.
tagline: Are you feeling lucky?
title: Bingo Hell
plot:
Bingo Hell is a 2021 American comedy horror film directed by Gigi Saul Guerrero, who wrote the screenplay with Shane McKenzie and Perry Blackshear. The fifth entry in the Welcome to the Blumhouse anthology series, it stars Adriana Barraza as Lupita, an elderly resident of the town of Oak Springs, with L. Scott Caldwell as her friend Dolores, Richard Brake as the sinister Mr. Big, Joshua Caleb Johnson as Dolores's grandson Caleb, Clayton Landey as Morris and Bertila Damas as the hairdresser Yolanda.

Mario, who has just sold the town's bingo hall, comes home in a daze, talks to a picture of his dead wife about the sale and, coaxed by an ominous voice, gorges himself on bingo balls until he chokes to death. The next morning Lupita makes her rounds of Oak Springs, visiting her friend Clarence at his auto repair shop and Yolanda at her salon. Dolores, meanwhile, is angry with her daughter-in-law Raquel for failing to discipline Caleb, a boy who breaks into cars, and she bristles when Lupita compares Caleb to her late son. A bingo night is cut short because Mario has not paid the electricity bill. Soon flyers announce that the hall is under new management, and Lupita and her friends find that it has been turned into a glitzy casino, where Raquel wins ten thousand dollars from the owner, Mr. Big. The next morning Raquel is gone, along with her winnings. After Clarence wins one hundred thousand dollars, he unknowingly drinks motor oil while celebrating and dies after sticking his arm into a car motor. Finding his body and seeing Morris receive a disintegrating stamp on his hand from Mr. Big, Lupita realizes the whole town is being lured into the hall. She heads there with Eric and her shotgun; when Caleb, blaming the place for his mother's disappearance, tries to break in, Eric chases him inside, and Mr. Big kills Eric. When Mr. Big begins crushing Lupita's head against a podium, Caleb shoots him in the back. Lupita destroys the TV, the residents turn on Mr. Big, and Caleb sets fire to the money as they escape, leaving him to burn.

Filmed in New Orleans in early 2021, Bingo Hell premiered at Fantastic Fest on 24 September 2021 and was released by Amazon Studios on 1 October. It holds a 66% Rotten Tomatoes rating, with a consensus describing it as moderately effective, socially conscious horror.

overview: While doing a friend a favor and searching for a runaway teenager, a police detective stumbles upon a bizarre band of criminals about to pull off a bank robbery.
tagline: HE was more than a cop. SHE was more than a thief.
title: No Good Deed
plot:
No Good Deed, also known as The House on Turk Street, is an American crime thriller of 2002 directed by Bob Rafelson, his last feature film. Christopher Cannan and Steve Barancik wrote the screenplay, updating Dashiell Hammett's 1924 story "The House in Turk Street". Samuel L. Jackson stars as the police detective Jack Friar, with Milla Jovovich as Erin, Stellan Skarsgård as the gang leader Tyrone, Doug Hutchison as the volatile Hoop and Joss Ackland and Grace Zabriskie as the Quarres.

Jack, a diabetic auto-theft detective and amateur cellist, is about to leave for a week of music-making when a neighbor begs him to bring home her runaway teenage daughter. His search leads him to a house on Turk Street, where he stumbles by chance onto a crew in the final stages of a bank robbery: a multimillion-dollar computer heist masterminded by the meticulous Tyrone. The gang's hideout is fronted by a harmless-looking older couple, the Quarres, and the plan depends on David, a bank official who believes Erin is in love with him. The criminals tie Jack to a chair.

Erin, Tyrone's glamorous girlfriend, turns out to be a skilled manipulator who quietly plays the men in her life against one another. Hoop imagines they will ditch Tyrone and take the money. When the others leave to carry out the robbery, Erin is left alone to guard Jack. The two share secrets; Tyrone, he learns, brought her from Russia, where she was a piano prodigy. When Jack slips into a diabetic coma, she fetches insulin from his house and brings back his cello, and later unties him for an intimate, erotically charged cello lesson. Tied up again, he tries to burn through his bonds over a flame on the kitchen stove. Meanwhile Mr. Quarre waits to fly the robbers away. The heist proceeds until David refuses to hand over a password-protected disk holding the transfer data unless he sees Erin, and Hoop reacts violently. Caught between her loyalty to her partners and her growing feelings for the captive, Erin keeps all three men guessing, and Jack cannot tell whether she is sincere or manipulating him too. The ending strikes the cynical, unsentimental note of classic film noir.

The film was screened at the 24th Moscow International Film Festival in June 2002, opened first in Italy that autumn and reached American theaters in September 2003. Made for about $12 million, it grossed about $1.4 million. Reviews were mostly negative; Roger Ebert, however, called it an absorbing, atmospheric noir.

overview: As two evil sisters prepare to conquer the land, two renegades—Eric the Huntsman, who aided Snow White in defeating Ravenna in Snowwhite and the Huntsman, and his forbidden lover, Sara—set out to stop them.
tagline: The story before Snow White
title: The Huntsman: Winter's War
plot:
The Huntsman: Winter's War is a 2016 American fantasy adventure film directed by Cedric Nicolas-Troyan, written by Evan Daugherty and Chris Morgan, and starring Chris Hemsworth, Charlize Theron, Emily Blunt, Jessica Chastain, and Tom Savage.

**Beginning**

The film begins with the Huntsman (Chris Hemsworth), a skilled warrior who is tasked by King Magnus (Nathan Jones) to kill his own son, Prince Eric (Tom Savage), as part of a prophecy that foretells the downfall of the kingdom. However, the Huntsman takes pity on Eric and spares his life.

**Plot Development**

The story then jumps forward in time, where we see Eric, now a young man, who has grown up to become a powerful sorcerer. He is being hunted by Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), an evil queen who seeks to destroy all magic in the world and rule with an iron fist.

Meanwhile, Eric meets a young woman named Sara (Emily Blunt), who becomes his love interest and helps him on his quest to defeat Ravenna. The two of them embark on a perilous journey to find the ancient magic that can defeat Ravenna's powers.

**The Huntsman's Quest**

As they journey through treacherous landscapes, the Huntsman is forced to confront his past and make amends for his failure to kill Eric as a child. He joins forces with Sara and Eric to stop Ravenna from obtaining the magical crystal that will give her the power to destroy all magic in the world.

**The Battle**

The final battle takes place at the ancient temple where the magical crystal is hidden. The Huntsman, Sara, and Eric face off against Ravenna and her army of dark creatures. In a thrilling showdown, the three heroes work together to defeat Ravenna and shatter the crystal, saving magic in the world.

**Ending**

In the end, Eric and Sara are able to find happiness together, while the Huntsman is finally able to make amends for his past mistakes. The film concludes with a sense of hope and renewal, as the heroes look towards a brighter future.

Overall, The Huntsman: Winter's War is an action-packed fantasy adventure that explores themes of redemption, love, and the power of magic. While it received mixed reviews from critics, fans of the genre will enjoy the thrilling battles, stunning visuals, and memorable performances from the cast.

original_title: 名探偵コナン 水平線上の陰謀
overview: Fifteen years ago in a barren stretch of the Pacific, a cruise ship collided with an iceberg and was lost at sea. More than a decade later, Hideto Yashiro—a ship engineer—died in a fatal car accident. The unlikely connection between these events only comes to light on the luxury liner St. Aphrodite during her maiden voyage. Aboard it on a much needed vacation, Kogorou Mouri, his daughter Ran, Conan Edogawa, and the Detective Boys enjoy a trip provided by Sonoko Suzuki's family. But their fun is soon cut short when a game of hide-and-seek leads to Sonoko's disappearance.
title: Detective Conan: Strategy Above the Depths
plot:
Detective Conan: Strategy Above the Depths is a mystery film that revolves around the character of Shinichi Kudo, who goes undercover as a high school student to solve a murder case. The movie delves into themes of deception and identity, as Shinichi navigates his dual life as a detective and a high school student.

The story explores the idea of maintaining a facade in order to achieve one's goals, as Shinichi uses his alter ego to gather information and solve the mystery. This theme is further complicated by the fact that Shinichi's true identity is hidden from everyone around him, including his friends and acquaintances.

At the same time, the movie touches on the idea of loyalty and trust, as Shinichi struggles to form genuine connections with those around him while keeping his secret hidden. The film also raises questions about the morality of deception and whether it can be justified in order to achieve a greater good.

Overall, Detective Conan: Strategy Above the Depths is a thought-provoking mystery that explores complex themes of identity, loyalty, and deception, all set against the backdrop of a intriguing whodunit plot.

original_title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
overview: Creatively unfulfilled and facing financial ruin, Nick Cage must accept a $1 million offer to attend the birthday of a dangerous superfan. Things take a wildly unexpected turn when Cage is recruited by a CIA operative and forced to live up to his own legend, channeling his most iconic and beloved on-screen characters in order to save himself and his loved ones.
tagline: Nicolas Cage is Nick Cage.
title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
plot:
The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent is a 2022 American action comedy directed by Tom Gormican, who co-wrote it with Kevin Etten. Nicolas Cage stars as a fictionalized version of himself, alongside Pedro Pascal as Javi Gutiérrez, Sharon Horgan, Lily Mo Sheen, Tiffany Haddish, Ike Barinholtz and Neil Patrick Harris.

Nick Cage's career is stalling after he misses out on several major roles, and he is plagued by visions of "Nicky", his younger, more successful self, while years of neglect have strained his bond with his ex-wife, Olivia, and daughter, Addy. After losing a coveted part and embarrassing himself at Addy's birthday party, he announces his retirement and accepts his agent's offer of $1 million to attend the birthday of Javi, a billionaire fan in Mallorca. Though irritated at first by Javi's neediness, Nick warms to him over a shared love of movies such as The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari and Paddington 2. CIA agents Vivian and Martin then tell Nick that Javi, who they say is an arms dealer, has kidnapped María Delgado, the daughter of a Catalan politician, to force her father out of an election. Doubtful but willing, Nick plants cameras in Javi's compound and announces their film partnership as a pretext to stay and search for María. After an LSD-fueled misadventure, they decide their movie should be about their friendship. When Javi brings Nick's family to the villa, they rebuff Nick's apology.

Javi's cousin Lucas is revealed as the real arms dealer and María's kidnapper; he warns Javi that Nick is working with the CIA and demands that he kill him. Neither man can go through with it, and when Lucas's men attack, they discover Addy has been abducted too. At the CIA safe house, Martin is found dead and Vivian dies holding off Lucas's men. Nick and Olivia pose as a criminal couple to approach Lucas and, though he sees through it, escape with Addy and María, racing for the American embassy as Javi stays behind to delay him. When Lucas corners Nick, Addy throws him a knife and he kills Lucas, a moment that becomes a scene in the film Nick and Javi later complete. At its premiere, Nick congratulates Javi and goes home with his family to watch Paddington 2.

The film premiered at South by Southwest on March 12, 2022, and Lionsgate released it on April 22. It grossed $29.1 million against a $30 million budget. Reviews were positive, with 87% on Rotten Tomatoes and 68 on Metacritic, praising Cage and Pascal's chemistry.

overview: Mary and Joseph make the hard journey to Bethlehem for a blessed event in this retelling of the Nativity story. This meticulously researched and visually lush adaptation of the biblical tale follows the pair on their arduous path to their arrival in a small village, where they find shelter in a quiet manger and Jesus is born.
tagline: Her child would change the world.
title: The Nativity Story
plot:
The Nativity Story is a 2006 American drama film directed by Catherine Hardwicke, produced by New Line Cinema, and written by John Steinbeck IV.

The main themes of The Nativity Story include:

1. **Faith and Spirituality**: The film explores the spiritual journey of Mary, Joseph, and Jesus as they navigate their way to Bethlehem for the census. It highlights the importance of faith, trust, and obedience in the face of uncertainty and adversity.
2. **Love and Sacrifice**: The story showcases the selfless love and sacrifice of Mary, who is willing to give up her own desires and ambitions for the sake of her child. This theme is also reflected in Joseph's willingness to care for Jesus as a father figure.
3. **Identity and Purpose**: As Jesus grows up, he begins to question his purpose and identity. The film explores this theme through his interactions with other characters, including John the Baptist and the Pharisees, who challenge his understanding of himself and his mission.
4. **Human Connection and Community**: The Nativity Story emphasizes the importance of human connection and community in times of need. The film depicts the kindness and generosity of strangers, such as the innkeeper and the shepherds, who provide shelter and support to Mary, Joseph, and Jesus.

The film's narrative is structured around key events from the biblical account of Jesus' birth, including:

* The journey to Bethlehem
* The encounter with the innkeeper
* The visitation by the shepherds
* The birth of Jesus in a manger

Overall, The Nativity Story offers a poignant and thought-provoking exploration of faith, love, identity, and community, set against the backdrop of one of the most significant events in human history.

overview: The men who made millions from a global economic meltdown.
tagline: This is a true story.
title: The Big Short
plot:
The Big Short is a biographical comedy-drama film directed by Adam McKay, released in 2015 by Paramount Pictures. The movie is based on the 2010 book of the same name by Michael Lewis, which chronicles the 2008 financial crisis from the perspective of several individuals who predicted and profited from the collapse.

The film begins with a series of vignettes introducing us to four main characters: Mark Baum (played by Christian Bale), a Wall Street trader; Charlie Geller (played by John Magaro) and Jamie Shipley (played by Finn Wittrock), two young investors; and Dr. Michael Burry (played by Steve Carell), an eccentric hedge fund manager.

In 2005, the housing market is booming, and subprime mortgages are being aggressively marketed to unsuspecting homeowners. Baum, Geller, and Shipley, who have lost their jobs in the financial industry, stumble upon a lucrative investment opportunity: buying mortgage-backed securities (MBS) that are based on these subprime loans.

However, Dr. Burry, an outcast among his peers, has been warning about the impending doom of the housing market for years. He believes that the subprime mortgages will default en masse, causing a catastrophic collapse in the financial system. Despite being ridiculed and dismissed by his colleagues, Burry's predictions are eerily accurate.

As the story unfolds, we see how each character becomes increasingly convinced that the housing market is about to implode. Baum, Geller, and Shipley start buying MBS, while Dr. Burry creates a credit default swap (CDS) to hedge against the potential losses. The CDS allows them to profit from the collapse of the subprime mortgages.

The plot thickens as the characters navigate the complex web of financial instruments and regulatory loopholes that enabled the crisis. They face resistance from their colleagues, who are more interested in making money than warning about the impending disaster.

As the housing market begins to decline, the characters' fortunes change dramatically. Baum's firm is on the verge of bankruptcy, while Dr. Burry's CDS becomes a lucrative investment. The film culminates with the collapse of Lehman Brothers and the subsequent financial crisis.

Throughout the movie, McKay uses satire and humor to critique the excesses of Wall Street and the failures of regulatory oversight. The film features an all-star cast, including Ryan Gosling as Jared Vennett, a Deutsche Bank trader who becomes Dr. Burry's partner in crime.

The Big Short is a thought-provoking and entertaining film that sheds light on one of the most significant financial crises in modern history. By following the stories of these four characters, we gain a deeper understanding of how the crisis unfolded and how some individuals were able to profit from it. The movie ends with a sense of irony and outrage, as the characters reflect on the consequences of their actions and the failures of the system that enabled them.

Overall, The Big Short is a gripping and informative film that provides valuable insights into the world of high finance and the human factors that drive economic behavior.

original_title: A Turtle's Tale 2: Sammy's Escape from Paradise
overview: Sammy and Ray, leatherback turtles and friends forever, are enjoying an atoll's water and sand, shepherding new hatchlings Ricky and Ella out to sea. Suddenly, a poacher swoops in and ships them off to be part of a spectacular aquarium show for tourists in Dubai. The kingpin of the place, Big D the seahorse, enlists them in his plans for a great escape. But with their new friends Jimbo the bug-eyed blob fish and Lulu the snippy lobster, Annabel the sweet Octopus, and a whole family of penguins, Sammy and Ray hatch breakout plans of their own. That is when little Ricky and Ella arrive, determined to break in to rescue them. After a series of thrilling adventures and narrow escapes, our heroes head south to meet up with Shelly, Sammy's first and only love.
title: A Turtle's Tale 2: Sammy's Escape from Paradise
plot:
A Turtle's Tale 2: Sammy's Escape from Paradise is a French-Belgian animated adventure comedy film directed by Ben Stassen and Frédéric Back. The movie follows the story of Sammy, a sea turtle who has been living in a beautiful paradise with his friends.

The main themes of A Turtle's Tale 2: Sammy's Escape from Paradise include:

1. Friendship: The movie highlights the strong bond between Sammy and his friends, particularly his best friend, Helga. Their friendship is put to the test when Sammy decides to leave the paradise to explore the world beyond.
2. Self-discovery: Sammy's journey is also a metaphor for self-discovery. As he navigates through new environments and meets different creatures, he learns more about himself and what he truly wants out of life.
3. Freedom: The movie explores the theme of freedom, as Sammy longs to experience the world beyond his paradise. His desire for freedom drives him to take risks and face challenges that test his courage and determination.
4. Loyalty: Despite his desire for adventure, Sammy ultimately realizes that his true home is with his friends in the paradise. The movie shows that loyalty and commitment to one's loved ones are essential values.

The movie features stunning animation, engaging characters, and a heartwarming story that will appeal to audiences of all ages.

overview: In the smog-choked dystopian Los Angeles of 2019, blade runner Rick Deckard is called out of retirement to terminate a quartet of replicants who have escaped to Earth seeking their creator for a way to extend their short life spans.
tagline: Man has made his match... now it's his problem.
title: Blade Runner
plot:
Blade Runner is a science fiction classic directed by Ridley Scott, released in 1982 by Warner Bros. Pictures. The film is set in a dystopian future Los Angeles in the year 2019 and is based on the novel "Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?" by Philip K. Dick.

The story follows Rick Deckard (Harrison Ford), a bounty hunter known as a blade runner, who works for the Los Angeles Police Department's special task force. Deckard's job is to track down and retire advanced androids called replicants, which are nearly indistinguishable from humans. The replicants were created by the Tyrell Corporation, led by the enigmatic and sinister Dr. Eldon Tyrell (Joe Turkel).

The film begins with Deckard being assigned to hunt down a group of six rogue replicants who have escaped and are seeking to extend their short lifespan. The leader of the group is Roy Batty (Rutger Hauer), a highly advanced replicant who possesses exceptional strength, agility, and intelligence.

As Deckard pursues the replicants, he begins to question his own humanity and the nature of his work. He forms a bond with Rachael (Sean Young), a replicant who is being hunted by Deckard, and together they embark on a journey that challenges their perceptions of reality.

Throughout the film, Deckard's character undergoes significant development as he grapples with the moral implications of his work. He begins to empathize with the replicants, particularly Roy Batty, who delivers a poignant monologue about the fleeting nature of life and the desire for human connection.

As the story unfolds, Deckard and Rachael find themselves on the run from their pursuers, leading to a climactic confrontation with the Tyrell Corporation. In a shocking twist, it is revealed that Deckard himself is a replicant, created by Dr. Tyrell as part of an experiment to test the boundaries between humans and androids.

The film's ending is intentionally ambiguous, leaving the audience to ponder whether Deckard is indeed human or a replicant. The final scene shows Deckard and Rachael standing together on a rooftop, gazing out at the cityscape, as the camera pans up to reveal the sky filled with clouds of ash and smoke, suggesting a post-apocalyptic world.

Blade Runner's exploration of themes such as humanity, empathy, and what it means to be alive continues to resonate with audiences today. The film's visual effects, cinematography, and score have been widely influential, making it a landmark in the science fiction genre.

overview: The story of four characters whose lives intertwine amid the hustle and bustle of the Coney Island amusement park in the 1950s: Ginny, an emotionally volatile former actress now working as a waitress in a clam house; Humpty, Ginny’s rough-hewn carousel operator husband; Mickey, a handsome young lifeguard who dreams of becoming a playwright; and Carolina, Humpty’s long-estranged daughter, who is now hiding out from gangsters at her father’s apartment.
title: Wonder Wheel
plot:
Wonder Wheel is an American period drama of 2017 written and directed by Woody Allen, set on Coney Island in the early 1950s. Kate Winslet stars as Ginny Rannell, a former actress working as a waitress, with Jim Belushi as her husband Humpty, a recovering alcoholic who runs the carousel, Juno Temple as his daughter Carolina, Justin Timberlake as the lifeguard and narrator Mickey Rubin and Tony Sirico and Steve Schirripa as the gangsters Angelo and Nick.

Mickey, an aspiring playwright, narrates to the audience. Carolina turns up on the boardwalk looking for her stepmother Ginny, who works at a clam bar, and asks to move in. Humpty had disowned her for marrying Frank, a mobster, but she explains that she has testified to the FBI about mob activity and believes Frank wants her dead. Humpty lets her stay if she saves for college, and Ginny gets her a waitressing job. When the gangsters come asking, the couple deny seeing her.

Ginny, whose own infidelity ended her happy first marriage, is miserable with the loud-mouthed Humpty and with life on the boardwalk, and her son Richie keeps setting fires. She begins an affair with Mickey, who is drawn to her maturity and sees her as someone to rescue. Humpty, softened by his daughter's presence, pays for her night classes. When Mickey happens to meet Carolina, he is captivated by her story and becomes torn between the two women. Ginny steals to buy Mickey an expensive watch, which he refuses, and grows jealous of his interest in Carolina. Carolina's unsuspecting boss tells the gangsters she has gone to a Brooklyn pizzeria with Mickey. Ginny phones the restaurant to warn her but, seeing a chance to be rid of her rival, hangs up without speaking. That night Mickey confesses his feelings and his affair, and Carolina walks off alone, followed by the mobsters' car. She never comes home. Discovering that Ginny made the silent call, Mickey confronts her; drinking and dressed in one of her old stage costumes, she holds out a knife and begs him to kill her, but he walks away. Humpty, drinking again after the police find no trace of his daughter, tells Ginny he needs her, but she coldly refuses his invitation to join a fishing trip with his friends' wives.

The film closed the 55th New York Film Festival in October 2017 and was released by Amazon Studios on 1 December 2017, grossing $15.9 million. Reviews were mixed, with criticism of the screenplay but praise for Winslet's performance and Vittorio Storaro's cinematography.

overview: McCall believes he has put his mysterious past behind him and dedicated himself to beginning a new, quiet life. But when he meets Teri, a young girl under the control of ultra-violent Russian gangsters, he can’t stand idly by – he has to help her. Armed with hidden skills that allow him to serve vengeance against anyone who would brutalize the helpless, McCall comes out of his self-imposed retirement and finds his desire for justice reawakened. If someone has a problem, if the odds are stacked against them, if they have nowhere else to turn, McCall will help. He is The Equalizer.
tagline: What do you see when you look at me?
title: The Equalizer
plot:
The Equalizer is a 2014 American action-thriller film directed by Antoine Fuqua and written by Richard Wenk. The movie stars Denzel Washington as Robert McCall, a retired CIA operative who uses his skills to help those in need.

The story begins with Robert McCall (Denzel Washington), a quiet and unassuming man living in Boston. He spends most of his days working at Home Depot, where he befriends a young woman named Susan Plummer (Chloë Moretz). Susan is being harassed by her abusive boyfriend, Teddy Madsen (Marton Csokas), who has also been threatening her family.

When Susan's life is in danger, Robert steps in to help her. He uses his skills and resources to gather information about Teddy's past and expose him for the manipulative and violent person he is. As Robert delves deeper into Teddy's world, he discovers that he was involved in a human trafficking ring and has been using his wealth and influence to exploit vulnerable women.

As Robert gets closer to the truth, he attracts the attention of Teddy's associates, who begin to hunt him down. With the help of Susan and her family, Robert must use his skills as a former CIA operative to take down Teddy and his cohorts.

Throughout the movie, Robert's character is revealed through flashbacks, showing his time in the CIA and his experiences during the Cold War. We see that he was once a highly skilled operative who worked undercover, but after leaving the agency, he retired from the spy game and tried to live a quiet life.

As the story unfolds, Robert faces off against Teddy's men in a series of intense battles. He uses his knowledge of hand-to-hand combat and marksmanship to take down his opponents, often using unconventional methods to outsmart them.

In the climactic final confrontation, Robert faces off against Teddy in a tense showdown. With the help of Susan and her family, Robert is able to expose Teddy's true nature and bring him to justice.

The movie ends with Robert reflecting on his actions and the consequences of his decisions. He realizes that he has been living a lie, pretending to be an ordinary man when in reality, he was always meant for something more. The film concludes with Robert walking away from the chaos, ready to start anew and leave his past life behind.

Overall, The Equalizer is a gripping action-thriller that showcases Denzel Washington's signature style and charisma. With its intricate plot and well-developed characters, the movie keeps viewers on the edge of their seats until the very end.

overview: Like some other kids, 12-year-old Trevor McKinney believed in the goodness of human nature. Like many other kids, he was determined to change the world for the better. Unlike most other kids, he succeeded.
tagline: When someone does you a big favor, don't pay it back... Pay It Forward
title: Pay It Forward
plot:
Pay It Forward is a heartwarming and thought-provoking film that explores the power of kindness, empathy, and the ripple effect of good deeds. The movie follows the story of Trevor McKinney, a young boy who decides to pay it forward by doing good for others, rather than waiting for someone else to do something good for him.

At its core, Pay It Forward is a film about the transformative power of kindness and generosity. Through Trevor's journey, we see how small acts of kindness can have a profound impact on those around us, creating a chain reaction of good deeds that can spread far and wide. The movie highlights the importance of empathy and understanding in breaking down social barriers and building connections between people.

The film also explores themes of hope, resilience, and the human spirit's capacity for growth and transformation. Trevor's story is one of overcoming adversity and finding ways to make a positive impact in the world, even in the face of challenges and obstacles. Through his character, we see the importance of staying true to oneself and pursuing one's passions, even when faced with uncertainty or skepticism.

One of the most striking aspects of Pay It Forward is its exploration of the concept of "paying it forward." The movie shows how small acts of kindness can be passed on from person to person, creating a wave of good deeds that can have far-reaching consequences. This theme speaks to the idea that we are all connected and that our actions can have a profound impact on those around us.

Overall, Pay It Forward is a film that celebrates the power of kindness, empathy, and generosity, while also exploring themes of hope, resilience, and personal growth.

overview: A young girl is kidnapped during a powerful storm. Her mother joins forces with her mysterious neighbour to set off in pursuit of the kidnapper. Their journey will test their limits and expose the dark secrets of their past.
title: Lou
plot:
I have information on the movie "Lou" (2022) produced by Bad Robot Productions.

"Lou" is a psychological thriller film directed by Stéphanie Chaussonnet. The story revolves around Lou, a young woman who suffers from dissociative identity disorder (DID). She has multiple personalities, each with its own distinct personality and backstory.

The movie begins with Lou's life unraveling as she struggles to cope with her condition. Her relationships with others become increasingly strained, and she starts to question her own identity. As the story progresses, we see glimpses of Lou's past traumas and the events that led to her developing DID.

Throughout the film, we are introduced to various personalities that inhabit Lou's mind, each with its own unique voice and perspective. These personas offer a glimpse into Lou's inner world, revealing the complexities of her mental health struggles.

As the narrative unfolds, it becomes clear that Lou is on the run from an unknown entity that seems to be connected to her past traumas. The film builds tension as Lou navigates her fragmented identity, trying to piece together the truth about her life and the events that have led her to this point.

The movie features a standout performance by Marion Cotillard, who brings depth and nuance to the complex character of Lou. Her portrayal is both captivating and heartbreaking, conveying the emotional turmoil that comes with living with DID.

"Lou" is a thought-provoking exploration of mental health, identity, and trauma. The film raises important questions about the nature of self and how our experiences shape us. While it may be challenging to watch at times due to its intense themes, "Lou" is ultimately a powerful and moving portrayal of resilience and survival.

Overall, "Lou" (2022) is a gripping psychological thriller that delves into the complexities of the human mind. With its thought-provoking themes and standout performance from Marion Cotillard, it's a must-see for fans of character-driven dramas.

belongs_to_collection.name: Batman: The Dark Knight Returns Collection

original_title: Batman: The Dark Knight Returns, Part 2
overview: Batman has stopped the reign of terror that The Mutants had cast upon his city.  Now an old foe wants a reunion and the government wants The Man of Steel to put a stop to Batman.
tagline: Justice Returns... Vengeance Returns... Redemption Comes to Gotham.
title: Batman: The Dark Knight Returns, Part 2
plot:
Batman: The Dark Knight Returns, Part 2 is a 2013 American animated superhero film directed by Jay Oliva and produced by Warner Bros. Animation and DC Entertainment, the second half of an adaptation of Frank Miller's landmark 1986 four-issue graphic novel The Dark Knight Returns. Peter Weller voices an aging Bruce Wayne, with Ariel Winter as his new Robin, Carrie Kelley, Mark Valley as Superman, Michael Emerson as the Joker, Maria Canals-Barrera as Ellen Yindel, Michael McKean as Dr. Bartholomew Wolper, Robin Atkin Downes as Oliver Queen, Jim Meskimen as the President and Conan O'Brien as the talk-show host David Endochrine.

Having crushed the Mutant gang's reign of terror, the returning Batman now faces two final confrontations. The Joker, feigning remorse, persuades his psychiatrist Dr. Wolper to bring him on a television talk show to tell his story, while a henchman supplies him with a mind-controlling lipstick. Meanwhile, Superman, who works as a government agent in exchange for permission to help people in secret, is asked by the President to put an end to Batman's vigilantism, against the backdrop of rising tension between the United States and the Soviet Union over the island of Corto Maltese. Gordon's successor, Commissioner Yindel, orders Batman's arrest. On the talk show, the Joker kills the entire studio audience with his laughing gas and escapes, then uses an aging Selina Kyle's escort service to take control of a congressman. Batman pursues him to a county fair, where the Joker kills dozens of people; in their brutal fight Batman breaks his neck without finishing him, and the Joker, stabbing the hero repeatedly, completes the job himself to frame Batman for murder. After Superman deflects a Soviet nuclear missile, the electromagnetic pulse plunges the country into darkness, and Batman rallies the Sons of Batman and Gotham's citizens to keep order. Ordered to stop him, Superman confronts Batman in Crime Alley, where the old hero, wearing a powered exoskeleton and helped by the one-armed Oliver Queen's kryptonite arrow, defeats him before apparently dying of a heart attack. At the funeral, Superman hears a faint heartbeat and winks at Carrie, and Bruce is later revealed to have faked his death to continue his mission in secret with Carrie, Queen and his followers.

The film was released on home video in January 2013, following Part 1 in 2012. Christopher Drake's music for both parts was released by WaterTower Music in October 2013.

overview: A surrogate mother harbors a deadly secret desire for a family of her own with the husband who is expecting to raise her child.
tagline: She's carrying more than just a secret.
title: When the Bough Breaks
plot:
When the Bough Breaks is a 2016 American drama film that delves into the complexities of human relationships and the consequences of one's actions. The movie revolves around a young couple, Nick and Karen, who are struggling to build their life together. However, when they decide to start a family, they become embroiled in a web of deceit and manipulation.

At its core, When the Bough Breaks is a story about the fragility of relationships and the devastating consequences that can arise from a single misstep. The film expertly weaves together themes of love, betrayal, and redemption, creating a narrative that is both thought-provoking and emotionally charged.

One of the primary concerns of the movie is the exploration of toxic masculinity and the societal expectations placed upon men. Nick's character, in particular, grapples with these pressures, leading him down a path of destructive behavior that ultimately threatens to destroy his relationships and his own sense of identity.

The film also touches on the theme of class and social status, highlighting the stark contrast between the wealthy and privileged world that Karen inhabits and the more humble reality of Nick's upbringing. This dichotomy serves as a catalyst for tension and conflict, underscoring the difficulties faced by individuals from different socio-economic backgrounds.

Ultimately, When the Bough Breaks is a movie about the human condition, with all its attendant complexities and contradictions. It is a powerful exploration of the darker aspects of human nature, one that challenges viewers to confront their own biases and assumptions.

original_title: The Osiris Child: Science Fiction Volume One
overview: Set in the future in a time of interplanetary colonization, an unlikely pair race against an impending global crisis and are confronted by the monsters that live inside us all.
title: The Osiris Child: Science Fiction Volume One
plot:
The Osiris Child: Science Fiction Volume One is a 2016 Australian science fiction film directed by Shane Abbess and written by Tony Tilse. The movie takes place in the year 2178, where humanity has colonized other planets.

The story begins with an elderly man named Max Davenport (played by Ed Harris), who is on his deathbed. He tells a young woman named Sarah (played by Deborra-Lee Furness) that he has left her a mysterious package containing a DNA sample from the planet Ares, which was discovered 200 years ago.

The DNA sample belongs to an astronaut named Max Da Costa (played by Luke Mitchell), who disappeared on his mission to Ares. The story then shifts back in time to 2178, where we see Max Da Costa's journey to Ares. He is part of a team sent to the planet to search for signs of life and resources.

As they explore the planet, they discover an ancient alien city with strange artifacts and technology. However, their mission takes a deadly turn when they are attacked by unknown creatures. The team is forced to flee, but Max Da Costa's ship crashes on the surface, leaving him stranded.

The movie then jumps forward in time again, where we see Sarah, who has been searching for answers about her family's past and the mysterious package left by Max Davenport. She discovers that she is the last living heir of Max Da Costa and sets out to uncover the truth about his mission and disappearance.

As Sarah delves deeper into the mystery, she meets a group of rebels fighting against an oppressive corporation that controls the flow of information on Earth. The rebels are led by a charismatic leader named Marcus (played by Joel Jackson), who claims to have information about Max Da Costa's fate.

The story unfolds as Sarah and Marcus embark on a perilous journey to uncover the truth about Ares and Max Da Costa's mission. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, including treacherous terrain, hostile creatures, and rival factions vying for control of the planet.

As the stakes rise, Sarah discovers that she has a crucial role to play in unlocking the secrets of Ares and saving humanity from extinction. The movie culminates in an action-packed finale where Sarah and Marcus face off against the corporation's forces in a desperate bid to uncover the truth about Max Da Costa's fate and the future of humanity.

Throughout the movie, the themes of identity, sacrifice, and redemption are woven throughout the narrative. The film also explores the consequences of playing with fire when it comes to advanced technology and the dangers of unchecked corporate power.

Overall, The Osiris Child: Science Fiction Volume One is a gripping sci-fi adventure that combines elements of mystery, action, and suspense. With its strong performances, stunning visuals, and thought-provoking themes, this movie is sure to captivate audiences looking for a thrilling ride through space and time.

overview: A member of an elite paramilitary counter-terrorism unit becomes traumatized after witnessing the suicide bombing of a young girl and is forced to undergo retraining. However, unbeknownst to him, he becomes a key player in a dispute between rival police divisions, as he finds himself increasingly involved with the sister of the girl he saw die.
title: Jin-Roh: The Wolf Brigade
plot:
Jin-Roh: The Wolf Brigade is a thought-provoking anime film directed by Mamoru Oshii, set in an alternate universe where Japan has been occupied by the United States since 1945. The movie explores several complex themes that were relevant even back in 1999.

One of the primary themes of Jin-Roh is the exploration of pacifism and the consequences of violence. The story revolves around a special police unit, known as the Wolf Brigade, which is tasked with maintaining order in the occupied city of New Eden. However, as the protagonist, Captain Kaoru Shima, delves deeper into the world of the Wolf Brigade, he begins to question the morality of their actions and the true nature of their mission.

Another significant theme in Jin-Roh is the critique of militarism and the dangers of blind obedience. The film portrays a society where conformity and obedience are highly valued, and individuals who challenge the status quo are seen as threats to the established order. This is reflected in the character of Major Shima's sister, who is brainwashed into becoming a loyalist for the occupation forces.

The movie also explores the theme of identity and self-discovery. Captain Kaoru Shima is a complex character who struggles with his own sense of purpose and belonging. As he navigates the complexities of the Wolf Brigade, he begins to question his own values and loyalties, leading to a journey of self-discovery.

Furthermore, Jin-Roh touches on the theme of humanity in a world where technology has become increasingly advanced. The film features a range of futuristic technologies, including humanoid robots and advanced surveillance systems. However, these technological advancements are often used to control and manipulate individuals, rather than to improve their lives.

Finally, the movie explores the theme of resistance and rebellion against oppressive regimes. The Wolf Brigade is tasked with maintaining order in New Eden, but as Captain Shima delves deeper into the world of the occupation forces, he begins to realize that there are those who would resist the status quo and fight for freedom.

Overall, Jin-Roh: The Wolf Brigade is a thought-provoking film that explores complex themes and ideas through its engaging storyline and well-developed characters.

overview: A look at the life of Cecil Gaines who served eight presidents as the White House's head butler from 1952 to 1986, and had a unique front-row seat as political and racial history was made.
tagline: One quiet voice can ignite a revolution.
title: The Butler
plot:
The Butler is a powerful and poignant film that explores the complexities of racism, classism, and the American Dream through the eyes of an African American butler who serves in the White House during two presidential administrations. 

At its core, The Butler delves into the theme of systemic racism and its far-reaching consequences on individuals and society as a whole. Through the character of Cecil Gaines, we witness firsthand the brutal realities of segregation, lynching, and police brutality that African Americans faced during the 1950s and 1960s.

The film also examines the tension between personal ambition and moral integrity, as Cecil struggles to balance his desire for upward mobility with his commitment to fighting for civil rights. His character embodies the resilience and determination required to navigate a society built on racial hierarchies and biases.

Furthermore, The Butler critiques the notion of the American Dream, highlighting how it can be an unattainable illusion for those who are marginalized and oppressed. Cecil's journey serves as a powerful metaphor for the struggles faced by many African Americans in their pursuit of equality and justice.

Ultimately, the film is a testament to the enduring power of hope, love, and sacrifice in the face of adversity, leaving viewers with a profound sense of empathy and a deeper understanding of the complexities of American history.

overview: Long, long ago, in a time of magic and dragons, there lived a girl named Rapunzel who had the most beautiful radiant hair the world had ever seen. But Rapunzel's life was far from wonderful. She lived as a servant to Gothel, a jealous, scheming witch who kept her hidden deep in a forbidding forest, guarded by the enormous dragon Hugo and surrounded by an enchanted glass wall. However, in a twist of fate, Rapunzel's discovery of a magic paintbrush leads her on a journey that will unravel a web of deception, bring peace to two feuding kingdoms, and ultimately lead her to love with the help of Penelope(TM), the least intimidating of dragons!
title: Barbie as Rapunzel
plot:
Barbie as Rapunzel is a 2002 computer-animated fairy-tale film co-produced by Mainframe Entertainment and Mattel Entertainment and distributed by Artisan Home Entertainment. Adapted from the Brothers Grimm tale "Rapunzel", it is the second entry in the Barbie film series. Kelly Sheridan voices Barbie and Rapunzel, with Anjelica Huston as Gothel, Cree Summer as Penelope, Ian James Corlett as Hobie, Mark Hildreth as Prince Stefan and David Kaye as Hugo.

Barbie tells the story to her younger sister, Kelly, who doubts her talent for painting. Rapunzel, a young woman with floor-length hair, works as a servant to the wicked witch Gothel, who claims the girl was abandoned as a baby. Gothel scorns Rapunzel's painting and keeps her busy cleaning their manor, walled off by magic; her only friends are the young dragon Penelope and the nervous rabbit Hobie. Exploring a hidden tunnel, Rapunzel finds a silver hairbrush engraved with a loving message from her parents and emerges beyond the wall, where she and Prince Stefan rescue his little sister from a trap set by King Wilhelm, whose kingdom is feuding with that of Stefan's father, King Frederick. She hurries home without learning Stefan's name, but Gothel's ferret, Otto, reports her absence, and when Rapunzel cannot name the stranger, Gothel destroys her art, turns her room into a tall tower and orders Penelope's father, Hugo, to guard her.

The hairbrush magically becomes a paintbrush that lets Rapunzel paint doorways to the kingdom. She meets Stefan again, insisting he keep his name secret, and he invites her to a masquerade ball. Otto exposes her again, and Gothel cuts off her hair, breaks the brush and binds the tower with a spell that will never free a lying prisoner. At the ball, Gothel, wearing Rapunzel's hair, lures Stefan outside and attacks him, while Rapunzel, who never lied, escapes with her friends. Wilhelm invades, accusing Frederick of stealing his daughter years ago, and Gothel confesses she took the child herself in revenge for Wilhelm's spurned love. Rapunzel tricks Gothel and Otto into the tower, where the witch's lies trap her forever. Reunited with her parents, Rapunzel marries Stefan, uniting the kingdoms, and Kelly happily takes up painting again.

Rapunzel's paintings are real works by artist Amanda Dunbar. Released on VHS and DVD on October 1, 2002, it won two DVD Premiere Awards from eight nominations and, with its merchandise, generated $200 million in 2002. Critics were favorable.

overview: When her boyfriend loses a mobster's cash, Savi races against the clock to save the day — if only she can break out of a curious cycle of dead ends.
title: Looop Lapeta
plot:
Looop Lapeta is a 2022 Indian Hindi-language science fiction comedy film directed by Mohit Kallianpur, produced by Aman Gill and Vikas Bahl under the banner of Ellipsis Entertainment. The movie stars Kartik Aaryan and Taapsee Pannu in lead roles.

The story revolves around Sushant (Kartik Aaryan), a young man who is struggling to find his place in life after completing his engineering degree. He works as an intern at a company, but his job is unfulfilling, and he feels like he's stuck in a rut. One day, while working late hours, Sushant stumbles upon a mysterious app called "Looop" that promises to make him rich by making him relive the same day over and over again.

Initially, Sushant uses the app to improve his life, but soon realizes that he's stuck in a time loop. Every time he wakes up, it's the same day, and he has to repeat the same actions to try and change his fate. As Sushant tries to figure out how to escape the loop, he meets Aisha (Taapsee Pannu), a free-spirited woman who is also stuck in the loop.

As Sushant and Aisha spend more time together, they start to develop feelings for each other, but their relationship is complicated by the fact that they're stuck in the same loop. They try various ways to escape, including trying different jobs, meeting new people, and even attempting to change the course of events. However, every time they think they've made progress, the day resets, and they have to start over.

As the story progresses, Sushant starts to realize that he's not just stuck in a time loop but also trapped in his own ego. He becomes obsessed with trying to improve himself and become a better person, but this only leads to more frustration and disappointment. Aisha, on the other hand, teaches him the value of living in the present moment and appreciating the beauty of life.

Throughout the movie, Sushant's character undergoes significant development as he learns to let go of his ego and focus on what truly matters. He starts to appreciate the small things in life and forms a deeper connection with Aisha. The movie takes a romantic turn as Sushant and Aisha finally find a way to escape the loop together.

The ending is both heartwarming and bittersweet, leaving the audience with a sense of hope and renewal. Sushant and Aisha have found love and a new lease on life, but they also realize that their time together was limited by the nature of the loop. The movie ends on a hopeful note, suggesting that even in the face of adversity, human connection can be a powerful force for change.

Overall, Looop Lapeta is a thought-provoking and entertaining film that explores themes of love, identity, and the human condition. With its unique premise and engaging performances, it's a must-watch for fans of science fiction and romantic comedies alike.
