The film presents a nuanced portrayal of the complexities involved in counter-terrorism efforts, highlighting the difficulties in distinguishing between good and evil, and the consequences of relying on simplistic categorizations.

Ultimately, the movie is a thought-provoking exploration of the human condition, inviting viewers to ponder the intricacies of identity, nationality, and morality.

overview: An unlikely friendship forms between 21 year-old Jane and the elderly Sadie after Jane discovers a hidden stash of money inside an object at Sadie's yard sale.
title: Starlet
plot:
Starlet is a 2012 American independent drama directed, edited and co-produced by Sean Baker, who co-wrote it with Chris Bergoch. It follows an unlikely friendship that develops in the San Fernando Valley between a 21-year-old woman, played by Dree Hemingway, and an 85-year-old widow, played by Besedka Johnson in her only screen role.

Jane, who also goes by Tess, lives in an apartment rented by Melissa and her boyfriend, Mikey, with her Xolo dog, Starlet. Told she cannot repaint her room because Mikey uses it for "shoots", she looks for change at neighborhood yard sales and buys a thermos from a crotchety old woman named Sadie. At home, Jane discovers a stash of cash hidden inside. After splurging on a few luxuries, she decides to return the money, but Sadie shuts the door on her before she can explain. Jane persists, and despite Sadie's prickliness a friendship forms. Jane learns that Sadie has always loved Paris but never gone there, and that she was married to a successful gambler, was widowed long ago and never had children.

It emerges that Jane, Melissa and Mikey all work in adult films. When Melissa is fired after clashing with their boss, Jane persuades him to suspend her for a month instead, and Jane herself is promoted. While Jane works a porn convention, Starlet slips away from Sadie, who eventually finds the dog. A drunken Melissa urges Jane to spend her windfall on someone she cares about, expecting to benefit herself, but Jane buys two first-class tickets to Paris and persuades Sadie to come. Enraged, Melissa throws Jane out, and their boss gives her a room in a house shared by other performers. Out of spite, Melissa tells Sadie about the money Jane found. Sadie briefly begins unpacking, then resumes preparing for the trip. When Jane, unaware that Sadie knows, picks her up for the airport, Sadie asks to stop at the cemetery to leave flowers on her husband's grave. Nearby, Jane notices the grave of Sadie's daughter, who died at about 18, and returns to the car before the two drive off together.

The film was shot entirely in Los Angeles in August and September 2011. Starlet premiered at South by Southwest on March 11, 2012, where Johnson received Special Jury Recognition and was released by Music Box Films on November 9, 2012. It grossed $146,222. Critics praised it, with 87% on Rotten Tomatoes and 74 on Metacritic, and it won the Independent Spirit Robert Altman Award. Johnson died a year after its release.

overview: When a border guard with a sixth sense for identifying smugglers encounters the first person she cannot prove is guilty, she is forced to confront terrifying revelations about herself and humankind.
production_companies: MEDIA Programme of the European Union
tagline: Sense something beautiful
title: Border
plot:
Border is a 2018 Swedish drama film directed by Olaf Falck and produced by Det Danske Filminstitut. The movie revolves around a mysterious and isolated border control officer, Joan, who lives in the middle of nowhere, Sweden, and her peculiar relationship with a young migrant named Torgers.

The main theme of Border is the exploration of identity, particularly in relation to borders both physical and metaphorical. The film delves into the complexities of human migration, highlighting the struggles and challenges faced by those seeking a new life elsewhere. Through Joan's character, the movie raises questions about the nature of belonging, identity, and what it means to be human.

The story also touches on themes of loneliness, isolation, and the blurring of boundaries between self and other. Joan's peculiar relationship with Torgers serves as a catalyst for exploring these themes, as she begins to question her own sense of identity and purpose in life.

Furthermore, Border critiques the notion of borders as physical barriers that separate people from their humanity. The film suggests that borders are often arbitrary and can be both oppressive and liberating, depending on one's perspective. Through its thought-provoking narrative, Border encourages viewers to reflect on their own assumptions about identity, belonging, and what it means to be human.

Overall, Border is a poignant and introspective film that challenges viewers to confront the complexities of human migration and identity in a world where borders are increasingly complex and multifaceted.

original_title: Winnie the Pooh: Blood and Honey
overview: Christopher Robin is headed off to college and he has abandoned his old friends, Pooh and Piglet, which then leads to the duo embracing their inner monsters.
tagline: This ain't no bedtime story
title: Winnie the Pooh: Blood and Honey
plot:
Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey is a 2023 British independent slasher film produced, written, directed and edited by Rhys Frake-Waterfield. A horror reimagining of A. A. Milne and E. H. Shepard's Winnie-the-Pooh books and the first entry in what became the Twisted Childhood Universe, it stars Nikolai Leon as Christopher Robin, Craig David Dowsett as Pooh and Chris Cordell as Piglet, with Amber Doig-Thorne and Natasha Rose Mills. The project went into development after the 1926 book entered the public domain in the United States in January 2022, and it was shot in six days in Ashdown Forest, East Sussex, the inspiration for the Hundred Acre Wood.

As a boy, Christopher Robin befriended Pooh, Piglet, Owl, Rabbit, Eeyore, Kanga and Roo in the Hundred Acre Wood, but after he left for college, the starving creatures ate Eeyore during the winter. Traumatized, the survivors came to hate humans, including Christopher for abandoning them, reverted to their wild instincts and vowed never to speak again. Five years later Christopher returns with his fiancée Mary and finds the wood deserted; that night Piglet strangles Mary with a chain and he and Pooh drag Christopher away. Later, university students Maria, Jessica, Alice, Zoe, Lara and Tina rent a cabin in the wood to help Maria recover from being stalked. Pooh kills Tina in a woodchipper; in his treehouse, Christopher is held captive. That night Pooh and Piglet attack the cabin, killing Lara and Zoe and abducting Alice, whom Maria and Jessica manage to rescue. In the treehouse the three free Christopher and another prisoner, Charlene, who wants revenge on Piglet for disfiguring her, but Piglet kills her. Alice knocks Piglet out with his sledgehammer before Pooh kills her. On the road, Pooh slaughters a group of men who stop to help, and when Maria crashes a pick-up truck while trying to run him down, he drags away and beheads Jessica. Christopher pins Pooh with his car, but Pooh frees himself and takes Maria hostage. When Christopher begs him to let her go, promising to stay with him forever, Pooh breaks his silence to tell him "You left" and kills Maria, and Christopher flees the wood.

Planned as a direct-to-video release, the film instead received a global theatrical run, premiering in Mexico on 26 January 2023. Critics savaged it, giving it a 3% Rotten Tomatoes rating, and it won five Golden Raspberry Awards, including Worst Picture, yet it grossed $7.7 million on a budget of about $50,000.

original_title: 遊☆戯☆王 THE DARK SIDE OF DIMENSIONS
overview: Yugi and Kaiba have a special duel that transcends dimensions.
tagline: Back to the stage of battle
title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Dark Side of Dimensions
plot:
Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Dark Side of Dimensions is a Japanese animated science fiction film directed by Noriyuki Abe and produced by Toei Animation. The movie takes place after the events of the Yu-Gi-Oh! Arc-V series.

The story begins with Yugi Mutou, now known as Yūgi Muto in Japan, who has been living a peaceful life with his friends and family. However, he is suddenly pulled back into the world of Duel Monsters by the spirit of Pharaoh Atem, who warns him that the evil spirit of Seto Kaiba's alter ego, Blue-Eyes White Dragon, has returned to wreak havoc on the world.

Yūgi soon discovers that the Blue-Eyes White Dragon has taken over Kaiba's body and is using his vast wealth and resources to build a massive robot called the "Dark Side of Dimensions." The robot is capable of destroying entire cities with its powerful energy beam, and Yūgi knows he must stop it before it's too late.

As Yūgi delves deeper into the mystery, he meets a new ally in the form of a young girl named Luna, who possesses the ability to see and communicate with spirits. Together, they embark on a perilous journey to gather the fragments of the "Heart of the Cards," an ancient artifact that holds the key to defeating the Dark Side of Dimensions.

Along the way, Yūgi is forced to confront his own dark past and the consequences of his actions as the King of Games. He also reunites with old friends like Joey Wheeler, Tristan Taylor, and Téa Gardner, who join him on his quest to save the world from destruction.

As the stakes grow higher, Yūgi and Luna face off against a series of formidable foes, including the Blue-Eyes White Dragon's minions and other powerful dueling opponents. In the end, Yūgi must use all his skills and knowledge to defeat the Dark Side of Dimensions and restore balance to the world.

Throughout the movie, the animation is stunning, with vibrant colors and epic battles that bring the world of Duel Monsters to life in a way that's both nostalgic and exciting for fans of the series. The story is full of twists and turns, keeping viewers on the edge of their seats as they root for Yūgi and his friends.

Overall, Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Dark Side of Dimensions is an action-packed adventure that explores themes of friendship, sacrifice, and the power of the human spirit. With its engaging storyline, memorable characters, and stunning animation, it's a must-see for fans of the Yu-Gi-Oh! franchise.

overview: Standing on the precipice of adulthood, a group of friends navigate new relationships, while reexamining others, during their final summer before college.
tagline: Your real life is about to begin
title: The Last Summer
plot:
The Last Summer is a 2019 American romantic comedy directed by William Bindley from a screenplay he wrote with his brother Scott Bindley. An interconnected ensemble piece, it follows a circle of recent high school graduates through their final summer before college, as they start new relationships, end old ones and reconsider their plans. KJ Apa, Maia Mitchell, Jacob Latimore, Halston Sage and Tyler Posey lead the cast.

Griffin, bound for Columbia thanks to his father's connections though he longs to study music at Berklee, reconnects with his childhood crush Phoebe, who is making a documentary she hopes will win a festival prize and pay her way to New York University. He helps her with the sound mix and they begin dating, until Griffin learns that his father is having an affair with Phoebe's single mother; when the affair comes out, Phoebe is hurt that he kept quiet. He apologises, her film is well received, and the reconciled couple agree to try a long-distance relationship as he chooses Berklee. Erin and Alec, a couple for two years, amicably split before college, but Alec is quickly snapped up by the popular Paige, while Erin starts dating Ricky, a rookie Cubs player who catches a ball in her lap; she drops him on finding his ex at his home, and at her farewell party she and Alec kiss. Erin's friend Audrey, a working-class student rejected by most colleges, nannies for Lilah, a child actress pushed by her ambitious mother; the two skip an audition for a day at the beach, Audrey is fired, and she turns down her last-choice college to volunteer with children. Alec's friend Foster pursues a list of girls he wants to sleep with, which goes viral and backfires, and confesses he is a virgin before an attractive divorcée invites him in. Meanwhile two awkward friends, Chad and Reece, are mistaken for traders at a businessmen's bar and start dating two women in their twenties, who reveal they knew the boys' real age all along.

Apa plays Griffin, with Mitchell as Phoebe, Latimore as Alec, Sage as Erin, Posey as Ricky, Sosie Bacon as Audrey, Wolfgang Novogratz as Foster, Jacob McCarthy as Chad, Mario Revolori as Reece, Gage Golightly as Paige, and Gabrielle Anwar and Ed Quinn as Griffin's parents. Filming began in May 2018, and Netflix, which acquired worldwide rights that June, released it on May 3, 2019. Reviews were mostly negative, with 33% approval from the few critics counted by Rotten Tomatoes.

overview: An artist and her elderly mother confront long-buried secrets when they return to a former family home, now a hotel haunted by its mysterious past.
tagline: An exquisite ghost story.
title: The Eternal Daughter
plot:
The Eternal Daughter is a 2022 psychological drama film directed by Peter Kosminsky, starring Olivia Colman as Clio, an elderly woman who returns to her childhood home with her daughter, and Emma Stone as Young Clio.

The main themes of The Eternal Daughter include:

1. **Mother-Daughter Relationships**: The film explores the complex and often fraught relationship between mothers and daughters, particularly in the context of trauma, guilt, and unresolved emotions.
2. **Trauma and Memory**: The movie delves into the ways in which traumatic experiences can shape our memories, perceptions, and relationships. Clio's past traumas are slowly revealed through a series of fragmented flashbacks, blurring the lines between reality and fantasy.
3. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: As Young Clio navigates her own life, she grapples with the consequences of her mother's actions, leading to a journey of self-discovery and exploration of her own identity.
4. **Guilt and Redemption**: The film touches on the theme of guilt and redemption, as Clio confronts the choices she made in the past and seeks to make amends with herself and those around her.
5. **The Power of Storytelling**: Through Clio's storytelling, the film highlights the importance of narrative in shaping our understanding of ourselves and others.

Throughout the movie, these themes are woven together to create a complex and thought-provoking exploration of the human experience.

overview: Set in 1920s Vienna, this is the tale of a little girl, whose godfather gives her a special doll one Christmas Eve.
tagline: Experience the Holiday Classic as You've Never Seen it Before
title: The Nutcracker: The Untold Story
plot:
The Nutcracker in 3D, also released as The Nutcracker: The Untold Story, is a 2010 Christmas musical fantasy film adapted from Tchaikovsky's 1892 ballet The Nutcracker. Andrei Konchalovsky directed, co-wrote and produced the film, a co-production of the United Kingdom, Russia and Hungary that sets the story in 1920s Vienna and sets lyrics to Tchaikovsky's music. First screened at the European Film Market in February 2009, it opened in the United States and Canada on November 24, 2010.

Young Mary lives with her parents, Joseph and Louise, and little brother, Max. On Christmas Eve, while her parents are at a party, her Uncle Albert gives the children a dollhouse and a nutcracker named NC, who comes to life that night and grows to human size. In the sitting room, now enormous, Mary meets NC's toy friends: Gielgud, a courtly chimpanzee; Tinker, a fussy opera-singing clown; and Sticks, a drummer boy. Atop the Christmas tree the Snow Fairy, who resembles Mary's mother, reveals that NC is a prince whose kingdom was seized by the Rat King and his mother, the Rat Queen, who cursed him. Because Mary believes in him, NC briefly becomes a boy again, and she sees his city, where the light-fearing Rat King forces people to burn children's toys in factories so that the smoke blots out the sun.

The rats' robotic dogs topple the tree, and Mary wakes in bed to parents who dismiss her story. The next night NC is captured along with Tinker and Sticks, and Max is lured to the rat city and imprisoned. With Gielgud, Mary slips through a portal in the attic and, disguised as a rat, finds the factory where NC lies lifeless. Her declaration of love breaks the curse for good, the workers rise up, and after a fight aboard the rats' helicopter, the King and Queen revert to rats and flee into the sewers. NC is crowned and promises Mary they will meet again. Back home, her parents apologize and vow to spend more time with her, and Uncle Albert introduces his new neighbor, a boy who looks like the prince and asks to be called NC.

Elle Fanning plays Mary, with Nathan Lane as Uncle Albert, John Turturro as the Rat King, Frances de la Tour as the Rat Queen, Richard E. Grant as Joseph and Yulia Vysotskaya as Louise and the Snow Fairy; Charlie Rowe and Shirley Henderson share the role of the Nutcracker. It was roundly panned, with 0% approval on Rotten Tomatoes, criticism of its Nazi-like rats and toy-burning imagery, and earnings of about $20 million against a $90 million budget.

overview: After getting a car ride from an unknown man, Lisa wakes up in a tube. On her arm is strapped a bracelet with a countdown. She quickly understands that every 8 minutes, fire burns an occupied section. She has no choice but to crawl into safe sections to survive. To know why she’s there and how to get out, Lisa will have to face the memories of her dead daughter…
tagline: You have just woken up stuck in a pipe full of deadly traps. How far will you go?
title: Meander
plot:
Meander (French: Méandre) is a 2020 French science fiction film written and directed by Mathieu Turi, starring Gaia Weiss as Lisa and Peter Franzén as Adam. It premiered online at the Sitges Film Festival on 11 October 2020, opened in French cinemas on 26 May 2021 and was released in the United States and on video on demand by Gravitas Ventures on 9 July 2021.

On an empty road somewhere in America, Lisa, a Frenchwoman, accepts a ride from a man named Adam who has a cross tattooed on his right hand. She tells him that her daughter, Nina, died young and would have turned nine that day. When a radio bulletin describes a serial-killer suspect with the same tattoo, Adam brakes hard and Lisa is knocked unconscious. She wakes in a maze of narrow metal tunnels, wearing a catsuit and a strange glowing bracelet, and must crawl past crushers, flamethrowers, flooded passages and acid, finding the decayed bodies of others dressed as she is. She meets a filthy, raving prisoner who dies in a burst of flame after they struggle over a single safe space; his surviving hand bears the cross tattoo, revealing that he is Adam and that she has been there far longer than she realized. Beneath his bracelet are tattooed symbols she cannot decipher.

A mechanical tentacle tipped with a skull tends her wounds and triggers memories of Adam stabbing her and a strange light in the sky. Pursued by a burned, one-handed creature that seems to be Adam's revived corpse, she relives Nina's fatal fall from a window, and when she becomes snared in razor wire, a trapdoor drops her back to where she started. Copying Adam's symbols on the wall in her own blood, she realizes they are directions through the labyrinth, burns off her own bracelet in acid and finds a fresh set tattooed on her wrist. She passes a womb-like chamber with alien shapes moving beyond its walls, crushes the creature in a compactor and loses a foot to a blade, only to find that the daylight ahead is a screen. As she weeps, she is lifted into a light and wakes, whole, on a sunlit rock beside Nina, who explains that her body died many times, the corpses being her earlier selves, and tells her to live. The camera reveals an alien world.

Critics often compared the film to Cube, and Screen Daily singled out its sound design. It holds 86% approval on Rotten Tomatoes from 14 reviews and grossed about $698,000 worldwide.

belongs_to_collection.name: The Fast and the Furious Collection

overview: Deckard Shaw seeks revenge against Dominic Toretto and his family for his comatose brother.
tagline: Vengeance hits home
title: Furious 7
plot:
Furious 7 is a 2015 action film directed by James Wan and written by Chris Morgan. The movie marks the seventh installment in the Fast and Furious franchise, which has become one of the most successful and beloved franchises in Hollywood.

The story begins with Dominic Toretto (Vin Diesel) and his crew, including Brian O'Conner (Paul Walker), Tej Parker (Chris "Ludacris" Bridges), Roman Pearce (Tyrese Gibson), and Mia Toretto (Jordana Brewster), who are still dealing with the aftermath of their last adventure. However, their lives take a dramatic turn when they receive news that Brian has been killed in action.

The crew is devastated by Brian's death, but Dom decides to honor his friend's memory by taking on one final mission: to rescue a young girl named Ramsey (Nathalie Emmanuel) from the clutches of Deckard Shaw (Jason Statham), a skilled mercenary who was once a member of the British Special Forces.

As the crew embarks on their perilous journey, they are joined by new recruits, including Deckard's sister, Maggie (Gina Carano), and a mysterious woman named Anna (Michelle Rodriguez). The team faces numerous challenges and obstacles as they navigate through the streets of Abu Dhabi, Dubai, and London to reach Ramsey.

Throughout the film, Dom and his crew encounter various adversaries, including Shaw, who is determined to take revenge on Dom for killing his brother. The action sequences are intense and thrilling, with stunning stunts and high-octane chases that showcase the team's skills and teamwork.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Deckard has a personal vendetta against Dom, which makes their confrontation all the more intense. Meanwhile, Dom also grapples with his own demons, including his complicated relationship with Mia and his feelings of guilt over Brian's death.

The film's climax features an epic showdown between Dom and Shaw, with the two engaging in a fierce hand-to-hand combat sequence that showcases their skills and physicality. In the end, Dom emerges victorious, but not before Shaw reveals a shocking secret about his past that adds depth to the story.

Furious 7 also pays tribute to Paul Walker, who passed away during filming due to a car accident. The film's producers incorporated a heartfelt tribute to Walker into the movie, featuring footage of him from previous films in the franchise and a poignant message from Dom to Brian.

Overall, Furious 7 is an action-packed thrill ride that delivers on its promise of high-octane excitement and heart-pumping suspense. With its talented cast, stunning stunts, and emotional depth, it's a fitting addition to the Fast and Furious franchise.

overview: John "Breacher" Wharton leads an elite DEA task force that takes on the world's deadliest drug cartels. When the team successfully executes a high-stakes raid on a cartel safe house, they think their work is done – until, one-by-one, the team members mysteriously start to be eliminated. As the body count rises, everyone is a suspect.
tagline: Leave no loose ends
title: Sabotage
plot:
Sabotage is a 2014 action thriller film directed by David Ayer and starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, Woody Harrelson, and Mireille Enos.

The main themes of Sabotage revolve around the consequences of revenge, loyalty, and the blurred lines between right and wrong. The story follows a team of Navy SEALs who embark on a mission to rescue their kidnapped family members, but things take a dark turn when they discover that the kidnappers are actually corrupt government officials.

As the team navigates through the treacherous terrain, they begin to question whose side they're really on and what's driving their actions. The film explores the theme of revenge as the team seeks to punish those responsible for the kidnapping, but in doing so, they become increasingly consumed by their own personal demons.

The movie also delves into the idea of loyalty, particularly among the SEALs, who are forced to confront their own moral codes when faced with difficult choices. The film's protagonist, John "Breacher" Wharton (played by Arnold Schwarzenegger), is a complex character whose motivations and loyalties are constantly tested.

Throughout the film, Ayer raises questions about the nature of justice and whether revenge can ever truly be justified. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that nothing is as black-and-white as it initially seems, and the team's actions have far-reaching consequences that challenge their own sense of identity and purpose.

Ultimately, Sabotage is a thought-provoking thriller that challenges its audience to confront the complexities of human nature and the consequences of our actions.

original_title: デスノート the Last name
overview: In the second installment of the Death Note film franchise, Light Yagami meets a second Kira and faithful follower Misa Amane and her Shinigami named Rem. Light attempts to defeat L along with Teru Mikami (a Kira follower) and Kiyomi Takada (another Kira follower) but in the end will Light win? or will a Shinigami named Ryuk make all the difference in Light's victory or his ultimate death?
tagline: The last name to be written in the DEATH NOTE... Whose name will it be?
title: Death Note: The Last Name
plot:
Death Note: The Last Name is a 2006 Japanese psychological thriller film directed by Shinichiro Watanabe, produced by Shochiku, and based on the manga series of the same name written by Tsugumi Ohba and illustrated by Takeshi Obata.

The main themes of Death Note: The Last Name include:

1. **Morality and Ethics**: The film explores the moral implications of having the power to decide who lives or dies. Light Yagami, the protagonist, believes that he is doing the right thing by ridding the world of crime, but his actions lead to a complex web of consequences.
2. **Power and Corruption**: As Light's power grows, so does his ego and sense of invincibility. This theme highlights how easily power can corrupt even the most well-intentioned individuals.
3. **Justice vs. Vengeance**: The film raises questions about whether justice can be achieved through vigilantism or if it's better to leave justice in the hands of the law enforcement agencies.
4. **Identity and Self-Discovery**: Light's character undergoes significant development as he navigates his new role as a god-like figure, forcing him to confront his own identity and motivations.
5. **Friendship and Loyalty**: The relationships between Light, L, and Ryuk are central to the story, highlighting the complexities of friendship, loyalty, and trust.

The film's plot is driven by these themes, which ultimately lead to a thrilling and thought-provoking conclusion that challenges the audience to consider the consequences of playing god.

overview: Maya, a 40-year-old woman struggling with frustrations from unfulfilled dreams. Until that is, she gets the chance to prove to Madison Avenue that street smarts are as valuable as book smarts, and that it is never too late for a second act.
tagline: Her talent was real. Her résumé was not.
title: Second Act
plot:
Second Act is a 2018 American comedy-drama film directed by Gregg Henkin and starring Jennifer Lopez, Milo Ventimiglia, and Vanessa Hudgens.

The main theme of Second Act revolves around self-discovery, empowerment, and the pursuit of one's dreams. The story follows Margot Leighton (played by Jennifer Lopez), a struggling single mother who works as an accountant at a large corporation. Despite her success in her job, she feels unfulfilled and restless, yearning for something more.

As Margot navigates her personal life, she meets a young girl named Emily (played by Vanessa Hudgens) who is struggling to find her place in the world. Inspired by Emily's passion and determination, Margot decides to take a leap of faith and pursue her own dreams, which leads her to become a successful fashion designer.

Throughout the film, Second Act explores themes of:

1. Self-discovery: Margot's journey is a metaphor for finding one's true purpose and identity. As she navigates her life, she discovers new passions and interests that bring her joy and fulfillment.
2. Empowerment: The film celebrates women's empowerment and independence. Margot takes control of her life, making choices that align with her values and aspirations.
3. Perseverance: Despite facing numerous setbacks and rejections, Margot remains determined to pursue her dreams. Her perseverance ultimately leads to success and personal growth.

The film also touches on themes of motherhood, friendship, and the importance of following one's heart. Overall, Second Act is a heartwarming and inspiring story about embracing change and pursuing one's passions.

overview: In the future, crime is out of control and New York City's Manhattan is a maximum security prison. Grabbing a bargaining chip right out of the air, convicts bring down the President's plane in bad old Gotham. Gruff Snake Plissken, a one-eyed lone warrior new to prison life, is coerced into bringing the President, and his cargo, out of this land of undesirables.
tagline: 1997. New York city is now a maximum security prison. Breaking out is impossible. Breaking in is insane.
title: Escape from New York
plot:
"Escape from New York" (1981) is a dystopian action film directed by John Carpenter, produced by Debra Hill and Jon Davison, and distributed by AVCO Embassy Pictures.

The main themes of "Escape from New York" include:

1. **Critique of 1980s America**: The film is set in a dystopian future where the United States has descended into chaos. This serves as a commentary on the social and economic issues of the 1980s, such as rising crime rates, government corruption, and the erosion of civil liberties.
2. **Punishment and Rehabilitation**: The movie explores the concept of punishment and rehabilitation in a society that has lost its moral compass. The main character, Snake Plissken (Kurt Russell), is a tough-as-nails convict who must navigate a treacherous landscape to rescue the President from a deadly virus.
3. **Individualism vs. Conformity**: Snake's character embodies individualism and self-reliance in a world that values conformity and obedience. His actions are driven by his own moral code, which sets him apart from the authorities and the society around him.
4. **The Power of Human Resilience**: Despite being trapped in a nightmarish environment, Snake's determination and resourcefulness allow him to survive against all odds. This theme highlights the human capacity for resilience and adaptability in the face of adversity.
5. **Social Commentary on Politics and Authority**: The film critiques the excesses of 1980s politics and the abuse of power by those in authority. The President's situation, where he is held captive in a maximum-security prison, serves as a metaphor for the ways in which politicians can become detached from reality and lose touch with their constituents.

Overall, "Escape from New York" is a thought-provoking film that explores complex themes through its action-packed narrative and memorable characters.

belongs_to_collection.name: The Nine Lives of Christmas Collection

overview: With Christmas approaching, a handsome fireman afraid of commitment adopts a stray cat and meets a beautiful veterinary student who challenges his decision to remain a confirmed bachelor.
title: The Nine Lives of Christmas
plot:
The Nine Lives of Christmas is a romantic comedy that explores the idea of love and relationships through the lens of reincarnation. The movie follows the story of a young woman named Jenny, who discovers that she has been reincarnated multiple times throughout history, each time with a new chance to find true love.

At its core, The Nine Lives of Christmas is a film about the power of love and connection to transcend time and circumstance. Through Jenny's various incarnations, the movie shows how different eras and cultures can shape our experiences and relationships, but ultimately, it is the human heart that remains constant across centuries.

The film also touches on themes of self-discovery and personal growth, as Jenny navigates her multiple lives and learns to let go of past mistakes and regrets. As she moves through time, she encounters a range of characters who teach her valuable lessons about love, loss, and the importance of living in the present moment.

One of the main themes of The Nine Lives of Christmas is also the idea that our experiences and relationships are not defined by their duration or circumstances, but rather by the impact they have on us. Jenny's multiple lives serve as a reminder that every moment, no matter how brief or fleeting, has the potential to be transformative and meaningful.

Overall, The Nine Lives of Christmas is a heartwarming and romantic film that explores the complexities of love, relationships, and personal growth through the lens of reincarnation.

overview: Verena is a nurse who arrives at an old mansion in Italy to help a young boy who has fallen silent since the sudden passing of his mother.
tagline: Silence is calling
title: Voice from the Stone
plot:
Voice from the Stone is a 2017 Italian supernatural drama film directed by Donnie Yutes and written by Donnie Yutes and Marco Risi. The movie follows the story of a young woman named Mary, who takes in a mute and mysterious man named Silas, who has been living in the woods for years.

The main theme of Voice from the Stone revolves around the idea of isolation and loneliness. Both Mary and Silas have experienced deep emotional pain and trauma in their pasts, which has led them to withdraw from society and live on the fringes of human connection. Through their interactions with each other, the film explores the complexities of human relationships and the ways in which people can form connections despite their differences.

The movie also touches on themes of redemption and forgiveness. Silas, who is haunted by his past, begins to open up to Mary and share his story with her. As they spend more time together, Mary helps Silas to confront his demons and find a sense of peace and redemption. The film suggests that forgiveness is not just about letting go of the past, but also about finding a way to heal and move forward.

Furthermore, Voice from the Stone explores the idea of the power of human connection in breaking down barriers and transcending social boundaries. Mary and Silas's relationship challenges traditional notions of masculinity and femininity, as they navigate their differences and find common ground with each other.

Overall, the movie is a poignant exploration of the human condition, delving into themes of isolation, loneliness, redemption, forgiveness, and the transformative power of human connection.

overview: An eight-year-old boy is willing to do whatever it takes to end World War II so he can bring his father home. The story reveals the indescribable love a father has for his little boy and the love a son has for his father.
tagline: Believe the impossible.
title: Little Boy
plot:
Little Boy is a 2015 American drama film directed by David Green. The story revolves around a young boy's journey to cope with his father's absence during World War II.

The movie delves into the theme of grief and loss, as the protagonist, John Beardsley, struggles to come to terms with his father's deployment to war. The film explores the emotional toll of separation on a child, highlighting the difficulties of growing up without a parent by one's side.

Another significant theme in Little Boy is the power of friendship and human connection. As John navigates his way through childhood, he finds solace in his relationships with those around him, including his mother, his friends, and even a kind-hearted stranger who becomes a temporary guardian figure.

The film also touches on the theme of resilience and adaptability, as John learns to cope with the uncertainty and unpredictability of life. Through his experiences, he develops a strong sense of determination and resourcefulness, which ultimately helps him navigate the challenges of growing up without his father.

Overall, Little Boy is a poignant and powerful exploration of the human experience, tackling complex themes with sensitivity and nuance.

overview: The greatest Olympic Wrestling Champion brother team joins Team Foxcatcher led by multimillionaire sponsor John E. du Pont as they train for the 1988 games in Seoul - a union that leads to unlikely circumstances.
tagline: Ambition. Power. Control.
title: Foxcatcher
plot:
Foxcatcher is a 2014 biographical drama film that delves into the complex and dark world of Olympic wrestling and the twisted relationship between John du Pont, a wealthy heir, and two wrestlers, Mark Schultz and Dave Schultz. The main themes of Foxcatcher revolve around the darker aspects of human nature, particularly the corrupting influence of wealth and privilege.

At its core, Foxcatcher is a story about the destructive power of obsession and the blurring of reality and fantasy. John du Pont's fixation on wrestling and his desire to become a champion himself leads him down a path of madness, where he becomes increasingly isolated from reality. His relationship with Mark Schultz, in particular, is marked by a toxic dynamic of control and manipulation.

The film also explores the theme of identity and the search for meaning in life. Mark Schultz's journey is one of self-discovery, as he navigates his way through the world of wrestling and grapples with his own sense of purpose. His relationship with his brother Dave serves as a counterpoint to John du Pont's obsession, highlighting the importance of human connection and empathy.

Furthermore, Foxcatcher touches on the theme of class and privilege, showcasing the stark contrast between John du Pont's opulent lifestyle and the humble world of wrestling. The film raises questions about the nature of wealth and power, and how they can both corrupt and destroy individuals.

Ultimately, Foxcatcher is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that exposes the darker aspects of human nature, revealing the devastating consequences of unchecked ambition and the destructive power of obsession.

overview: Zen, an autistic teenage girl with powerful martial arts skills, gets money to pay for her sick mother Zin's treatment by seeking out all the people who owe Zin money and making them pay.
tagline: She's sweet but deadly.
title: Chocolate
plot:
Chocolate, also known as Zen, Warrior Within, is a 2008 Thai martial arts film directed by Prachya Pinkaew with fight choreography by Panna Rittikrai. Yanin "Jeeja" Vismistananda makes her screen debut as Zen, with Hiroshi Abe as Masashi, Pongpat Wachirabunjong as No. 8, Ammara Siripong as Zin and Taphon Phopwandee as Moom.

Zin, once the girlfriend of the Thai gangster No. 8, falls in love with his rival, the Japanese yakuza boss Masashi. No. 8 shoots off his own toe as a symbolic gesture and forbids Zin from ever seeing Masashi again, so she persuades Masashi to return to Japan for their safety. Soon afterward, Zin discovers she is pregnant and moves away to escape No. 8. Her daughter, Zen, proves to be autistic. When Zin later writes to Masashi about their child, No. 8 finds out and cuts off one of her toes as a warning, forcing her to move again, this time beside a Muay Thai school. Growing up, Zen becomes fascinated by martial arts and teaches herself by imitating the students next door and the Bruce Lee and Tony Jaa films she watches on television, also developing uncanny reflexes. Zin takes in Moom, a bullied street boy.

When Zin develops cancer and cannot pay for chemotherapy, Zen and Moom perform a street act, but it does not earn enough. Moom then finds an old notebook listing people who owed money to Zin from her days as a loan shark working for No. 8, and the pair set out to collect the debts. The first attempt turns violent, and Zen fights back with her self-taught skills, leading to clashes with several gangs and finally with No. 8 himself. Realizing that retaliation is coming, Zin sends Moom to mail a plea for help to Masashi; No. 8's gang seizes the boy but lets the letter go through, intending to deal with Zin and Masashi together, and Masashi leaves the yakuza to protect his family. When Zin and Zen confront No. 8 to rescue Moom, the meeting erupts into violence, and Zen battles through No. 8's men before throwing No. 8 to his death from a third-story ledge. She returns to find her mother dead, and Masashi comforts and adopts his daughter.

Pinkaew discovered Yanin in 2003 while casting Born to Fight; already trained in taekwondo, she trained further with Rittikrai's stunt team, and the script was developed around her. Reviews were generally positive (71% on Rotten Tomatoes), praising the stunt work and action choreography but faulted the plot. Its success prompted Sahamongkol Film International to announce a sequel.

overview: As the holiday season rolls around and all the Peanuts gang are getting ready for it. Whether it be Charlie Brown struggling to raise money for his girlfriend or Sally and Peppermint Patty struggling to rehearse and memorize their one word lines for the Christmas pageant, these kids try to keep with the Christmas spirit while Snoopy has his mischief to do.
title: It's Christmastime Again, Charlie Brown
plot:
"It's Christmastime Again, Charlie Brown" is a heartwarming animated special that explores the complexities of friendship, love, and the true meaning of Christmas. The story revolves around Charlie Brown as he navigates his feelings for the Little Red-Haired Girl, while also trying to help Linus understand the significance of Christmas.

At its core, the movie delves into the theme of unrequited love and the pain of rejection. Charlie Brown's longing for the Little Red-Haired Girl serves as a poignant reminder that sometimes, even with the best intentions, we may not receive the affection or validation we desire. This narrative thread is woven throughout the story, adding depth and nuance to the otherwise lighthearted tale.

The movie also touches on the idea of friendship and loyalty, particularly in the relationship between Charlie Brown and Linus. Their bond serves as a source of comfort and support for both characters, helping them navigate the challenges they face during the holiday season.

Furthermore, "It's Christmastime Again, Charlie Brown" explores the theme of finding meaning and purpose in life. As Linus grapples with his own feelings about Christmas, he comes to realize that the true spirit of the holiday is not about material gifts or superficial trappings, but rather about kindness, compassion, and love.

Ultimately, the movie presents a hopeful and optimistic portrayal of the holiday season, one that emphasizes the importance of human connection and the power of love to transcend even the most difficult challenges.

overview: Carl Allen has stumbled across a way to shake free of post-divorce blues and a dead-end job: embrace life and say yes to everything.
tagline: One Word Can Change Everything.
title: Yes Man
plot:
Yes Man is a 2008 American comedy film directed by Nicholas Stoller and starring Jim Carrey, Zooey Deschanel, and Bradley Cooper.

The movie begins with Carl Allen (Jim Carrey), a recently divorced man who feels lost and uncertain about his life. He has been stuck in a rut, feeling unfulfilled and disconnected from the world around him. On his 39th birthday, he is given an unusual gift by his brother: a "yes" card that forces him to say "yes" to every opportunity that comes his way.

At first, Carl is hesitant and struggles with the idea of committing to everything that's presented to him. However, as time passes, he starts to realize the benefits of saying "yes" to new experiences and people. He begins to reconnect with old friends, try new hobbies, and even start dating again.

One of the people Carl meets through his newfound enthusiasm is Allison (Zooey Deschanel), a quirky and charming woman who becomes his love interest. As they spend more time together, Carl finds himself falling for her, but he's also faced with challenges from his brother, who wants him to say "no" to everything.

As the story unfolds, Carl faces various obstacles and learns valuable lessons about taking risks, being open-minded, and embracing uncertainty. He says "yes" to a job offer that turns out to be a disaster, joins a group of eccentric friends who become like a surrogate family to him, and even takes up skydiving.

Throughout the movie, Jim Carrey's performance is both hilarious and heartwarming as he brings Carl's transformation from a hesitant to an enthusiastic "yes" man. The supporting cast, including Bradley Cooper and Rhys Ifans, add to the humor and charm of the film.

As the story reaches its climax, Carl must confront his brother and figure out what it truly means to say "yes" to life. In the end, he learns that embracing uncertainty and taking risks can lead to personal growth, new relationships, and a sense of fulfillment.

The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Carl having found a new sense of purpose and happiness. He's still got his "yes" card, but now he knows how to use it wisely. The film is a lighthearted and entertaining exploration of the importance of taking chances and living life to the fullest.

Overall, Yes Man is a delightful comedy that will leave you smiling and feeling inspired to take a few risks in your own life.

overview: As a group of university students go out for a night on the town, a sophomore known only as "The Girl with Black Hair" experiences a series of surreal encounters with the local nightlife – all the while unaware of the romantic longings of "Senpai", a senior student who has been creating increasingly fantastic and contrived reasons to run into her in an effort to win her heart.
tagline: Meeting like this so often, it's due to fate.
title: Night Is Short, Walk On Girl
plot:
Night Is Short, Walk on Girl is a 2017 Japanese romantic comedy-drama film directed by Masaaki Yuasa. The movie follows the story of Hanako, a high school girl who has a unique and fascinating way of experiencing life.

At its core, Night Is Short, Walk on Girl explores themes of identity, self-discovery, and the complexities of human relationships. Through Hanako's character, the film delves into the struggles of adolescence, where individuals are trying to find their place in the world and navigate the challenges of growing up.

The movie also touches on the idea of escapism and the power of imagination as a means of coping with the difficulties of life. Hanako's experiences are often surreal and fantastical, blurring the lines between reality and fantasy. This serves as a metaphor for the way people often use their imaginations to escape the mundanity of everyday life.

Furthermore, Night Is Short, Walk on Girl examines the complexities of female relationships and the ways in which women interact with each other. The film portrays a cast of characters who are all struggling with their own identities and desires, and it offers a nuanced exploration of the ways in which these relationships can be both supportive and suffocating.

Overall, Night Is Short, Walk on Girl is a thought-provoking and visually stunning film that explores the complexities of human experience through the lens of a unique and fascinating protagonist.

overview: Wreck-It Ralph is the 9-foot-tall, 643-pound villain of an arcade video game named Fix-It Felix Jr., in which the game's titular hero fixes buildings that Ralph destroys. Wanting to prove he can be a good guy and not just a villain, Ralph escapes his game and lands in Hero's Duty, a first-person shooter where he helps the game's hero battle against alien invaders. He later enters Sugar Rush, a kart racing game set on tracks made of candies, cookies and other sweets. There, Ralph meets Vanellope von Schweetz who has learned that her game is faced with a dire threat that could affect the entire arcade, and one that Ralph may have inadvertently started.
tagline: The story of a regular guy just looking for a little wreck-ognition.
title: Wreck-It Ralph
plot:
Wreck-It Ralph is a 2012 animated science fiction comedy film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios. The movie takes place in a world where arcade games are alive, and follows the story of Ralph, an antagonist character from the classic arcade game Fix-It Felix.

The film begins with Ralph (voiced by John C. Reilly), a large, green, hulking monster who lives in the Nicelanders' arcade game "Fix-It Felix." In this game, Ralph's job is to wreck the apartment building so that Felix (voiced by Jack McBrayer) can fix it and earn points for the game. However, Ralph feels unappreciated and lonely, as he is only allowed to play with the Nicelanders' arcade games when no one else is around.

One day, Ralph decides to explore other arcade games to find a new purpose in life. He visits Sugar Rush, a fast-paced racing game where he meets Vanellope von Schweetz (voiced by Sarah Silverman), a glitchy and energetic character who becomes his friend. However, their fun is short-lived as Ralph discovers that the game's main character, Vanellope, has been banned from competing in the Sugar Rush Grand Prix due to her glitch.

Ralph decides to help Vanellope enter the tournament, but things become complicated when he realizes that the only way for her to compete is by exploiting a bug in the game. Ralph and Vanellope's friendship deepens as they work together to fix the bug and save the Sugar Rush Grand Prix.

Meanwhile, Felix becomes jealous of Ralph's newfound friendships and tries to sabotage his efforts. However, Ralph eventually finds a new purpose in life when he realizes that being an antagonist is not all bad - it allows him to have fun and be himself.

In the end, Ralph and Vanellope successfully fix the bug, and Vanellope wins the Sugar Rush Grand Prix. The movie ends with Ralph returning to Nicelanders' arcade game, but this time as a hero, having found a new sense of belonging and purpose in life.

Throughout the film, the animation is vibrant and colorful, with a mix of 8-bit and 16-bit graphics that pay homage to classic video games. The voice acting is also excellent, with John C. Reilly bringing Ralph's lovable but gruff personality to life, while Sarah Silverman adds a fun and quirky touch to Vanellope.

Overall, Wreck-It Ralph is a heartwarming and hilarious film that explores themes of identity, friendship, and finding one's purpose in life. The movie features a talented voice cast, stunning animation, and a story that will leave audiences laughing and cheering for more.

overview: A young street-smart, Nathan Drake and his wisecracking partner Victor “Sully” Sullivan embark on a dangerous pursuit of “the greatest treasure never found” while also tracking clues that may lead to Nathan’s long-lost brother.
tagline: Fortune favors the bold.
title: Uncharted
plot:
Uncharted is an action-adventure film directed by Ruben Fleischer, released in 2022. The movie is based on the popular video game series of the same name, developed by Naughty Dog.

The story follows Nathan Drake (played by Tom Holland), a young and charismatic treasure hunter who becomes embroiled in a global adventure. Nathan's life takes a dramatic turn when he meets Victor Sullivan (played by Mark Wahlberg), an older and more experienced treasure hunter who becomes his mentor.

As they embark on a perilous journey to find the lost city of El Dorado, Nathan and Victor are pursued by a ruthless adversary, Sully's former partner, Chloe Frazer (played by Sophia Ali). Chloe is driven by a desire for revenge against Sully, whom she believes wronged her in the past.

Throughout their quest, Nathan and Victor must navigate treacherous jungles, avoid deadly traps, and fight off rival treasure hunters. Along the way, Nathan discovers more about his own family history and the secrets surrounding his father's disappearance.

As the stakes grow higher, Nathan finds himself torn between his loyalty to Sully and his growing feelings for Chloe. The film's climax features an intense showdown between Nathan and Chloe, with the fate of El Dorado hanging in the balance.

One of the standout aspects of Uncharted is its strong performances from the cast, particularly Tom Holland and Mark Wahlberg. Their chemistry on screen is undeniable, and their characters' banter adds a welcome layer of humor to the film.

While the movie takes some creative liberties with the source material, it remains faithful to the spirit of the video game series. The action sequences are thrilling, and the cinematography captures the lush beauty of the jungle environments.

Overall, Uncharted is an entertaining and action-packed adventure that explores themes of loyalty, family, and redemption. With its talented cast and engaging storyline, it's a great addition to the action-adventure genre.

overview: The story 11-year-old Luis who makes friends with three loveable little aliens, who crash their UFO into his house. In return for Luis' help in finding the home-shopping channel stuff they came for, they save Luis from boarding school - and an exciting adventure follows.
production_companies: MEDIA Programme of the European Union
tagline: Extraterrestrial. Extra trouble.
title: Luis and the Aliens
plot:
Luis and the Aliens is a 2018 English-language animated science fiction comedy written and directed by the brothers Christoph and Wolfgang Lauenstein, who won an Academy Award for their short Balance, with Sean McCormack as co-director. A German, Luxembourgish and Danish co-production by Ulysses Filmproduktion, Fabrique d'Images and A. Film, it features the voices of Callum Maloney as Luis, Dermot Magennis as his father, Lucy Carolan, Eoin Daly and Aileen Mythen, while the North American version adds Will Forte and Lea Thompson.

Luis Sonntag is a lonely boy whose mother died long ago. His father Armin, an absent-minded ufologist obsessed with proving that evil aliens have designs on Earth, spends his nights at his telescope, leaving Luis to cook, tidy the house and even bake his own birthday cake. At school Luis is picked on by a bully and overlooked by Jennifer, the girl he admires. On his birthday he becomes the only witness when three small, blob-like aliens, Mog, Nag and Wabo, crash-land beside his house. They have come to Earth to buy a massage mat called the Nubbi Dubbi that they saw advertised on a television shopping channel, and they can take on anyone's appearance once they have eaten a piece of that person's hair, although they are much better at looking like people than at behaving like them. Luis has never had so much fun, but knows his father must not discover his secret. Meanwhile the stern Ms. Diekendaker, the head of a home for problem children, persuades Luis's principal that the boy should be sent away unless a meeting with his father goes perfectly, so Luis has one of his new friends impersonate Armin. As the aliens' clumsy disguises cause one misunderstanding after another, Luis must protect them, help them get back to their mothership and keep himself out of Ms. Diekendaker's hands, discovering along the way that his father was right about menacing aliens.

The film premiered at the Luxembourg City Film Festival on March 2, 2018 and was released in Germany on May 24, in North America on August 17 and in the United Kingdom, by Warner Bros., on August 24, 2018, grossing about $12.6 million worldwide. It was better received in Europe than in the United States or Britain. The Hollywood Reporter called it peppy but ordinary and dull, and The Guardian found it bland and derivative, criticizing lazy stereotypes, whereas Katie Walsh of the Los Angeles Times considered it rote but lifted by a surprisingly sad heart.

overview: In Italy, a woman becomes involved in a series of unauthorized exorcisms during her mission to discover what happened to her mother, who allegedly murdered three people during her own exorcism.
tagline: No soul is safe.
title: The Devil Inside
plot:
The Devil Inside is a 2012 American supernatural horror film directed by William Brent Bell, who co-wrote it with Matthew Peterman. Presented as found footage, it stars Fernanda Andrade as Isabella Rossi, a woman drawn into a series of exorcisms while trying to understand why her mother killed three people, with Simon Quarterman and Evan Helmuth as the priests Ben Rawlings and David Keane.

On October 30, 1989, Maria Rossi killed three people during an exorcism performed on her, and has since been held in a church psychiatric hospital in Rome. Her daughter, Isabella, learned of the killings from her father, who died three days after telling her. Twenty years later, Isabella is making a documentary about exorcism with filmmaker Michael Schaefer and travels to Rome to visit her mother, meeting priests Ben and David, who perform unauthorized exorcisms. Maria speaks in shifting accents and bears inverted crosses carved into her skin. She tells Isabella that killing a child is against God's will, seemingly alluding to an abortion her mother could not have known about.

The priests take her to the exorcism of a young woman, Rosalita, who calls Isabella by name and attacks the crew. During an exorcism of Maria, she taunts Ben about his past, and the ritual fails, but she appears to pass demons on to David and Isabella. Ben finds that four demons speak through Maria at once. While performing a baptism, David begins forcing the infant under the holy water before collapsing, and Ben later finds him at home with his forearms covered in blood, as Maria's had been. When police arrive, David seizes an officer's gun and, unable to finish reciting the Lord's Prayer, shoots himself. Isabella has a seizure and in the hospital slashes a nurse's throat. As Ben and Michael drive her to seek help, she breathes into Michael's mouth, possessing him, and he steers into oncoming traffic, killing himself and Ben, while Isabella vanishes from the wreck. A closing title says the case remains unresolved.

Peterman conceived the idea in 2005 after reading about the Catholic Church's exorcism school. Shot in 2010 in Bucharest and Rome, it was acquired by Paramount's low-budget label Insurge Pictures and released on January 6, 2012. It was not screened for critics, who panned it, giving it 6% on Rotten Tomatoes and 18 on Metacritic, with an F CinemaScore and a widely mocked ending. Even so, it grossed $101.8 million on a $1 million budget.

overview: Tells the story of Jesus Christ at age seven as he and his family depart Egypt to return home to Nazareth. Told from his childhood perspective, it follows young Jesus as he grows into his religious identity.
tagline: Before he was the savior, he was a child.
title: The Young Messiah
plot:
The Young Messiah (2016) is a historical drama film directed by Cyrus Nowrasteh, which tells the story of Jesus Christ's life as a young boy.

The main themes of The Young Messiah include:

1. **Faith and Spirituality**: The film explores Jesus' early life, his relationship with God, and his journey to becoming the Son of God. It delves into the spiritual struggles and triumphs of a young Jesus, showcasing his devotion to his faith.
2. **Identity and Purpose**: As Jesus navigates his role as the Messiah, he faces questions about his identity, purpose, and destiny. The film examines how these questions shape his character and inform his decisions.
3. **Family and Relationships**: The movie highlights the importance of family and relationships in shaping Jesus' life. His interactions with his parents, Mary and Joseph, and his friendships with other children in Nazareth provide a glimpse into his early experiences and values.
4. **Power and Corruption**: As Jesus begins to exhibit extraordinary abilities, he attracts attention from those who seek power and control. The film explores the tension between Jesus' desire for humility and the temptation of power by those around him.
5. **Coming of Age**: The Young Messiah can be seen as a coming-of-age story, where Jesus faces challenges and learns valuable lessons about himself, his faith, and the world around him.

The film features a strong performance from Jonathan Roumie as Jesus Christ, who brings depth and nuance to the character. Overall, The Young Messiah offers a thought-provoking exploration of Jesus' early life, faith, and identity, making it a compelling watch for fans of historical dramas and biblical epics.

overview: An adrenaline seeking snowboarder gets lost in a massive winter storm in the back country of the High Sierras where he is pushed to the limits of human endurance and forced to battle his own personal demons as he fights for survival....
tagline: Miracle on the Mountain
title: 6 Below: Miracle on the Mountain
plot:
"6 Below: Miracle on the Mountain" is a biographical drama film directed by Richard Kelly, based on the true story of Aron Ralston, an American outdoorsman and mountaineer. The movie follows Ralston's harrowing experience in 2003 when he became trapped in a canyon for 127 hours.

The main themes of "6 Below: Miracle on the Mountain" include:

1. **Survival and Resilience**: Aron Ralston's story is a testament to human endurance and resilience. Despite being trapped for an extended period, Ralston finds ways to survive, including rationing his food, conserving energy, and maintaining his mental health.
2. **Self-Discovery and Redemption**: Throughout the film, Ralston grapples with feelings of guilt, regret, and self-doubt. His experience in the canyon forces him to confront these emotions and ultimately find a path towards redemption and personal growth.
3. **The Power of Human Connection**: The movie highlights the importance of human relationships in our lives. Ralston's interactions with his family, friends, and strangers who help him during his ordeal serve as a reminder that we are not alone in our struggles.
4. **The Importance of Nature and Exploration**: As an avid outdoorsman, Ralston's love for nature and adventure is a central theme in the film. His experiences in the canyon and subsequent travels serve as a reminder of the beauty and danger that can be found in the natural world.

Overall, "6 Below: Miracle on the Mountain" is a powerful and inspiring film that explores themes of survival, self-discovery, human connection, and the importance of nature and exploration.

overview: Two alchemist brothers go on a quest for the Philosopher's Stone after an attempt to revive their dead mother goes horribly wrong.
title: Fullmetal Alchemist
plot:
Fullmetal Alchemist (Hagane no Renkinjutsushi) is a Japanese science fantasy action film of 2017 directed by Fumihiko Sori and adapted from Hiromu Arakawa's manga. Ryosuke Yamada stars as Edward Elric, with Atomu Mizuishi as his brother Alphonse, Tsubasa Honda as their friend Winry Rockbell, Dean Fujioka as Colonel Roy Mustang, Ryuta Sato as Maes Hughes and Yasuko Matsuyuki as Lust. Warner Bros. released it in Japan on 1 December 2017.

In the land of Amestris, Edward and Alphonse grow up in a rural town with their mother Trisha. When she dies of illness, the boys attempt the forbidden art of human transmutation to bring her back, and pay the price of equivalent exchange: Edward loses his left leg and Alphonse is pulled into the Gate of Truth. Edward gives up his right arm to recover his brother's soul and bind it to a suit of armor, and Winry's family fits him with automail prostheses. Recruited by Mustang, Edward becomes the youngest State Alchemist, the Fullmetal Alchemist, and the brothers begin searching for the legendary Philosopher's Stone that could restore their bodies.

Years later, Major General Hakuro introduces the teenage brothers to Shou Tucker, who earned his state license by creating a talking chimera. Tucker sends them to Dr. Tim Marcoh, a former stone-maker in hiding, who is killed by the assassin Lust. Returning to Tucker's home, the brothers discover that he has fused his little daughter Nina with the family dog to keep his credentials; they have him arrested, but not before he sows a bitter quarrel between them. Hughes finds something alarming in Marcoh's notes and is murdered by Lust's partner Envy.

Marcoh's research leads Edward to the secret Fifth Laboratory, where the now-deranged Tucker is holding Alphonse and Winry. There Edward learns that Philosopher's Stones are made from human lives and breaks down. Lust kills Tucker, revealing herself as a homunculus, and Hakuro, her ally, admits the military made stones from human captives; he unleashes an army of artificial Mannequin Soldiers powered by stones, which kill him. As the army destroys them, Mustang kills Lust and gives Edward the stone from her body, but the brothers refuse to use it to restore Alphonse. Instead Edward uses it to reach his brother's real body at the Gate of Truth and vows to find another way.

It was shot in Italy and Japan in 2016. Netflix released the film internationally in February 2018. Reviews were mixed, and two sequels followed in 2022.

overview: After a global war, the seaside kingdom known as the Valley of the Wind remains one of the last strongholds on Earth untouched by a poisonous jungle and the powerful insects that guard it. Led by the courageous Princess Nausicaä, the people of the Valley engage in an epic struggle to restore the bond between humanity and Earth.
tagline: A young girl's love called forth miracles…
title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
plot:
Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind is a 1984 animated science fantasy film written and directed by Hayao Miyazaki, produced by Topcraft. The film is set in a post-apocalyptic world where humans have been devastated by environmental disasters.

In the year 2029, the world has been ravaged by pollution, climate change, and war between nations over resources. The story takes place in the Valley of the Wind, a small island nation that has managed to maintain its independence and ecological balance despite the devastation around it. The film follows the journey of Princess Nausicaä, the 17-year-old princess of the Valley of the Wind.

Nausicaä is a kind-hearted and compassionate young woman who is deeply concerned about the well-being of her people and the environment. She is also an accomplished warrior and scientist, skilled in the art of combat and the study of the natural world. Nausicaä's mother, Queen Kushana, has died, leaving her to take on the responsibility of leading the Valley of the Wind.

The film begins with Nausicaä's encounter with a group of toxic waste-spewing machines known as the "Hijackers," which have been terrorizing the surrounding lands. She also meets Asbel, a young man from the neighboring kingdom of Tolmekia, who has come to the Valley of the Wind seeking refuge.

As Nausicaä and Asbel form a bond, they become embroiled in a conflict between the Valley of the Wind and the neighboring kingdom of Tolmekia. The Tolmekians are seeking to expand their territory and exploit the natural resources of the surrounding lands, including the Valley of the Wind's unique ecosystem.

Throughout the film, Nausicaä must navigate the complexities of politics, war, and environmentalism. She is aided by her friends and allies, including her mentor, Lord Yupa, a wise and experienced leader who has guided the Valley of the Wind for many years.

As the conflict escalates, Nausicaä discovers that the Hijackers are being controlled by a powerful and malevolent force known as the "God of the Dead," a creature from ancient mythology that feeds on human suffering. The God of the Dead is revealed to be a manifestation of humanity's destructive tendencies, and Nausicaä must confront her own role in perpetuating these destructive forces.

In the climactic final battle, Nausicaä faces off against the leader of the Tolmekians, King Jah, who has become corrupted by his desire for power and control. With the help of her friends and allies, Nausicaä is able to defeat Jah and shatter the God of the Dead's hold on the world.

The film concludes with Nausicaä reflecting on the lessons she has learned about the importance of compassion, cooperation, and environmental stewardship. She realizes that true strength lies not in military might or technological advancements, but in understanding and respecting the natural world.

Overall, Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind is a powerful and thought-provoking film that explores themes of environmentalism, pacifism, and the importance of human connection in a world torn apart by conflict and destruction.

overview: Gretta, a budding songwriter, finds herself alone after her boyfriend Dave ditches her. Her life gains purpose when Dan, a record label executive, notices her talent.
tagline: You're only as strong as your next move.
title: Begin Again
plot:
Begin Again is a 2013 American musical romantic comedy-drama film directed by John Carney and written by Mark Murphy. The movie stars Keira Knightley, Mark Ruffalo, James Corden, and Hailee Steinfeld.

The main themes of Begin Again revolve around the power of music, love, and redemption. The story follows Greta (Keira Knightley), a struggling singer-songwriter who is trying to make it big in New York City. She meets Dan (Mark Ruffalo), a record executive who is going through a midlife crisis.

As they navigate their relationship, Greta and Dan team up with two aspiring musicians, Jake (James Corden) and Gina (Hailee Steinfeld). Together, they form an indie band and use the streets of New York City as their stage to perform. The movie showcases the beauty of music as a way to bring people together and find inspiration.

Throughout the film, Greta's character undergoes significant development as she learns to let go of her past and trust herself. Dan, on the other hand, finds redemption through his relationship with Greta and his rediscovery of his passion for music.

The movie explores themes of:

1. The power of music: Music is a universal language that can bring people together and evoke emotions.
2. Love and relationships: The film highlights the complexities of love, friendship, and finding one's true partner.
3. Redemption and personal growth: Both Greta and Dan undergo significant transformations as they learn to let go of their past mistakes and find new beginnings.

Overall, Begin Again is a heartwarming and uplifting film that celebrates the beauty of music, love, and redemption.

original_title: Taylor Swift: The 1989 World Tour - Live
overview: Filmed in front of 76,000 fans at the ANZ Stadium in Sydney, Australia, "The 1989 World Tour Live" captures Taylor Swift's entire performance while also mixing in behind-the-scene, rehearsal, and special guest footage from her 1989 Tour.
tagline: She lost him, but she found herself. And somehow that was everything.
title: Taylor Swift: The 1989 World Tour - Live
plot:
The 1989 World Tour Live is a 2015 American concert film by the singer-songwriter Taylor Swift, documenting her fourth concert tour, the 1989 World Tour, staged in support of her fifth studio album, 1989 (2014), her first record marketed as pop rather than country. Directed by Jonas Åkerlund and produced in partnership with Apple Music, the film was shot at the show of 28 November 2015 at ANZ Stadium in Sydney, Australia, and also includes behind-the-scenes footage and appearances by special guests from shows in North America and Europe. Its release marked Swift's first collaboration with Apple, coming months after she pulled her catalog from Spotify over its payment model and after Apple agreed to pay artists during the free trial period of its streaming service.

The concert opens with black-and-white projections of street scenes as Swift rises from beneath the stage to sing "Welcome to New York," followed by "New Romantics" and "Blank Space," and an industrial rock version of "I Knew You Were Trouble." The set moves through "I Wish You Would," a Singin' in the Rain-inspired staging of "How You Get the Girl" with dancers twirling neon umbrellas, and "I Know Places," in which masked dancers chase her through moving doors. Swift introduces "Clean" by sharing lessons from her personal life and performs a synth-driven "Love Story" on an elevated platform that sweeps around the stadium. Later highlights include "Style," "This Love," "Bad Blood" in a black leather suit, a rock rendition of "We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together" on electric guitar, a piano mashup of "Enchanted" and "Wildest Dreams," and "Out of the Woods" beneath giant paper planes, before the show closes with "Shake It Off" on a platform above the crowd amid fireworks and confetti.

The tour began in Tokyo on 5 May 2015 and ended in Melbourne on 12 December, spanning 85 shows. It was the highest-grossing tour of 2015, selling more than 2.27 million tickets and grossing over 250 million dollars, and critics praised Swift's stage presence and connection with her audience, while her parade of celebrity guests drew wide comment. Announced on 13 December 2015, the film premiered exclusively on Apple Music on 20 December 2015 and remained on the service until 22 May 2020; footage from it was also used in the music video for "New Romantics."

overview: William Thatcher, a knight's peasant apprentice, gets a chance at glory when the knight dies suddenly mid-tournament. Posing as a knight himself, William won't stop until he's crowned tournament champion—assuming matters of the heart don't get in the way.
tagline: He Will Rock You
title: A Knight's Tale
plot:
A Knight's Tale is a 2001 medieval adventure comedy film directed by Brian Helgeland and starring Heath Ledger, Paul Bettany, and Shannyn Sossamon. The movie is set in the late 14th century and follows the story of William Thatcher (Heath Ledger), a poor squire who dreams of becoming a knight.

The film begins with William, a young man from a humble background, living on his family's farm. He spends most of his days helping his father, a blacksmith, and dreaming of adventure beyond their village. One day, the local lord, Sir Ector (Paul Bettany), announces that he will hold a tournament to find a new knight to serve him. William sees this as an opportunity to prove himself and become a knight.

However, there's a catch - the only way for William to participate in the tournament is if he can disguise himself as a noble knight. He comes up with a plan to pretend to be the son of a deceased knight, Sir Ulrich von Liebewort (Alan Tudyk), who was known for his bravery and skill on horseback.

William's plan works, and he gains the trust of Sir Ector, who becomes his mentor. As William prepares for the tournament, he meets Jocelyn (Shannyn Sossamon), a beautiful and talented jester who becomes his love interest. Meanwhile, William faces stiff competition from other knights, including the arrogant Count Adhemar (Rufus Sewell).

As the tournament progresses, William's skills as a knight are put to the test. He faces off against various opponents, using his wit, bravery, and cunning to outmaneuver them. Along the way, he also learns valuable lessons about honor, loyalty, and the true meaning of knighthood.

In the final match, William faces off against Count Adhemar in a thrilling jousting competition. Despite being outnumbered and outmatched, William uses his quick thinking and agility to gain the upper hand. In the end, he emerges victorious, earning the respect and admiration of the crowd and Sir Ector.

The movie ends with William being knighted by Sir Ector, who recognizes him as a true knight in his own right. William also wins Jocelyn's heart, and the two share a romantic moment. The film concludes on a high note, with William riding off into the sunset, ready to face new challenges and adventures.

Overall, A Knight's Tale is a fun and entertaining movie that combines action, adventure, and romance. Heath Ledger shines as the lead character, bringing a youthful energy and charisma to the role. The supporting cast adds depth and humor to the story, making it a delightful watch from start to finish.

overview: A young woman, traumatized by a tragic event in her past, seeks out vengeance against those who crossed her path.
tagline: Revenge never looked so promising.
title: Promising Young Woman
plot:
Promising Young Woman is a 2020 American black comedy thriller film written and directed by Emerald Fennell. The movie stars Carey Mulligan, Bo Burnham, Alison Brie, and Chris Evans.

The story follows Cassie Thomas (Carey Mulligan), a successful medical school dropout who has been living with a traumatic event from her past. After witnessing the rape of her best friend Emily (Alyah Chanelle Scott) by their college acquaintance, Ryan (Molly Burnett), Cassie's life took a drastic turn. She became withdrawn and isolated, unable to shake off the guilt and anger that consumed her.

The movie begins with Cassie attending a medical school reunion, where she is forced to confront her past and the choices she made after dropping out of medical school. She meets Dean (Max Greenfield), a charming but shallow man who is now working as a doctor at the same hospital where Emily was raped. The encounter sparks a sense of unease in Cassie, and she begins to formulate a plan for revenge.

Cassie's plan involves pretending to be a vulnerable and intoxicated woman, allowing men to take advantage of her before she "wakes up" and exacts her revenge on them. She starts by targeting the same men who were present at Emily's party that night, including Ryan, Dean, and several others. As Cassie navigates this new persona, she begins to confront the societal norms and expectations that led to Emily's rape.

Throughout the movie, Fennell expertly weaves together themes of trauma, consent, and female empowerment. Cassie's character is a complex and multifaceted one, driven by a desire for justice and revenge. However, as the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Cassie's motivations are not solely driven by anger, but also by a deep-seated need to reclaim her own agency and autonomy.

As Cassie's plan gains momentum, she begins to attract attention from Dean, who is initially oblivious to her true intentions. The two engage in a cat-and-mouse game, with Cassie using her newfound persona to manipulate Dean into becoming more invested in their relationship.

The movie builds towards a thrilling climax, as Cassie's plan reaches its fruition. In the end, Cassie exacts her revenge on the men who wronged Emily and herself, but not before confronting the darker aspects of her own psyche. The film ends with Cassie walking away from the wreckage, symbolizing her newfound freedom and empowerment.

Overall, Promising Young Woman is a thought-provoking and timely commentary on the societal norms that perpetuate rape culture. Fennell's direction is masterful, and Mulligan delivers a standout performance as the complex and multifaceted Cassie Thomas.

overview: A slightly dystopian vision of LA, we follow three disaffected teenagers, Jessie, Calvin and Nicky, all victims of extreme childhoods, running supreme hedonistic riot as they try to work out a way in life.
title: Gully
plot:
