Throughout the film, the animation is stunning, with vibrant colors and detailed character designs that bring the world of Bungo Stray Dogs to life. The action sequences are intense and well-choreographed, making for an exhilarating viewing experience.

Ultimately, Atsushi and his team succeed in defeating The Order and recovering the Dead Apple. However, the film's ending is bittersweet, leaving room for interpretation about the true nature of Shizuka Kurogane's intentions and the consequences of her actions.

Overall, Bungo Stray Dogs: Dead Apple is a gripping and thought-provoking thriller that explores themes of identity, power, and the blurred lines between human and artificial intelligence. With its engaging characters, intricate plot, and stunning animation, it is a must-see for fans of the series and anime enthusiasts alike.

overview: The story of a mild-mannered radio executive who strives to become the best stepdad ever to his wife's two children, but complications ensue when their freewheeling, freeloading real father arrives, forcing stepdad to compete for the affection of the kids.
tagline: Choose your Daddy
title: Daddy's Home
plot:
Daddy's Home is a 2015 American comedy film directed by Sean Anders and John Morris, written by Anders and Morris, and produced by Paramount Pictures.

The movie follows the story of Brad Whitaker (Will Ferrell), a radio host who is recently divorced from his wife Sara (Linda Cardellini). Brad meets Sara's two sons, Dylan (Owen Vaccaro) and Miles (Noah Schnapp), from her previous marriage to Dusty Mayron (Mark Wahlberg), a tough and rugged ex-cop.

Brad is determined to become the new "Daddy" in the boys' lives and win their hearts. However, things get complicated when Dusty returns to the picture, and the two men engage in an escalating series of pranks and one-upmanship to outdo each other as the favorite father figure.

As the competition between Brad and Dusty intensifies, the boys begin to feel torn between their love for both fathers. Meanwhile, Sara is struggling to balance her own life and relationships with her sons' conflicting feelings towards Brad and Dusty.

Throughout the movie, Brad's antics become increasingly absurd and childish, while Dusty's tough exterior hides a softer side as he tries to connect with his sons on a deeper level. The two men engage in a series of hilarious and ridiculous competitions, including a wild goose chase through the neighborhood and a showdown at a local amusement park.

As the story unfolds, Brad and Dusty are forced to confront their own insecurities and vulnerabilities as fathers. In the end, they come together to support each other and work towards creating a harmonious family environment for Dylan and Miles.

The movie features plenty of comedic moments, thanks to the chemistry between Ferrell and Wahlberg, who play off each other's strengths and weaknesses perfectly. The supporting cast, including Cardellini and Schnapp, add to the humor and heart of the film.

Overall, Daddy's Home is a lighthearted and entertaining comedy that explores the complexities of family relationships and the challenges of becoming a new father figure in someone else's life.

overview: Twins separated at birth, Camryn and Alex meet by chance for the first time on their 21st birthday and discover they're witches with the power to save their homeland of Coventry from the evil that threatens it. But when Camryn leaves Alex to face the darkness alone, will Coventry be doomed? Or will the sisters multiply their magic by standing together?
title: Twitches
plot:
Twitches is an American fantasy comedy-drama of 2005 made as a Disney Channel Original Movie, directed by Stuart Gillard and written by Melissa Gould and Dan Berendsen, based on the Twitches book series by H. B. Gilmour and Randi Reisfeld. Tia and Tamera Mowry star as Alex Fielding and Camryn Barnes, twin witches separated at birth, with Kristen Wilson as their mother Miranda, Patrick Fabian as their uncle Thantos. It premiered on 14 October 2005.

In the magical realm of Coventry, the royal witch Miranda gives birth to identical twin girls on Halloween night. Named Apolla and Artemis, they wear sun and moon amulets. Their father, the powerful warlock Aron DuBaer, dies after pouring all his magic into protecting them from an evil force called the Darkness. The family friends Karsh and Ileana spirit the babies away to Earth and give them up for adoption. Apolla is raised by a wealthy couple as Camryn Barnes, while Artemis is raised by a single mother as Alex Fielding.

Alex grows up a night owl who writes stories about magical twin sisters without knowing they are true. Camryn, an early riser and passionate artist, unknowingly sketches Miranda and Coventry. On their 21st birthday, Karsh and Ileana steer Alex into the shop where Camryn is trying on clothes. Camryn is thrilled, but when she grabs the fleeing Alex's hand, a burst of energy releases their powers. The guardians reveal the sisters' origins and a prophecy that only they can defeat the Darkness and restore Coventry. Alex, whose stories all end in death, wants no part of it, but Camryn persuades her, and the two practice their magic and grow close.

Miranda, now married to Aron's brother Thantos, senses that her daughters are alive. When the Darkness reaches Alex's apartment, the twins escape to Coventry, but the overwhelmed Camryn returns to Earth for her birthday party. Alex stays and meets Thantos, who warns that Camryn is powerless alone. At the party, Camryn learns from the Darkness itself that Thantos controls it, and she escapes to Coventry as Karsh and Ileana sacrifice themselves to help her. Exposed, Thantos admits murdering Aron for wealth and power, seizes Miranda and rampages through the castle until the twins unite their magic of light and love to destroy him, restoring Coventry and reviving Miranda, Karsh and Ileana. The sisters then celebrate their birthday on Earth with their adoptive families.

Shot in Toronto in 2005, the film was followed by a sequel, Twitches Too, in 2007.

overview: Ren MacCormack is transplanted from Boston to the small southern town of Bomont where loud music and dancing are prohibited. Not one to bow to the status quo, Ren challenges the ban, revitalizing the town and falling in love with the minister’s troubled daughter Ariel in the process.
tagline: There comes a time to cut loose
title: Footloose
plot:
Footloose is an American musical drama of 2011 and a remake of the 1984 film, directed by Craig Brewer from a script he wrote with Dean Pitchford. Kenny Wormald stars as Ren McCormack, a Boston teenager who challenges a small Southern town's ban on dancing, with Julianne Hough as Ariel Moore, Dennis Quaid as her father, Reverend Shaw Moore, Andie MacDowell as her mother Vi, Miles Teller as Ren's friend Willard and Patrick John Flueger as Chuck.

After a night of partying, the reverend's son Bobby and his friends are killed in a head-on collision with a truck on a bridge outside Bomont, Georgia. In his grief, Shaw persuades the city council to pass a series of strict ordinances, including a ban on unsupervised dancing within the town limits. Three years later, Ren arrives in Bomont to live with his uncle Wes, aunt Lulu and their daughters after his mother's death from leukemia and his father's desertion. He befriends Willard and is drawn to Ariel, the reverend's rebellious daughter, who is secretly seeing the dirt-track racer Chuck. Provoked by Chuck, Ren wins a school bus race despite the bus catching fire. Shaw distrusts Ren and forbids his daughter to see him.

Ren and his classmates want to overturn the ban and hold a prom. As Ariel falls for Ren, her father complains to Wes, who tells him about Ren's mother and suggests that perhaps Ren is the one too good for Ariel. Ariel breaks up with Chuck, who hits her and leaves her with a black eye. At church, Shaw blames Ren and demands his arrest, but Ariel says he cannot blame everything on Ren as he did over Bobby and taunts him about her sex life; he slaps her, shocking Vi, who later tells him he has gone too far and that dancing and music are not the problem. Ren reads Bible passages to the city council showing that people danced even in ancient times, but Shaw has the votes to defeat him.

Ren's boss Andy Beamis offers his cotton mill, just across the line in neighboring Bayson, for the prom. Ren visits Shaw at the church, and the two find common ground in losing someone they loved; Ren insists the dance will happen anyway and politely asks permission to take Ariel, which Shaw grants. On prom night, Ren, Ariel, Willard, Ariel's friend Rusty and Andy run off Chuck's gang, and everyone dances to a country version of "Footloose".

Shot around Atlanta in late 2010 on a $24 million budget, the film was released by Paramount in October 2011 and grossed $63 million worldwide. Reviews were mixed to positive.

overview: When a retiring assassin realizes that he is the target of a hit, he winds up back in the game going head to head with a gang of younger, ruthless killers.
tagline: If the job doesn't kill you, retirement will.
title: Polar
plot:
Polar is a 2019 action thriller film directed by Frank Grillo and written by Matt Sazama and Burk Sharpless. The movie stars Mads Mikkelsen, Kevin Hart, and Maria Bello.

The story follows Nicks (Mads Mikkelsen), a hitman who works for a secret organization known as the "Polar Corporation." Nicks is a highly skilled assassin with a unique ability to survive extreme cold temperatures, making him nearly unstoppable in his line of work. He lives a solitary life, always on the move and never staying in one place for too long.

However, when Nicks receives an offer from the Polar Corporation to take out a target named Sam (Kevin Hart), he begins to question his loyalty to the organization. Sam is a former colleague who has turned against the corporation, and Nicks starts to develop feelings of empathy towards him.

As Nicks delves deeper into the world of the Polar Corporation, he discovers that they are involved in a sinister plot to control the global economy through mind control. The corporation uses advanced technology to manipulate people's thoughts and actions, making them do their bidding without question.

Nicks decides to take down the organization from the inside, using his skills to gather evidence and build a case against them. Along the way, he teams up with Sam, who has managed to escape from the corporation's clutches. Together, they embark on a mission to expose the truth about the Polar Corporation and bring its leaders to justice.

As Nicks and Sam navigate the complex web of intrigue, they face numerous challenges and obstacles. The corporation will stop at nothing to silence them, using their mind control technology to try and turn Nicks against his former colleagues.

In the end, Nicks and Sam succeed in taking down the Polar Corporation, but not without sacrifices. Nicks is forced to confront his own morality and the true nature of his work as a hitman. The movie ends with Nicks walking away from the wreckage of the corporation's headquarters, symbolizing his newfound independence and commitment to doing what is right.

Throughout the film, Mads Mikkelsen delivers a standout performance as Nicks, bringing depth and nuance to the character. Kevin Hart provides comedic relief as Sam, while Maria Bello adds gravity to her role as Nicks' love interest. The action sequences are intense and well-choreographed, making for an entertaining ride.

Overall, Polar is a gripping thriller that explores themes of loyalty, morality, and redemption. With its unique blend of action and suspense, it's a must-see for fans of the genre.

original_title: ワンピース　フィルム GOLD
overview: The glittering Gran Tesoro, a city of entertainment beyond the laws of the government, is a sanctuary for the world’s most infamous pirates, Marines, and filthy rich millionaires. Drawn by dreams of hitting the jackpot, Captain Luffy and his crew sail straight for the gold. But behind the gilded curtains lies a powerful king whose deep pockets and deeper ambitions spell disaster for the Straw Hats and the New World alike.
tagline: It's a life-or-death gamble!
title: One Piece Film: GOLD
plot:
One Piece Film: Gold is a Japanese animated adventure film based on the popular manga and anime series "One Piece" created by Eiichiro Oda. The film was produced by Toei Animation and directed by Kiyoshi Matsuda.

The story takes place after the events of the Dressrosa Arc in the One Piece manga and anime series. Monkey D. Luffy, the main protagonist, is on a quest to find the legendary treasure known as "One Piece" that will grant him the title of Pirate King. Luffy's crew, the Straw Hat Pirates, are also searching for the treasure.

The film begins with Luffy and his crew arriving in the city of Gold Town, where they meet a young boy named Trafalgar Law, who is on a mission to find the legendary "Gold" that will grant him immense power. Law is revealed to be the son of Shanks, one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea, and has inherited his father's powers.

As Luffy and his crew search for the treasure, they become entangled in a conflict between Law and the World Government, who seek to capture Law and use his powers for their own gain. The Straw Hats soon discover that the "Gold" is actually a powerful artifact known as the "Will of D." which has the power to grant immense strength and abilities.

Throughout the film, Luffy and his crew face numerous challenges and battles against the World Government's agents, including the ruthless Admiral Kizaru. Along the way, they also meet new allies, such as Trafalgar Law's sister, Boa Hancock, who becomes a valuable member of the Straw Hats.

As the story unfolds, it is revealed that the "Gold" is actually a powerful artifact created by the ancient civilization known as the "Poneglyphs." The Poneglyphs were said to hold the secrets of the world and the location of the One Piece treasure. However, the World Government seeks to use the "Will of D." for their own gain, leading to a climactic battle between Luffy and Law.

In the end, Luffy and his crew successfully defeat the World Government's agents and claim the "Gold," which is revealed to be a powerful artifact that holds the secrets of the world. The film concludes with Luffy and his crew setting sail once again, determined to find the One Piece treasure and become the Pirate King.

Overall, One Piece Film: Gold is an action-packed adventure film that explores themes of power, friendship, and the pursuit of one's dreams. With its stunning animation and engaging storyline, it is a must-see for fans of the One Piece series.

overview: In the midst of a nasty public breakup of married movie stars, a studio publicist scrambles to put a cap on the escalating situation as the couple's latest film has found it's only print kidnapped by the director.
tagline: Hollywood's hottest couple just split up. It'll take more than special effects to reunite them.
title: America's Sweethearts
plot:
America's Sweethearts is a romantic comedy that delves into the complexities of fame, identity, and the blurred lines between reality and performance. The film follows a fictionalized version of the 1999 scandal involving the actors Kevin Kline and Kathleen Turner, who were accused of having an affair on set.

At its core, America's Sweethearts is a movie about the fragility of celebrity culture and the ways in which fame can both liberate and suffocate individuals. The film's protagonist, George Wade (played by Johnny Knoxville), is a struggling actor who becomes embroiled in a media frenzy surrounding his on-screen romance with Kathleen Walker (played by Christina Applegate).

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the lines between reality and fiction are increasingly blurred, and that the characters' public personas are often at odds with their private selves. The film explores themes of identity, performance, and the performative nature of celebrity culture.

Through George's journey, the movie critiques the ways in which fame can be both a blessing and a curse, highlighting the tension between the desire for authenticity and the need to maintain a public image. Ultimately, America's Sweethearts is a witty and engaging commentary on the human side of celebrity culture, one that invites viewers to reflect on the complexities of identity, performance, and the search for meaning in a world where reality and fiction are often indistinguishable.

overview: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a large bunny rabbit that manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.
tagline: 28 days, 6 hours, 42 minutes, 12 seconds... that is when the world will end.
title: Donnie Darko
plot:
Donnie Darko is an American science fiction psychological thriller of 2001 written and directed by Richard Kelly in his feature debut. Jake Gyllenhaal plays Donnie, a troubled teenager, with Jena Malone as Gretchen Ross, Maggie Gyllenhaal as his sister Elizabeth, Mary McDonnell as his mother Rose, Patrick Swayze as the motivational speaker Jim Cunningham, Noah Wyle as the science teacher Dr. Monnitoff and Drew Barrymore.

On 2 October 1988, in a Virginia suburb, Donnie sleepwalks out of his house, drawn by a mysterious voice, and meets a figure in a grotesque rabbit costume called Frank, who tells him the world will end in 28 days, 6 hours, 42 minutes and 12 seconds. Waking on a golf course, he returns home to find that a jet engine of unknown origin has crashed into his bedroom. As the visions continue, a psychiatrist diagnoses daylight hallucinations. When Frank asks Donnie whether he believes in time travel, Donnie consults Monnitoff, who gives him The Philosophy of Time Travel, a book by Roberta Sparrow, a seemingly senile old woman known locally as Grandma Death.

Sleepwalking at Frank's urging, Donnie floods the school. He begins dating Gretchen, a newcomer hiding from a violent stepfather. Donnie mocks the gym teacher Kitty Farmer's lessons drawn from Cunningham's teachings and insults Cunningham at an assembly. At a movie, while Gretchen sleeps, an unmasked Frank, his right eye a bleeding hole, persuades Donnie to burn down Cunningham's house. Firefighters find a stash of child pornography in the ruins, and he is arrested. Rose replaces Kitty as chaperone of their daughters' dance troupe on a trip to Los Angeles.

With both parents away, Donnie and Elizabeth throw a Halloween party, where Gretchen, distraught over her missing mother, sleeps with Donnie. Hours before the deadline, he takes Gretchen and two friends to Sparrow's house, where two bullies are robbing it. As the boys fight in the road, an oncoming car runs over Gretchen. Its driver is Elizabeth's boyfriend, Frank Anderson, wearing the rabbit costume, and Donnie shoots him in the eye. At dawn, as a vortex forms, Donnie drives Gretchen's body to a ridge and watches the plane carrying his mother home lose an engine into the vortex. The 28 days unwind, and Donnie wakes on 2 October, laughing as the engine crashes into his room and kills him.

Released soon after the September 11 attacks, the film was barely promoted and grossed just $517,375 in its first run, but it gained a cult following.

original_title: Harold & Kumar Escape from Guantanamo Bay
overview: Having satisfied their urge for White Castle, Harold and Kumar jump on a plane to catch up with Harold's love interest, who's headed for the Netherlands. But the pair must change their plans when Kumar is accused of being a terrorist. Rob Corddry also stars in this wild comedy sequel that follows the hapless stoners' misadventures as they try to avoid being captured by the Department of Homeland Security.
tagline: This time they're running from the joint.
title: Harold & Kumar Escape from Guantanamo Bay
plot:
Harold & Kumar Escape from Guantanamo Bay is a 2008 American stoner comedy film directed by Danny Leiner. The movie follows the misadventures of two friends, Harold Lee (John Cho) and Kumar Patel (Kal Penn), as they attempt to retrieve their stolen marijuana from a group of terrorists at Guantanamo Bay.

The main themes of the movie include:

1. Friendship: The film showcases the strong bond between Harold and Kumar, who have been friends since childhood. Their friendship is put to the test as they navigate various challenges and obstacles.
2. Cultural differences: The movie explores the cultural differences between Harold, a Korean-American, and Kumar, an Indian-American. This contrast leads to humorous misunderstandings and situations.
3. Racial stereotypes: The film pokes fun at racial stereotypes, particularly those associated with Asian Americans. However, it also tackles issues of racism and xenophobia in a lighthearted way.
4. Coming-of-age: Harold & Kumar Escape from Guantanamo Bay can be seen as a coming-of-age story for both characters. They are forced to confront their own maturity and take responsibility for their actions.
5. Social commentary: The movie offers social commentary on issues such as the War on Terror, racism, and xenophobia. It uses satire and absurdity to critique these topics.

The plot development of the movie follows Harold and Kumar's journey from their initial attempt to retrieve their marijuana to their eventual escape from Guantanamo Bay. Along the way, they encounter various characters, including a group of terrorists, a corrupt government official, and a series of eccentric individuals who aid or hinder their progress.

Ultimately, the ending of the movie features Harold and Kumar successfully escaping from Guantanamo Bay, but not before facing numerous challenges and setbacks. The film concludes with the two friends returning home, wiser and more mature, but still maintaining their friendship and sense of humor.

Overall, Harold & Kumar Escape from Guantanamo Bay is a comedy that uses satire and absurdity to explore themes of friendship, cultural differences, racial stereotypes, coming-of-age, and social commentary.

overview: A young girl is institutionalized by her abusive stepfather. Retreating to an alternative reality as a coping strategy, she envisions a plan which will help her escape from the mental facility.
tagline: You will be unprepared.
title: Sucker Punch
plot:
Sucker Punch is a 2011 American fantasy action film written and directed by Zack Snyder. The movie stars Emily Browning, Abbie Cornish, Vanessa Hudgens, Jamie Chung, and Bella Thorne.

The story begins with Babydoll (Emily Browning), a young girl who lives in an orphanage with her friends Blondie (Abbie Cornish), Rocket (Jamie Chung), Sweetpea (Vanessa Hudgens), and Spring (Bella Thorne). The girls are mistreated by the cruel and sadistic director of the orphanage, Mr. Edward Grey (Jonny Lee Miller).

One day, Babydoll's father, a soldier, returns home from war with a mysterious amulet that he gives to his daughter before being killed in action. As Babydoll holds the amulet, she is transported into a fantasy world where she and her friends are transformed into warriors.

In this fantasy world, the girls become "dream girls" who must fight against an army of twisted creatures, including zombies, demons, and other monstrous beings. They also encounter a mysterious figure known as Blue (Jonah Hill), who claims to be their ally but may have ulterior motives.

As the story unfolds, Babydoll and her friends embark on a series of surreal and fantastical adventures, including battling giant spiders, fighting in a medieval-style jousting tournament, and navigating a dream world filled with illusions and hallucinations.

Throughout the movie, the girls' experiences are intercut with flashbacks of their life in the orphanage, where they are subjected to physical and emotional abuse by Mr. Grey. The fantasy sequences serve as a metaphor for the girls' desire for freedom and escape from their harsh reality.

As the battle against Blue's army intensifies, Babydoll begins to realize that she has the power to control her own destiny and break free from the constraints of her reality. In a climactic final confrontation, Babydoll faces off against Blue, who reveals his true intentions: to use the girls' powers to gain ultimate control over the world.

In the end, Babydoll is able to defeat Blue and shatter the illusion that has held her captive for so long. She awakens back in the orphanage, where she finds that Mr. Grey has been killed by the girls themselves. The movie ends with Babydoll and her friends finally free from their tormentor's grasp, ready to face a brighter future.

While Sucker Punch received mixed reviews upon its release, it has since developed a cult following for its innovative visuals, imaginative storyline, and strong female characters.

overview: A veteran-turned-mercenary is hired to take a young woman with a secret from post-apocalyptic Eastern Europe to New York City.
tagline: Kill or be Killed.
title: Babylon A.D.
plot:
Babylon A.D. is a 2008 science fiction action film directed by Vincenzo Natali, starring Gerard Butler and Moon Bloodgood.

The movie takes place in the year 2019, where humanity has colonized other planets. The story follows Toorop (Gerard Butler), a former Special Forces operative who works as a bounty hunter on Mars. He is hired by a mysterious woman named Vea (Moon Bloodgood) to escort her across the planet to the New Eden colony.

Vea is pregnant with a genetically engineered child, known as "The Child," which has been created to be the first human being born in over 1,000 years. The Child is said to have the ability to heal any wound and is highly sought after by various factions vying for control of Earth.

As Toorop and Vea journey across Mars, they are pursued by a group of mercenaries led by Captain Virgil (Olivier Martinez) and his team. Along the way, Toorop begins to develop feelings for Vea, but their relationship is complicated by her mysterious past and the danger that surrounds them.

As they near New Eden, Toorop and Vea are ambushed by Captain Virgil's team, and a fierce battle ensues. In the chaos, The Child is stolen from Vea, and she is left for dead. Toorop vows to rescue Vea and retrieve The Child, leading him on a perilous journey across Mars.

The movie culminates in an action-packed showdown between Toorop and Captain Virgil's team at New Eden. In the end, Toorop rescues Vea and retrieves The Child, but not before discovering that he has fallen in love with her. As they escape the planet, Toorop and Vea share a moment of intimacy, suggesting that their relationship may have a future.

Throughout the movie, the themes of humanity, sacrifice, and redemption are explored through Toorop's character development. Despite his tough exterior, Toorop is shown to be vulnerable and compassionate, particularly in his interactions with Vea and The Child.

Overall, Babylon A.D. is an action-packed sci-fi thriller that explores complex themes and features a strong performance from Gerard Butler. While the movie received mixed reviews from critics, it has developed a loyal fan base over the years.

overview: The first story focused on Tai and Kari Kamiya four years before their adventure in the Digital World. It shows their first encounter with Digimon and what happened to them (as well as the other children). Tai and Kari wake one morning to find a Digi-Egg that came out of their computer the night before and the egg soon hatches, revealing a Botamon. The Digimon then evolves into Koromon and then Agumon (not the same one that became friends with Tai in the series, and yet, somehow, both Koromon and Kari remember each other), who then goes out and unintentionally destroys a good part of the neighborhood with Kari riding on his back. A second Digi-Egg appears in the sky to reveal an evil digimon, Parrotmon. Agumon then Digivolves to Greymon but isn't strong enough to beat Parrotmon and is knocked out. Tai grabs Kari's whistle and wakes up Greymon, who defeats Parrotmon and disappears with him.
tagline: New Monsters. New Battles. Now on the Big Screen.
title: Digimon: The Movie
plot:
Digimon: The Movie is a 2000 animated science fiction adventure film based on the popular Digimon franchise. The movie follows the story of Taichi "Tai" Kamiya, a young boy who partners with a digital creature known as Agumon to save the world from destruction.

The main themes of Digimon: The Movie include:

1. Friendship and Camaraderie: The film highlights the strong bond between Tai and his friends, including Matt Ishida, Sora Takenouchi, and Joe Kido, who all work together to defeat their enemies.
2. Self-Discovery and Growth: Throughout the movie, the characters face various challenges that test their courage, loyalty, and determination. As they overcome these obstacles, they learn valuable lessons about themselves and grow as individuals.
3. Good vs. Evil: The film features a clear distinction between good and evil, with the Digimon and their human partners fighting against an evil organization known as the "Digital Monster" that threatens to destroy the world.
4. Sacrifice and Loyalty: Tai and his friends are willing to make sacrifices for each other and for the greater good, demonstrating the importance of loyalty and selflessness in the face of adversity.

The movie's plot is driven by a series of events that unfold as follows:

* The story begins with Tai and Agumon being transported to a digital world where they meet other Digimon and form alliances.
* As they journey through this new world, they discover that an evil Digital Monster known as Devimon is threatening to destroy the digital realm.
* Tai and his friends must work together to defeat Devimon and save their partners from destruction.
* Along the way, they learn valuable lessons about teamwork, perseverance, and the importance of believing in themselves.

Overall, Digimon: The Movie is a heartwarming and action-packed adventure that explores themes of friendship, self-discovery, and good vs. evil.

original_title: Tinker Bell and the Legend of the NeverBeast
overview: An ancient myth of a massive creature sparks the curiosity of Tinker Bell and her good friend Fawn, an animal fairy who’s not afraid to break the rules to help an animal in need. But this creature is not welcome in Pixie Hollow — and the scout fairies are determined to capture the mysterious beast, who they fear will destroy their home. Fawn must convince her fairy friends to risk everything to rescue the NeverBeast.
tagline: They don't see what I see.
title: Tinker Bell and the Legend of the NeverBeast
plot:
Tinker Bell and the Legend of the NeverBeast is a 2014 animated fantasy film produced by DisneyToon Studios. The movie serves as the fourth installment in the Tinker Bell series.

The story begins with Tinker Bell (voiced by Mae Whitman) living on Pixie Hollow Island, where she spends her days playing and helping her friends. However, Tinker Bell is feeling unfulfilled and restless, yearning for adventure beyond her island home.

One day, a mysterious creature known as the NeverBeast appears in Pixie Hollow, causing chaos and destruction throughout the island. The NeverBeast is a massive, shape-shifting creature with incredible powers that can manipulate reality itself. Tinker Bell, feeling responsible for the creature's presence, sets out on a journey to find its home and convince it to leave Pixie Hollow.

Along the way, Tinker Bell meets a new friend, Fawn (voiced by Ginnifer Goodwin), who is struggling with her own identity crisis as she prepares to take over as the leader of the fairies. Together, they embark on a quest to find the NeverBeast's home and convince it to leave Pixie Hollow.

As Tinker Bell and Fawn journey through various lands, they encounter different creatures and obstacles that test their courage and friendship. Meanwhile, the villainous Zarina (voiced by Lucy Hale) is revealed to be working with the NeverBeast, seeking to use its powers for her own gain.

Throughout the movie, Tinker Bell learns valuable lessons about responsibility, friendship, and believing in herself. She also discovers that the NeverBeast is not a monster, but rather a misunderstood creature that needs help and understanding.

In the end, Tinker Bell and Fawn successfully convince the NeverBeast to leave Pixie Hollow, and it returns to its home in a distant land. The movie concludes with Tinker Bell returning to Pixie Hollow as a hero, having grown and learned from her adventure.

Overall, Tinker Bell and the Legend of the NeverBeast is a heartwarming and action-packed film that explores themes of friendship, responsibility, and self-discovery. With its stunning animation and lovable characters, it is a must-see for fans of the Tinker Bell series and DisneyToon Studios.

overview: Young American dancer Susie Bannion arrives in 1970s Berlin to audition for the world-renowned Helena Markos Dance Company. When she vaults to the role of lead dancer, the woman she replaces breaks down and accuses the company's female directors of witchcraft. Meanwhile, an inquisitive psychotherapist and a member of the troupe uncover dark and sinister secrets as they probe the depths of the studio's hidden underground chambers.
tagline: Give your soul to the dance.
title: Suspiria
plot:
Suspiria is a 2018 supernatural horror film directed by Luca Guadagnino from a screenplay by David Kajganich, inspired by Dario Argento's 1977 film of the same name. Guadagnino, who had acquired the rights from Argento and Daria Nicolodi, called it an homage rather than a straight remake, and Kajganich set it during West Germany's "German Autumn" of 1977 to explore inherited guilt, motherhood and power among women. Radiohead's Thom Yorke composed the score. The film premiered at the Venice International Film Festival on September 1, 2018, and Amazon Studios opened it in Los Angeles and New York on October 26.

Susie Bannion, an American raised in a Mennonite family in Ohio, joins the Markos Dance Academy in West Berlin just after student Patricia Hingle vanishes, having told her psychotherapist, Josef Klemperer, that the school is run by witches. When the Soviet student Olga storms out of rehearsal, she is trapped in a mirrored room, and Susie's ferocious dance for Madame Blanc mangles Olga's body, which the matrons drag away. The matrons secretly vote to keep the ancient, disfigured Mother Markos as their leader over Blanc. Susie rises quickly to become Blanc's protégée and the lead in the company's piece Volk, while her friend Sara, prompted by Klemperer, finds hidden passages and the withered Patricia in the catacombs. The witches break Sara's leg and force her to dance in a trance during the performance.

Klemperer, who has long believed his wife, Anke, lost in the war, is lured to the academy by a matron disguised as her, to serve as a witness. At the sabbath, where Susie is meant to become Markos's new vessel, the matrons disembowel Sara and Markos nearly decapitates the doubting Blanc. Susie then reveals that she herself is Mother Suspiriorum, one of the Three Mothers, summons Death to destroy Markos and her loyalists, and grants Patricia, Olga and Sara the deaths they plead for. Later she visits Klemperer, tells him Anke died at the Theresienstadt concentration camp, and erases his memories.

Dakota Johnson plays Susie, while Tilda Swinton plays Madame Blanc, Mother Markos and, under the pseudonym "Lutz Ebersdorf", Klemperer. Mia Goth plays Sara and Chloë Grace Moretz plays Patricia, and Jessica Harper, star of the original, makes a cameo. Critics were split, with 65% approval on Rotten Tomatoes, and the film earned about $7.7 million worldwide.

belongs_to_collection.name: Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon Eternal Collection

original_title: 劇場版 美少女戦士セーラームーンEternal 後編
overview: While under the care of the Outer Sailor Guardians, Hotaru begins to age rapidly. Then, the time comes for all the Sailor Guardians to reunite!
title: Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon Eternal The Movie Part 2
plot:
Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon Eternal The Movie Part 2 is a 2021 Japanese animated action fantasy film directed by Chiaki Kon and written by Kazuyuki Fudeyasu, the second half of a two-part adaptation of the Dream arc of Naoko Takeuchi's Sailor Moon manga, with Takeuchi serving as chief supervisor. Co-produced by Toei Animation and Studio Deen and distributed by Toei Company, the two films form a continuation, effectively the fourth season, of the anime series Sailor Moon Crystal. Kotono Mitsuishi voices Usagi Tsukino / Sailor Moon, with Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Helios, Naomi Watanabe as Zirconia and Nanao as Queen Nehelenia.

Picking up as darkness spreads across the Earth, the spirit of Sailor Saturn restores the memories of young Hotaru Tomoe, who gives Haruka, Michiru and Setsuna their crystals so that they can become Super Sailor Guardians and free their captured companions. When Zirconia mortally wounds Sailor Moon and Tuxedo Mask, Helios brings them to Elysion, the sacred realm within the Earth, where Usagi learns that the Golden Crystal, Earth's counterpart to the Silver Crystal, is sealed inside Mamoru. Meanwhile Zirconia traps Chibi Moon, Saturn and the Amazoness Quartet inside Nehelenia's mirror. Helios uses Elysion's last purifying power to save the heroes, who weaken Zirconia and break the mirror. In Elysion, a flashback reveals that Nehelenia was sealed away by Queen Serenity after cursing the newborn Princess Serenity. Nehelenia seizes the Silver Crystal, but Usagi and Mamoru's kiss breaks her nightmare; empowered by her friends and the Golden Crystal, Sailor Moon becomes Eternal Sailor Moon and destroys Nehelenia. Chibi Moon revives Helios, and the Amazoness Quartet, revealed as the asteroid Sailor Guardians, return to their slumber.

Part 2 was released in Japanese theaters on 11 February 2021, a month after the first part, which had been postponed from September 2020 by the COVID-19 pandemic; together they were the first Sailor Moon films shown in Japanese theaters in 26 years. Yasuharu Takanashi composed the score. Netflix released both parts worldwide outside Japan and mainland China on 3 June 2021. Critics were positive: Polygon praised its message of overcoming evil with love and friendship, Anime News Network gave it a B, IGN commended its stunning animation, and Den of Geek called it an enthralling adaptation. A sequel, Sailor Moon Cosmos, followed in 2023.

overview: Afflicted with a mysterious disease after surviving an overdose, a woman returns to her childhood home to confront her personal demons but instead discovers a real one.
tagline: The mother of all evil.
title: Matriarch
plot:
Matriarch is a 2022 folk horror film written and directed by Ben Steiner in his feature debut, expanding on his 2018 short film Urn. Jemima Rooper stars as Laura, a troubled executive, and Kate Dickie as her estranged mother, Celia, with Sarah Paul as Abi, Simon Meacock as Leonard, Nick Haverson as Gerald and Celinde Schoenmaker as Katrin. The film mixes psychological drama about the damage done by bad parenting with supernatural and body horror.

Laura lives in the city and works in a high-pressure executive job. She struggles to sustain relationships and relies on cocaine and alcohol to cope with stress. After a near-fatal overdose, and suffering from a strange illness that causes her body to ooze a black liquid, she reaches a breaking point and accepts an invitation from Celia, from whom she has long been estranged, to return to her childhood home in a rural village. Her questions about the cause of their estrangement, and whether her mysterious condition might be hereditary, hang over the visit.

The homecoming offers little comfort. Something is wrong with the village, whose residents behave strangely, are sometimes unwelcoming and seem unnaturally youthful, while the relationship between mother and daughter grows more strained and toxic as Laura is forced to confront her childhood traumas. Encounters with a former flame and old neighborly grudges complicate her stay, and hints of pagan ritual and a strange conspiracy surround Celia. As Laura gradually uncovers the truth about her mother's hold over the community and the black substance connected to it, the slow-building folk horror erupts into a third act of gruesome body horror, shocking surprises and dark rituals.

Matriarch was released on Hulu in the United States and on Disney+ in the United Kingdom on October 21, 2022, as part of Hulu's Halloween programming. It holds an 85% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Noel Murray of the Los Angeles Times praised the way it shifts between the physical threat of dark supernatural forces and the harm done by a lifetime of bad parenting, and Starburst called it a slowly simmering powder keg mixing human drama with touches of Cronenberg and The Devils. Meagan Navarro of Bloody Disgusting, awarding two and a half skulls out of five, praised Rooper and Dickie and its striking imagery but found it overly ambitious and its resolutions unsatisfying, while Ben Kenigsberg of The New York Times called the dark, barely legible finale a letdown.

overview: Fourteen years after the events of the first film, a series of encounters between people in Britain reminds us that in these different times Love, actually exists.
tagline: Love Continues
title: Red Nose Day Actually
plot:
Red Nose Day Actually is a romantic comedy film that explores the complexities of love and relationships through the lens of multiple storylines set during the same period in London. The movie delves into the intricacies of human connections, revealing how people navigate their emotions, desires, and vulnerabilities.

At its core, Red Nose Day Actually is a poignant exploration of the fragility and beauty of human relationships. It masterfully weaves together tales of love, loss, and longing, showcasing the ebbs and flows of life's journey. The film's narrative is replete with moments of tenderness, humor, and poignancy, as its characters confront their fears, insecurities, and dreams.

Through its diverse cast of characters, Red Nose Day Actually sheds light on the universal human experiences that transcend time and circumstance. It reminds us that love can take many forms – from the comfort of familiarity to the thrill of new connections – and that it's often in our most vulnerable moments that we discover true intimacy and understanding with ourselves and others.

Ultimately, Red Nose Day Actually is a heartwarming and thought-provoking film that celebrates the complexities of human relationships, inviting viewers to reflect on their own experiences and emotions.

belongs_to_collection.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - Collection

original_title: 鬼滅の刃 兄妹の絆
overview: Tanjiro finds his family slaughtered and the lone survivor, his sister Nezuko Kamado, turned into a Demon. To his surprise, however, Nezuko still shows signs of human emotion and thought. Thus begins Tanjiro's journey to seek out the Demon who killed their family and turn his sister human again. A recap film of Kimetsu no Yaiba, covering episodes 1-5 with extra footage.
title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Sibling's Bond
plot:
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba – Sibling's Bond (Japanese: Kimetsu no Yaiba: Kyōdai no Kizuna) is a 2019 Japanese animated dark fantasy compilation film produced by Ufotable, based on Koyoharu Gotouge's manga Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba. Running 105 minutes, it assembles the first five episodes of the anime television series with additional footage and was screened in theaters shortly before the series premiered on television. The series was directed by Haruo Sotozaki with scripts by the Ufotable staff, character designs by Akira Matsushima and music by Yuki Kajiura and Go Shiina. The voice cast is led by Natsuki Hanae as Tanjiro Kamado and Akari Kito as his sister Nezuko, with Takahiro Sakurai as Giyu Tomioka and Hōchū Ōtsuka as Sakonji Urokodaki.

Set in Japan's Taishō era, the story follows Tanjiro, a kind-hearted boy who supports his family by selling charcoal in a town below their snowy mountain home. Returning one day, he finds his family slaughtered by a demon; only his younger sister Nezuko survives, but she has been turned into a demon herself. The Demon Slayer Giyu Tomioka arrives to kill her, but Tanjiro defends her, and when Nezuko resists her craving for human flesh, Giyu spares them and sends Tanjiro to the trainer Sakonji Urokodaki on Mount Sagiri. After burying their family, the siblings set out. Urokodaki tests Tanjiro's resolve and accepts him as a pupil, and over two years Tanjiro learns Total Concentration and Water Breathing, aided by the mysterious swordsmen Sabito and Makomo, former students of Urokodaki, until he cuts a giant boulder in two. At the Final Selection, a seven-day ordeal on a mountain full of captive demons, he defeats the Hand Demon, which had killed Sabito, Makomo and other students of his master. Tanjiro returns as one of only a handful of survivors, reunites with an awakened Nezuko, receives a sword that turns black and is sent on his first mission to a village where young girls have been disappearing.

Sibling's Bond played in Japanese theaters for two weeks from 29 March 2019, a week before the television premiere on 6 April. Aniplex of America screened it at the Aratani Theatre in Los Angeles on 31 March 2019, and Madman Entertainment presented it in select Australian theaters on 2 April. The series' opening theme, "Gurenge," is performed by LiSA, and Aniplex of America licensed the anime for streaming in North America.

overview: Dracula, Mavis, Johnny and the rest of the Drac Pack take a vacation on a luxury Monster Cruise Ship, where Dracula falls in love with the ship’s captain, Ericka, who’s secretly a descendant of Abraham Van Helsing, the notorious monster slayer.
tagline: Family vacation. It will suck the life out of you.
title: Hotel Transylvania 3: Summer Vacation
plot:
Hotel Transylvania 3: Summer Vacation is a 2018 American animated monster comedy film directed by Genndy Tartakovsky and produced by Sony Pictures Animation. The movie serves as the third installment in the Hotel Transylvania franchise.

The story begins with Count Dracula (Adam Sandler) preparing for his daughter Mavis's (Selena Gomez) wedding to Jonathan (Andy Samberg). However, on the eve of the ceremony, a werewolf named Wayne (Kevin James) crashes the party and steals the bride. In an attempt to rescue Mavis, Dracula sets sail on a cruise ship called the "Dreadful Child" with his friends, including Frankenstein's monster (Steve Buscemi), the Invisible Man (David Spade), and the Wolfman (Robert Smigel).

As they embark on their journey, the group faces various obstacles, including sea monsters, pirates, and a rival cruise line run by the evil Captain Cutler (Peter Criss). Along the way, Dracula begins to reconnect with his daughter and learns to let go of his overprotectiveness.

Meanwhile, Mavis is being pursued by Jonathan's werewolf friend, Wayne. As they try to outsmart each other, they develop feelings for each other, but their love is put to the test when they are forced to confront their respective pasts.

Throughout the movie, Dracula and Mavis grow closer as they face various challenges together. They also learn valuable lessons about trust, acceptance, and embracing change. The film features a range of humor, from slapstick comedy to witty one-liners, making it an entertaining ride for audiences of all ages.

As the story unfolds, the group faces its greatest challenge yet: a showdown with Captain Cutler and his pirate crew. In the end, Dracula and Mavis successfully rescue their friends and find love in the process. The movie concludes on a heartwarming note, with the entire cast coming together to celebrate the power of friendship and acceptance.

Overall, Hotel Transylvania 3: Summer Vacation is a fun and lighthearted film that explores themes of family, love, and self-discovery. With its colorful characters, engaging storyline, and hilarious humor, it's sure to delight both kids and adults alike.

overview: After being coerced into working for a crime boss, a young getaway driver finds himself taking part in a heist doomed to fail.
tagline: All you need is one killer track.
title: Baby Driver
plot:
Baby Driver is a 2017 American action film written and directed by Edgar Wright, produced by Big Talk Productions, Stolen Pictures, and Cross Creek Pictures.

The movie follows the story of Baby (played by Ansel Elgort), a young getaway driver who works for a crime boss named Doc (Kevin Spacey). Baby has a unique talent - he can drive like no one else, with an incredible ability to anticipate the actions of those around him. He uses this skill to plan and execute high-stakes heists.

Baby's life is mundane and unfulfilling, stuck in a routine that consists of driving for Doc and listening to music on his headphones. However, things take a turn when Baby meets Debora (Lily James), a waitress at the diner where he works. The two share a romantic connection, but their relationship is complicated by Baby's secret life as a getaway driver.

As Baby becomes more involved with Debora, he begins to question his loyalty to Doc and the morality of his actions. He also starts to develop feelings for Debora, which puts him in a difficult position. Meanwhile, Doc's plans become increasingly reckless, putting everyone at risk.

The plot thickens when Baby is forced to participate in a high-stakes heist that goes horribly wrong. In an attempt to escape the chaos, Baby flees with Debora and her brother, Joey (Jamie Foxx), who is also involved in the crime world. The three of them embark on a road trip across the country, pursued by Doc's henchmen.

Throughout the film, Wright uses music as a key element of the storytelling. Baby's love of music is a central theme, and he uses it to express his emotions and connect with others. The film features a range of genres, from rock to hip-hop, which adds to its energy and excitement.

As the story unfolds, Baby must confront his past and make a choice between his loyalty to Doc and his growing feelings for Debora. In the end, Baby makes a bold move that sets him free from his life as a getaway driver. The film concludes with Baby driving off into the sunset, finally able to pursue his dreams and find happiness.

Overall, Baby Driver is a high-octane action film with a unique blend of music, style, and humor. Wright's direction brings the story to life, and the cast delivers strong performances that add depth and emotion to the narrative.

overview: An affable underachiever finds out he's fathered 533 children through anonymous donations to a fertility clinic 20 years ago. Now he must decide whether or not to come forward when 142 of them file a lawsuit to reveal his identity.
tagline: You're never quite ready for what life delivers.
title: Delivery Man
plot:
Delivery Man is a 2013 American comedy-drama written and directed by Ken Scott and produced by DreamWorks Pictures and Reliance Entertainment. A scene-for-scene remake of Scott's 2011 French-Canadian film Starbuck, it stars Vince Vaughn as David Wozniak, with Chris Pratt as his friend and lawyer, Brett, and Cobie Smulders as his girlfriend, Emma; Britt Robertson, Jack Reynor and the Polish actor Andrzej Blumenfeld, as David's father, also appear.

David is a deliveryman for his family's butcher shop in New York, hounded by thugs to whom he owes $80,000, and his girlfriend, Emma, a police officer, is pregnant with his child. One day a lawyer for a sperm bank tells him that the 693 donations he made as a student, which earned him $24,255, were used to father 533 children, and that 142 of them have filed a class-action lawsuit to learn the identity of the donor known only by the alias "Starbuck". Brett, a struggling lawyer and harried father, takes the case to keep the records sealed and gives David profiles of the plaintiffs. Curious, David seeks them out anonymously and performs random acts of kindness, covering a shift so a struggling actor can audition, and, posing as a pizza deliveryman, saving a daughter from an overdose.

Although tempted to reveal himself, David agrees to countersue the sperm bank for punitive damages after the thugs assault his father, and he wins $200,000 while keeping his identity secret. Regret soon sets in, but going public would cost him the settlement. When David confesses to his father that he is Starbuck, his father pays off his debts, and David announces his identity on Facebook. Hurrying to Emma's, he finds her in premature labor; at the hospital their baby is born, David proposes, and many of his children arrive to greet them. In the closing scenes, David keeps in touch with many of his offspring.

Starbuck served as the working title, and filming began in October 2012 in the Hudson Valley before moving to Brooklyn and Manhattan. Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures released the film through its Touchstone label on November 22, 2013. It grossed $53.1 million against a $26 million budget. Reviews were mixed: Rotten Tomatoes gave it 40%, its consensus finding it sweet but inferior to Starbuck, and Metacritic scored it 44, while audiences gave it a B+ CinemaScore. Variety called it a heartfelt celebration of parenthood and singled out Pratt's performance, but TheWrap found it neither funny nor moving.

overview: A gutsy crew of Joseon pirates and bandits battle stormy waters, puzzling clues and militant rivals in search of royal gold lost at sea.
title: The Pirates: The Last Royal Treasure
plot:
The Pirates: The Last Royal Treasure (Korean: Haejeok: Dokkaebi Gitbal, literally "The Pirates: Goblin Flag") is a 2022 South Korean period adventure film directed by Kim Jeong-hoon. A spiritual sequel to the 2014 film The Pirates rather than a direct continuation, it follows a band of pirates hunting for royal treasure that vanished without a trace. Kang Ha-neul and Han Hyo-joo lead an ensemble that includes Lee Kwang-soo, Kwon Sang-woo, Chae Soo-bin, Oh Se-hun, Kim Sung-oh and Park Ji-hwan. Kang was reported to be considering the project in March 2020, Han's casting marked her return to cinema two years after Illang: The Wolf Brigade, and the cast was complete by June 2020, with filming set for July.

The story centers on Woo Moo-chi, the leader of a band of bandits who boasts that he is the finest swordsman in Goryeo, and Hae-rang, the formidable captain of a pirate ship that rules the sea. Thrown together on one ship despite constant clashes, the two and their crews learn that a royal treasure, lost without a trace, lies hidden somewhere, and they set off on a perilous voyage in search of the greatest prize of their pirate lives. Their companions include Mak-yi, who dreams of becoming a pirate king; Hae-geum, a born swindler; the expert archer Han-goong; and Moo-chi's right-hand man, Kang-seop. They are not alone in their hunt: Bu Heung-soo, a ruthless rebel and traitor prepared to do anything to get what he wants, takes to the sea with his followers, including his subordinate Mangcho, to seize the treasure for himself.

Kang plays Moo-chi and Han plays Hae-rang, with Lee as Mak-yi, Kwon as Bu Heung-soo, Chae as Hae-geum and Oh as Han-goong. Planned for summer 2021 and then for the Chuseok holidays, the release was postponed by the COVID-19 pandemic, and the film finally opened in IMAX and other formats on January 26, 2022, during the Korean New Year holiday. It debuted at number one on 1,703 screens, held the top spot for 14 days and on its eleventh day became the first South Korean film of 2022 to pass one million admissions, ending with about 1.34 million admissions and US$10.31 million. Netflix began streaming it worldwide on March 2, 2022.

Reviews were mostly positive, with 60% approval on Rotten Tomatoes. MK Sports praised the cast and called the story predictable but never dull, Cine21 singled out its combination of naval and land battles and the three-way action between Kang, Han and Kwon, and Decider called Han a revelation as Hae-rang.

overview: People mysteriously start receiving voicemail messages from their future selves, in the form of the sound of them reacting to their own violent deaths, along with the exact date and time of their future death, listed on the message log. The plot thickens as the surviving characters pursue the answers to this mystery which could save their lives.
tagline: Death cannot be put on hold...
title: One Missed Call
plot:
One Missed Call is a psychological thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the consequences of one's actions. The film explores the theme of guilt, regret, and the blurred lines between right and wrong.

The story revolves around a mysterious phone call that predicts the exact time and circumstances of a person's death, leaving them with no choice but to take their own life to avoid being killed. This concept serves as a catalyst for the characters to confront their past mistakes and the consequences of their actions.

Throughout the film, the main character, Koichi Sakakibara, is forced to navigate this treacherous world, where the lines between good and evil are constantly shifting. As he delves deeper into the mystery, he begins to realize that the phone calls are not just random predictions, but rather a manifestation of the guilt and regret that haunts those who have committed wrongdoings.

The film's exploration of these themes is both thought-provoking and unsettling, leaving the audience with a sense of unease and discomfort. Ultimately, One Missed Call is a cautionary tale about the dangers of unchecked ambition, greed, and the devastating consequences of one's actions.

overview: The film centers mostly around the personal and professional life of Thomas "Stonewall" Jackson, a brilliant if eccentric Confederate general, from the outbreak of the American Civil War until its halfway point.
tagline: The nations heart was touched by...
title: Gods and Generals
plot:
Gods and Generals is a 2003 American epic war drama written and directed by Ronald F. Maxwell, adapted from Jeffrey Shaara's 1996 novel and serving as a prequel to Maxwell's Gettysburg (1993). It traces Confederate general Stonewall Jackson from the start of the Civil War to his death after Chancellorsville. Media mogul Ted Turner, who had been turned down by Warner Bros. in 2000, personally financed most of the production and appears in a cameo, as do several members of Congress. Filmed in 2001, it ran more than five hours before being cut to about three hours and forty minutes for its theatrical release by Warner Bros. on February 21, 2003; a longer director's cut followed in 2011.

When Virginia secedes, Robert E. Lee resigns from the U.S. Army, and Jackson, a professor at the Virginia Military Institute, leaves his family to fight. At the First Battle of Manassas, his steady brigade earns him the nickname "Stonewall" as the Confederates rout Union forces. Meanwhile, teacher Joshua Chamberlain becomes an officer and learns tactics from Colonel Adelbert Ames of the 20th Maine. At Fredericksburg, Union troops loot the town and then hurl themselves against Confederate positions behind a stone wall on Marye's Heights, where Irish units end up fighting each other. Chamberlain's regiment, pinned down in the open, survives by sheltering behind the dead before retreating.

Jackson winters at Moss Neck Manor, where he befriends a young girl, Jane Corbin, and weeps when she dies of scarlet fever. Reunited briefly with his wife and newborn child, he then leads a surprise flank attack at Chancellorsville, guided by his chaplain, and routs the Union 11th Corps before the attack stalls in confusion. Scouting at night, he is shot by his own men, who mistake his party for Union cavalry. His left arm is amputated, prompting Lee to say he has lost his right arm, and Jackson dies of pneumonia. His body returns to Lexington under the new Confederate flag.

Stephen Lang plays Jackson, Jeff Daniels plays Chamberlain and Robert Duvall plays Lee, with Mira Sorvino, Kevin Conway and C. Thomas Howell. Critics praised the acting and period detail but faulted the length and pacing, giving it 8% approval on Rotten Tomatoes, and critics and historians, including the Southern Poverty Law Center, accused it of a pro-Confederate "Lost Cause" slant. It grossed $12.8 million against a $56 million budget, which led Turner to drop plans to adapt the final novel of the trilogy.

overview: The continuing adventures of the barbers at Calvin's Barbershop. Gina, a stylist at the beauty shop next door, is now trying to cut in on his business. Calvin is again struggling to keep his father's shop and traditions alive--this time against urban developers looking to replace mom & pop establishments with name-brand chains. The world changes, but some things never go out of style--from current events and politics to relationships and love, you can still say anything you want at the barbershop.
tagline: Let your hair down
title: Barbershop 2: Back in Business
plot:
Barbershop 2: Back in Business is a comedy film that explores the theme of community and the importance of relationships in maintaining social cohesion. The movie delves into the lives of the characters in the barbershop, showcasing their interactions and dynamics as they navigate the challenges of everyday life.

The film also touches on the theme of identity and how it evolves over time. As the main character, Eddie, navigates his way through adulthood, he must confront his own sense of self and find a balance between his personal and professional life. This internal struggle is reflected in his relationships with those around him, particularly his friends and family.

Furthermore, the movie highlights the theme of loyalty and friendship, as the characters come together to support each other through various struggles and triumphs. The barbershop serves as a hub for social interaction, where people from different walks of life can gather, share stories, and find common ground.

Overall, Barbershop 2: Back in Business is a heartwarming film that celebrates the importance of community, relationships, and personal growth, making it a relatable and entertaining watch.

overview: A story set on the offshore drilling rig Deepwater Horizon, which exploded during April 2010 and created the worst oil spill in U.S. history.
tagline: When faced with our darkest hour, hope is not a tactic
title: Deepwater Horizon
plot:
Deepwater Horizon is a 2016 American biographical disaster film directed by Peter Berg and written by Matthew Michael Carnahan, Matthew Robbins, and Billy Ray. The film is based on the true story of the Deepwater Horizon oil spill, which occurred on April 20, 2010.

The movie begins with Mike Williams (played by Mark Wahlberg), a young and ambitious oil rig worker who has just been hired to work on the Deepwater Horizon, an offshore drilling platform located in the Gulf of Mexico. The film then cuts to the present day, where we see Mike as a single father living in Houston, Texas.

Mike is struggling to make ends meet after his daughter's death in a car accident, and he sees this new job as an opportunity to provide for her. He reunites with his old flame, Andrea Fleytas (played by Kate Hudson), who has become a nurse at the hospital where Mike works.

As Mike begins working on the Deepwater Horizon, we see him quickly rise through the ranks due to his exceptional skills and work ethic. However, tensions begin to rise among the crew as they face numerous challenges, including equipment failures and disagreements with their superiors.

On April 20, 2010, a catastrophic explosion occurs on the rig, killing 11 workers and injuring many more. The film then cuts to the aftermath of the disaster, where we see Mike's efforts to help rescue his fellow crew members and find out what caused the explosion.

As the investigation into the disaster unfolds, it becomes clear that the rig was not properly maintained, and that BP (British Petroleum) had been aware of the risks associated with drilling in the Gulf. The film then cuts to a series of courtroom scenes, where we see Mike testifying against BP, along with other crew members.

Throughout the film, we see flashbacks of the events leading up to the explosion, as well as the aftermath and the subsequent trial. We also see the personal struggles that Mike faces as he tries to come to terms with his daughter's death and find a way to move forward.

The film ends with Mike finally finding closure, having testified against BP and helped bring about justice for the victims of the disaster. The final scene shows Mike reunited with Andrea and their daughter, who has been adopted by another family after her original parents' death.

Overall, Deepwater Horizon is a powerful and emotional film that tells an important story about the human cost of corporate greed and negligence. Mark Wahlberg delivers a strong performance as Mike Williams, bringing depth and nuance to the character. The film's attention to detail and commitment to accuracy make it a compelling watch for anyone interested in true stories or disaster films.

overview: After Kansas Red rescues young Billy from a card-game shootout, the boy asks Red for help protecting his family from the outlaw Thorn, who’s just kidnapped Billy’s mother, Carol. As Red and Billy ride off to rescue Carol, they run into beautiful, tough-as-nails Leslie, who’s managed to escape Thorn’s men. The three race to stop Thorn’s wedding to Carol with guns a-blazing - but does she want to be rescued?
tagline: The Western Lore
title: Desperate Riders
plot:
Desperate Riders, also titled The Desperate Riders, is a 2022 American Western film directed by Michael Feifer and produced by Milestone Studios. Drew Waters stars as the gunslinger Kansas Red, with Vanessa Evigan as Leslie Allen, Sam Ashby as Billy Cassidy, Victoria Pratt as Billy's mother, Carol, Cowboy Troy as the tracker Finnegan, Rob Mayes as Deputy Harms, Trace Adkins as the outlaw Thorn Larson and Tom Berenger as Doc Tillman.

The story begins when Kansas Red intervenes on behalf of a young man caught up in a poker game that turns violent. By the time the shooting stops, three men are dead and Kansas Red has been wounded. While Doc Tillman patches him up, the young man, Billy Cassidy, realizes that his rescuer is the same Kansas Red he has read about in dime novels. Billy asks for his help: Thorn Larson, an old admirer of his mother, has broken out of jail and is sure to cause trouble for his family.

Kansas Red agrees, but Larson reaches the Cassidy ranch first. By the time Billy gets home, his father is dead, and his mother has been kidnapped along with two other women living at the ranch; Larson even announces to Carol that he is now her husband. Kansas Red and Billy set off in pursuit with the help of Finnegan, and their group grows to four when Leslie, a tomboyish sharpshooter who has escaped from Larson's gang, insists on joining the rescue. As they track the outlaws, it emerges that Kansas Red, Leslie and Carol each have secrets from the past they have been hiding, and the mission is complicated by doubts over whether Carol actually wants to be rescued. A series of revelations follows in the final stretch as the riders close in on Larson and his men.

Desperate Riders was filmed entirely in Tennessee in 2021, at locations including Historic Collinsville, Rippavilla Plantation, Beech Grove and McMinnville, with the Fairfield village at the Warren County fairgrounds used for the town scenes; Middle Tennessee was chosen for its scenery and its access to country music performers. Lionsgate distributed the film, releasing it in theaters and on streaming platforms simultaneously in 2022. Reviews were largely negative. Mark Franklin of Once Upon a Time in a Western found nothing memorable beyond its handsome homes and freshly scrubbed cast, criticized a string of groan-worthy revelations in the last ten minutes, and recommended Feifer's other Westerns, such as The Last Shootout, instead.

overview: In this interactive adventure, Barbie goes on a cross-country trek with friends and makes big decisions about the future. Which dream will she choose?
title: Barbie Epic Road Trip
plot:
Barbie Epic Road Trip (also styled Barbie: Epic Road Trip) is a 2022 American computer-animated interactive adventure comedy special directed by Conrad Helten and written by Aury Wallington, with Ann Austen also credited as a writer. Based on Mattel's Barbie franchise and released on Netflix on 25 October 2022, it is the 41st entry in the Barbie film series and the first interactive production in the franchise, letting viewers choose what the characters do at key points of the story. Its title was first revealed by Mattel co-president Richard Dickson in a presentation to analysts in February 2022.

Barbie "Malibu" Roberts (America Young) and her best friend Barbie "Brooklyn" Roberts (Tatiana Varria) pack up the pink van and head east from Malibu to Brooklyn, having been invited to audition as backing singers for the pop star Jacinda (Alba Ponce de Leon). Along the way they deliver foster dogs to forever homes found through Match Mutts, the new app launched by Barbie's younger sister Skipper (Kirsten Day), while Ken (Ritesh Rajan), who has come along for the ride, tries to tell Barbie how he really feels about her. The viewer decides, among other things, whether the group takes the scenic route or the express route, which song they perform, whether Barbie and Ken become more than friends, and which detours to follow. The journey crosses the country with stops at notable places and includes a ghost story told on the road, a creepy mansion where a vampire seems to appear from nowhere, aliens making spooky noises and a hang-gliding flight that nearly ends in a crash. Depending on the choices made, the story can reach six different endings, in which the Barbies land record deals or gigs, Skipper finds an investor for her app, or Barbie must weigh her career against her relationship with Ken, one of them ending in a kiss.

The voice cast also includes Cassidy Naber as Chelsea, Cassandra Lee Morris as Stacie, Greg Chun and Lisa Fuson as Barbie's parents George and Margaret, Nicolas Roye as Rafa and Dino Andrade as Magnifico. The special's single, "Flip the Script", performed by Lydia Li and produced by The Math Club, was released on 17 October 2022. Common Sense Media rated it suitable for ages five and up, praising its portrayal of responsible, generous and entrepreneurial young adults, the smooth weaving of its alternative storylines and the sweetness of the foster-dog plot, though it found Brooklyn's forced slang cringeworthy.

overview: Put in charge of his young son, Ali leaves Belgium for Antibes to live with his sister and her husband as a family. Ali's bond with Stephanie, a killer whale trainer, grows deeper after Stephanie suffers a horrible accident.
production_companies: Centre du Cinéma et de l'Audiovisuel de la Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles
Casa Kafka Pictures Movie Tax Shelter Empowered by Dexia
title: Rust and Bone
plot:
Rust and Bone is a poignant and powerful film that delves into the complexities of human relationships, love, loss, and resilience. The movie tells the story of Matilda, a young woman who forms an unlikely bond with Ali, a rough-around-the-edges whale trainer struggling to cope with his past.

At its core, Rust and Bone is a film about the transformative power of human connection in the face of adversity. It explores the ways in which people can find strength and solace in each other's company, even when life has dealt them a series of cruel blows. The movie is also a nuanced portrayal of grief, love, and longing, as Matilda and Ali navigate their complicated emotions for each other.

One of the film's central themes is the idea that our experiences shape us, but they do not define us. Both Matilda and Ali have been marked by trauma and hardship, yet they find ways to reclaim their lives and forge new paths forward. This theme is beautifully captured in the film's depiction of the whale training process, which serves as a metaphor for the delicate balance between control and surrender.

The movie also touches on the theme of vulnerability, highlighting the ways in which our most intimate relationships can be both our greatest source of comfort and our deepest source of pain. Matilda and Ali's bond is forged in the midst of chaos and uncertainty, yet it provides them with a sense of stability and purpose that they had previously lacked.

Ultimately, Rust and Bone is a film about hope and redemption, suggesting that even in the darkest moments, there is always the possibility for transformation and renewal. The movie's title, which refers to the rough, weathered skin of whales, serves as a powerful metaphor for the resilience and beauty that can be found in the most unexpected places.

overview: The life story of Brazilian football legend, Pele.
tagline: A boy with nothing who changed everything.
title: Pelé: Birth of a Legend
plot:
Pelé: Birth of a Legend is a 2016 biographical sports drama film directed by Mauro Fiore, written by David Seidler, and produced by Imagine Entertainment. The movie tells the story of Pelé, a Brazilian soccer player widely regarded as one of the greatest players of all time.

The film begins with Pelé's childhood in Três Corações, Minas Gerais, Brazil, where he grows up playing soccer with his friends and family. His talent is quickly recognized by local coach José Leite de Oliveira, who encourages him to pursue a career in soccer. Pelé's mother, Dora, supports her son's dreams, while his father, João, struggles to provide for the family.

As Pelé grows older, he joins the Santos FC youth team and begins to make a name for himself on the field. He eventually catches the attention of coach Vicente Feola, who becomes his mentor and helps him develop his skills. Pelé's hard work and dedication pay off when he is selected to play for the Brazilian national team.

The film follows Pelé's rise to fame as he leads Brazil to victory in the 1958 World Cup, becoming a hero to the nation. However, the movie also explores the challenges he faces, including racism and sexism, which threaten to derail his career. Despite these obstacles, Pelé perseveres and continues to excel on the field.

One of the most significant plot points in the film is Pelé's relationship with his wife, Assíria. The two meet while Pelé is playing for Santos FC, and their romance blossoms. However, their love is put to the test when Pelé is offered a chance to play for the New York Cosmos in the United States.

The movie ends with Pelé's retirement from professional soccer and his transition into coaching. He becomes a successful coach, leading Brazil to victory in the 1970 World Cup. The film concludes with Pelé reflecting on his life and legacy, proud of what he has accomplished but also aware of the challenges he faced along the way.

Throughout the film, the cinematography is stunning, capturing the beauty of Brazil's landscapes and the intensity of soccer matches. The performances by the cast, including Vincent Cassel as Pelé, are also noteworthy, bringing depth and nuance to their characters.

Overall, Pelé: Birth of a Legend is an inspiring and uplifting film that celebrates the life and achievements of one of the greatest soccer players of all time.

overview: The Daywalker known as "Blade" - a half-vampire, half-mortal man - becomes the protector of humanity against an underground army of vampires.
tagline: Part man. Part vampire. All hero.
title: Blade
plot:
Blade is a 1998 American superhero horror film directed by Stephen Norrington and starring Wesley Snipes as the titular character. The movie is based on the Marvel Comics character of the same name.

The story begins with a young Deacon Frost (played by Donald Sutherland), a vampire who seeks to bring about a blood war between humans and vampires. Frost, once a human, was turned into a vampire by the ancient vampire Thaddeus (played by Stephen Rea) and has since become one of the most powerful vampires in existence.

The movie then cuts to a young Blade (played by Wesley Snipes), who is revealed to be the son of Abraham Whistler (played by Ron Perlman), a human who was turned into a vampire by Thaddeus. However, Whistler's transformation was reversed when he drank his own blood, which contained a unique genetic marker that made him immune to vampirism.

As Blade grows up, he is trained by Abraham in the ways of combat and vampire hunting. He becomes a skilled warrior and sets out on a mission to track down Deacon Frost, who has escaped from a maximum-security prison.

Blade soon discovers that Frost plans to bring about a blood war between humans and vampires, which would result in the destruction of both species. Blade also learns that he is the last living heir of Abraham Whistler, making him the only one capable of stopping Frost's plan.

As Blade delves deeper into the world of vampires, he meets Nyssa Damaskinos (played by N'Bushe Wright), a vampire who becomes his ally and potential love interest. Together, they embark on a perilous journey to stop Frost and prevent the blood war from occurring.

The movie culminates in an epic battle between Blade and Deacon Frost, with the fate of humanity hanging in the balance. In the end, Blade emerges victorious, but not without sustaining significant injuries. The movie concludes with Blade standing watch over the city, ready to defend it against any future threats from vampires.

Throughout the film, Wesley Snipes delivers a memorable performance as Blade, bringing depth and nuance to the character. The movie's blend of action, horror, and humor helped establish the Blade franchise as a beloved part of the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

Overall, Blade is a thrilling and entertaining ride that explores themes of identity, community, and the struggle between good and evil. With its unique blend of vampire lore and superhero elements, it has become a cult classic among fans of the genre.

overview: A year after losing her mother, a young girl learns that she must journey across Japan to the annual gathering of gods in the sacred land of Izumo.
title: Child of Kamiari Month
plot:
Child of Kamiari Month (Japanese: Kamiarizuki no Kodomo) is a 2021 Japanese animated fantasy adventure film produced by Liden Films and directed by Takana Shirai. The project was announced and funded through three crowdfunding campaigns by Cretica Universal between 2019 and 2020, and Miwa performed its theme song, "Kanna". It opened in Japanese cinemas on October 8, 2021, and Netflix, which acquired international rights, began streaming it on February 8, 2022.

Kanna Hayama, an elementary school girl in Tokyo's Sumida ward, has lost her love of running since the death of her mother, Yayoi, a year earlier, and lives with her widowed father, Norimasa. During the school marathon she gives up mid-race and, after snapping at her father, runs to the local Ushijima Shrine. There her mother's keepsake bracelet activates, time slows, and she meets a huge black cow deity, a demon boy named Yasha who wants the bracelet, and Shiro, the school rabbit she looks after, who can now speak. Shiro, a messenger of the gods, explains that in October the deities of Japan gather above Izumo-taisha Shrine in Shimane for a harvest feast, and that Kanna must collect offerings from shrine gods along the way in a magic gourd and deliver them by seven o'clock that night.
